main.pt: 六类冲击并发与照护者损失识别
main.trap: 范畴遗漏（只算工资漏算照护）
main.stem: Marcus, age 38, is a widowed father in Coquitlam raising two children aged 4 and 6. He earns $95,000 a year as a logistics manager, carries a $420,000 mortgage, and wants to ensure $80,000 is set aside for his children's university education if he dies prematurely. When Marcus asks an agent to calculate his life insurance need based solely on replacing his $95,000 salary, which additional financial impacts of death must the agent include to avoid underestimating the shortfall?
main.zh: 38岁的 Marcus 是高贵林的一位丧偶单亲爸爸，独自抚养4岁和6岁的两个孩子。他担任物流经理年薪 $95,000，背负 $420,000 房贷，并希望万一自己过早身故能留出 $80,000 作为子女的大学教育金。当 Marcus 让代理人只按替代他 $95,000 年薪来测算寿险保额时，代理人必须一并纳入哪些额外的身故财务冲击才能避免低估缺口？

opts.t: Loss of caregiver costs for childcare, debt repayment for the mortgage, and estate creation for the university fund.
opts.w: 正确。六类身故财务冲击经常同时出现：Marcus 身故除了造成收入损失（loss of income）外，作为唯一在家照顾幼童的家长还会产生照护者损失（loss of caregiver，须付费雇人照顾孩子），外加房贷的债务清偿（debt repayment）以及为子女预留确定教育基金的遗产创造（estate creation），需求分析必须逐项核对并加总。

opts.t: Only debt repayment for the mortgage, because a single parent who earns a salary cannot trigger a loss of caregiver impact.
opts.w: 掉入“范畴遗漏（只算工资漏算照护）”陷阱。单亲家长既是唯一收入来源，也是唯一在家照顾幼童的成年人，身故会同时触发收入损失与照护者损失（loss of caregiver），还漏掉了教育金对应的遗产创造。

opts.t: Only estate creation for the university fund, because the mortgage lender is legally required to forgive the loan upon a borrower's death.
opts.w: 掉入“范畴遗漏与债务规则误解”陷阱。遗产执行人必须先完成债务清偿（debt repayment）才能分配遗产，贷款人绝不会因借款人身故而自动免除房贷，且漏掉了照护者损失。

opts.t: Business impacts and Lifetime Capital Gains Exemption adjustments, because raising children is treated as a family partnership.
opts.w: 掉入“概念混淆”陷阱。Marcus 是受雇物流经理而非企业主或合格农渔业合伙人，不涉及企业冲击（business impacts）与终身资本利得豁免（LCGE）。

main.pt: 风险管理四招在死亡风险上的区分与组合
main.trap: 机制混淆（把不可规避当成不能降低或不能自留）
main.stem: After a health scare, 42-year-old Victor quits smoking, starts exercising daily, and installs advanced safety equipment at his workshop. He also sets aside $15,000 in a high-interest savings account to cover minor final expenses, and buys a life insurance policy to cover the $600,000 mortgage and income gap his family could not afford. How are the risk management strategies correctly classified in Victor's plan?
main.zh: 经历一次健康警报后，42岁的 Victor 戒了烟、开始每天锻炼，并在工作室安装了先进的安全设备。他还在高息储蓄账户中留出 $15,000 用于覆盖小额最终开支，并购买了一份人寿保险来覆盖家人无力承担的 $600,000 房贷与收入缺口。Victor 计划中的各项举措分别对应哪一种风险管理策略？

opts.t: Quitting smoking is risk avoidance, the savings account is risk reduction, and the life insurance policy is risk retention.
opts.w: 掉入“机制混淆”陷阱。健康生活方式不能消除死亡本身，不属于风险规避（risk avoidance）；储蓄自担小额开支是自留而非降低；买保险是转移而非自留。

opts.t: Quitting smoking and safety measures are risk reduction, using savings for minor expenses is risk retention, and buying life insurance is risk transfer.
opts.w: 正确。死亡风险因“活着即暴露”而不可规避（risk avoidance 不适用），但戒烟与职业安全能推迟死亡时点、降低早逝概率，属于风险降低（risk reduction）；用自有流动资产承担可承受的小额损失属于风险自留（risk retention）；把超出家庭承受能力的 $600,000 巨额缺口转嫁给保险公司属于风险转移（risk transfer）。

opts.t: All three actions are forms of risk avoidance because they prevent Victor's family from suffering bankruptcy.
opts.w: 掉入“机制混淆”陷阱。风险规避（risk avoidance）指干脆不参与产生风险的活动，对死亡风险完全不适用，不能把减轻或转移财务后果叫做规避死亡风险。

opts.t: Only the life insurance policy is valid under exam rules, because risk reduction and risk retention can never be applied to the risk of death.
opts.w: 掉入“机制混淆（只凭死亡风险四字排除自留或降低）”陷阱。考试口径明确允许策略组合：降低措施配合、可承受部分自留、超出承受能力的缺口用保险转移。

main.pt: 视同处置税制与无遗产税误区
main.trap: 概念混淆（无遗产税等于无身故税）
main.stem: Widower Raymond, age 71, owns a lakeside cottage in the Okanagan that he bought decades ago for $120,000; its current fair market value is $920,000. He plans to leave the cottage and his $400,000 RRIF directly to his adult daughter. Raymond tells his agent, 'Since Canada has no estate or inheritance tax, my estate won't owe a penny of tax when I die.' How should the agent correct Raymond's understanding?
main.zh: 71岁的鳏夫 Raymond 在奥肯那根拥有一套几十年前以 $120,000 购入的湖畔度假屋，目前公允市值为 $920,000。他计划把度假屋和 $400,000 的注册退休收入基金（RRIF）直接留给成年女儿。Raymond 对代理人说：“既然加拿大没有遗产税或继承税，我死后遗产一分钱税都不用交。”代理人应如何纠正 Raymond 的理解？

opts.t: Confirm that Raymond is right, because the 1972 tax reform eliminated every form of income and capital gains tax that could arise at death.
opts.w: 掉入“概念混淆（无遗产税等于无身故税）”陷阱。1972年税改虽然取消了联邦遗产税，但同时引入了身故时的资本财产视同处置（deemed disposition）计税机制。

opts.t: Explain that British Columbia charges a separate provincial inheritance tax that adult children pay directly when they inherit real estate.
opts.w: 掉入“概念混淆”陷阱。加拿大联邦和各省（包括 BC 省）均没有遗产税或继承税，身故税负来自所得税法下的视同处置与注册账户收入并入。

opts.t: Explain that his death triggers a deemed disposition of the cottage at fair market value, and the RRIF is fully taxable on his final return.
opts.w: 正确。加拿大虽无遗产税（estate tax），但身故当天触发视同处置（deemed disposition）：度假屋按身故前公允市值 $920,000 视同出售，增值的 $800,000 按适用计入率计算应税资本利得；且因受益人是无递延资格的成年女儿（非配偶或合格受扶养人），RRIF 余额全额按边际税率（marginal tax rate）并入最后一年应税收入。

opts.t: Advise that naming an adult daughter as beneficiary automatically qualifies both the cottage and the RRIF for an indefinite tax deferral.
opts.w: 掉入“概念混淆”陷阱。资本财产的自动递延仅适用于符合条件的配偶、配偶信托及部分农渔业传承，普通度假屋和未指定合格受益人的 RRIF 传给成年子女不能递延。

main.pt: 企业主股权视同处置与LCGE双口径限制
main.trap: 双口径盲套（把政府给付或豁免额当成自动全额免除）
main.stem: Sanjay is the sole founder of a qualified small business corporation in Abbotsford. His shares have an original cost near zero and a current fair market value of $2,400,000. Assuming he has never used his Lifetime Capital Gains Exemption (LCGE)—which is $913,630 under the 2022 exam standard ($1,275,000 in 2026)—Sanjay believes passing the shares to his adult son at death will trigger zero income tax. Under the exam rules, why does Sanjay still face a significant estate liquidity need?
main.zh: Sanjay 是阿伯茨福德一家合格小型企业公司的唯一创始人。他的股份原始成本接近于零，目前公允市值为 $2,400,000。假设他从未动用过终身资本利得豁免（LCGE，2022考试口径为 $913,630，2026现行上限为 $1,275,000），Sanjay 认为身故时把股份传给成年儿子不会产生任何所得税。按照考试规则，为什么 Sanjay 的遗产仍然面临重大的流动性资金需求？

opts.t: Because the LCGE cannot be applied at death under any circumstances, so the whole $2,400,000 is taxed as if it were employment income.
opts.w: 掉入“概念混淆”陷阱。合格小型企业股份在身故视同处置时若满足条件可以使用终身资本利得豁免（LCGE），且超出部分按资本利得计税而非雇佣收入。

opts.t: Because the LCGE shelters only up to its limit, so the rest of the gain is taxed on the deemed disposition before the estate is distributed.
opts.w: 正确。本题考考试口径答案（注：考试口径 2022 年 LCGE 为 $913,630，而 2026 年现行上限已升至 $1,275,000）。无论按考试口径 $913,630 还是现行 $1,275,000，终身资本利得豁免（LCGE）都只能抵消部分资本利得，面对 $2,400,000 的股份增值，超出豁免额的部分在身故视同处置（deemed disposition）时仍须缴税，且必须在遗产分配前付清。

opts.t: Because passing shares to an adult son automatically qualifies for a spousal rollover, which defers every tax until the son himself retires.
opts.w: 掉入“样题术语与实务税法混淆”陷阱。把升值企业股份留给成年子女并不享受配偶递延，身故当期即触发视同处置税单。

opts.t: Because the Canada Pension Plan death benefit of $2,500 is automatically deducted from the corporation's retained earnings at death.
opts.w: 掉入“概念混淆”陷阱。CPP 一次性身故给付（CPP death benefit）是政府发放给遗产或遗属的给付，不会从公司留存收益中扣除。

main.pt: CPP遗属给付双口径与按实核定原则
main.trap: 双口径盲套（把政府给付或豁免额当成自动全额免除）
main.stem: Hannah, age 58, is reviewing her family's potential resources if her husband, who contributed to the Canada Pension Plan (CPP) for only eight years at low wages, were to die. She reads in the 2022 exam reference table that the maximum monthly CPP survivor's pension for a survivor under age 65 is $674.79 ($803.54 in the 2026 table) and the basic CPP death benefit is $2,500. How should the agent apply these exam figures in Hannah's needs analysis?
main.zh: 58岁的 Hannah 正在梳理万一丈夫身故时家里可用的财务资源；她丈夫此前仅以低工资缴纳了8年加拿大退休金计划（CPP）。她在2022年考试参考表中看到，65岁以下遗属的 CPP 遗属月给付上限为 $674.79（2026年现行表上限为 $803.54），CPP 一次性身故给付基本额为 $2,500。代理人在为 Hannah 做需求分析时应如何运用这些数字？

opts.t: Automatically plug in the maximum $674.79 monthly pension and a $5,000 death benefit for every client regardless of contribution history.
opts.w: 掉入“双口径盲套”陷阱。表内数字是最高额（上限），丈夫仅低薪供款8年，绝不能在需求分析中不经核定就统一代入最高值。

opts.t: Use the higher age-65-and-over maximum of $752.15 ($904.59 in 2026) because all widows are treated as seniors for CPP purposes.
opts.w: 掉入“年龄档位错配”陷阱。Hannah 只有58岁（未满65岁），不适用65岁及以上的上限档位，且同样不能直接套用最高额。

opts.t: Exclude all government benefits from the needs analysis, because CPP survivor and death benefits are only payable to residents of Quebec.
opts.w: 掉入“概念混淆”陷阱。CPP 适用于包括 BC 省在内的魁北克以外省份，需求分析的第一层正是先算政府给付能赔多少。

opts.t: Know the exam table maximums, but use only the amount her husband's contribution record is actually expected to qualify for.
opts.w: 正确。本题考考试口径答案与核定原则（注：65岁以下 CPP 遗属月给付上限在考试口径 2022 年为 $674.79，2026 现行最高额为 $803.54；一次性身故给付考试口径为 $2,500，2025 年起符合附加条件最高 $5,000）。考场识别表格上限，但需求分析（needs analysis）必须核实供款资格与预计核定额，不得把最高额统一代入。

main.pt: 全生命周期需求曲线与退休阶段风险
main.trap: 范畴遗漏（把六类冲击当成整体单一判断）
main.stem: Compare two clients in Kamloops: Client X is a 33-year-old married mother of two toddlers with a new $550,000 mortgage; Client Y is a 68-year-old retired widower whose mortgage is paid off and whose children are self-supporting, but who still owns 100% of an active manufacturing company and wishes to leave $200,000 to a children's charity. How do their primary financial impacts of death differ across the life cycle?
main.zh: 对比坎卢普斯的两位客户：客户 X 是33岁已婚妈妈，有两个学步幼童和一笔新的 $550,000 房贷；客户 Y 是68岁退休鳏夫，房贷已还清、子女已自立，但仍持有100%一家经营中制造企业的股权，并希望留 $200,000 给儿童慈善机构。在生命周期需求曲线上，他们面临的主要身故财务冲击有何不同？

opts.t: X faces peak income, caregiver and debt impacts; Y's income loss has receded, but estate creation, business and deemed disposition remain.
opts.w: 正确。对照 BC 家庭一生的寿险需求曲线：组建家庭与购房期（客户 X）收入损失（loss of income）、照护者损失（loss of caregiver）与房贷债务清偿（debt repayment）三项最急迫的冲击叠加达峰；进入退休期（客户 Y），收入损失下降，但慈善遗赠对应的遗产创造（estate creation）及未传承企业股权对应的企业冲击（business impacts）与视同处置（deemed disposition）税负成为主诉求。

opts.t: Client X mainly needs estate creation for a charitable gift, while Client Y mainly needs income replacement for wages lost at his death.
opts.w: 掉入“阶段颠倒”陷阱。把年轻育儿背房贷家庭与退休企业主的核心风险完全颠倒了。

opts.t: Client Y has zero exposure to any of the six financial impacts of death, because he is retired, mortgage-free and his children are independent.
opts.w: 掉入“范畴遗漏（把六类冲击当成整体单一判断）”陷阱。案例 C 强调，不能因为收入损失与房贷消失，就假设其余五类冲击（特别是遗产创造与股权视同处置税负）也自动消失。

opts.t: Both clients have identical risk profiles, because exposure to the financial impacts of death stays fixed throughout a person's whole life.
opts.w: 掉入“概念混淆”陷阱。死亡风险敞口不是固定量，它随单身、成家、事业峰值、退休等人生阶段动态变化。

main.pt: 按龄死亡概率曲线与最佳投保时机
main.trap: 性质与流程倒置（把寿险当投资或跳过需求分析直接推产品）
main.stem: Twenty-eight-year-old Owen and his wife just had their first child in Langley. Owen tells his agent, 'According to the mortality table, my probability of death this year is tiny, so I should wait until I am in my late 50s when mortality accelerates before buying life insurance.' Based on the relationship between mortality rates, risk transfer, and needs analysis in Chapter 1, what is the flaw in Owen's reasoning?
main.zh: 28岁的 Owen 和妻子刚在兰里迎来了第一个孩子。Owen 对代理人说：“根据生命表，我今年的死亡概率极低，所以我应该等到50多岁死亡率加速上升时再去买人寿保险。”根据第一章关于死亡率、风险转移与需求分析的逻辑，Owen 的推理错在哪里？

opts.t: Probability of death is actually highest in a person's late 20s and then declines steadily, so his risk will only fall as he gets older.
opts.w: 掉入“死亡率曲线方向颠倒”陷阱。从青壮年到中年再到老年，按龄死亡概率（probability of death）随年龄呈非线性加速上升，而非下降。

opts.t: Waiting until his late 50s lets Owen use risk avoidance during his 30s and 40s, so no transfer of death risk is needed in those years.
opts.w: 掉入“机制混淆”陷阱。只要活着就暴露在死亡风险下，风险规避（risk avoidance）在任何年龄都不适用于死亡风险。

opts.t: His death risk is low, but the severity for his young family is already high, and buying young locks in coverage while premiums are lowest.
opts.w: 正确。虽然年轻阶段按龄死亡概率（probability of death）很低，但一旦发生，年轻家庭面临的收入损失（loss of income）与照护者损失（loss of caregiver）严重度（severity）极高，超出自留能力；且死亡率曲线随年龄非线性加速上升，恰恰应在年轻、死亡概率最低即保费最低时通过风险转移（risk transfer）锁定保障。

opts.t: Life insurance should only be purchased at age 65, because that is the age at which CISRO competency component c1 starts to apply.
opts.w: 掉入“概念混淆”陷阱。CISRO 能力组件 c1（评估客户需求与处境，占35%权重）适用于所有年龄段客户的需求评估，与65岁无关。

main.pt: 转换权免核保及两年时钟沿用原签发日
main.trap: 误认转换会重置两年时钟
main.stem: Five years ago, Elena purchased a 10-year convertible term life insurance policy. Last month, she exercised her conversion privilege to convert the policy into a permanent life insurance contract without providing proof of insurability. How do the two-year incontestability period and the two-year suicide exclusion clause apply to Elena's permanent policy?
main.zh: 五年前，Elena 购买了一份 10 年期可转换定期寿险保单。上个月，她行使转换权将该保单转换为一份永久寿险合同，且未提供可保性证明。两年不可抗辩期与两年自杀除外条款在 Elena 的永久险保单上如何适用？

opts.t: Both two-year periods are measured from the issue date of the original term policy and have already been satisfied.
opts.w: 正确。行使转换权（convertibility）不是退旧买新，而是原合同权利的延续：不仅免交可保性证明（proof of insurability），而且不可抗辩期（incontestability period）与自杀除外条款（suicide exclusion clause）的两年时钟均沿用原定期险合同的签发日期起算，满五年后早已届满。

opts.t: The incontestability period carries over from the original term policy, but a new two-year suicide exclusion period starts on the conversion date.
opts.w: 误触「误认转换会重置两年时钟」陷阱。不可抗辩期与自杀除外条款的起算时间同步沿用原定期险签发日，只要保额与合同属正常转换，自杀除外期不会在转换日重新起算两年。

opts.t: Both the incontestability period and the suicide exclusion clause restart for a fresh two-year window because a new permanent contract was issued.
opts.w: 误触「误认转换会重置两年时钟」陷阱，把转换权（convertibility）当成了「退保后重新投保」。若重新起算两年时钟，就剥夺了可转换定期险的核心合同权利。

opts.t: The two-year periods carry over only if Elena voluntarily submits updated medical evidence at the time of conversion.
opts.w: 违反转换权免核保原则。转换权的核心就是无需提交任何新的可保性证明（proof of insurability）即可延续原签发日起算的两年时钟。

main.pt: 现龄转换与原龄转换的定价与补差机制
main.trap: 盲信原龄转换必然更划算
main.stem: Julian is comparing two convertible term policies: Policy X uses an attained-age conversion method, while Policy Y permits an original-age (retroactive) conversion. If Julian converts five years after issue, how do the financial mechanics of Policy Y compare with Policy X?
main.zh: Julian 正在比较两份可转换定期寿险：保单 X 采用现龄转换算法，而保单 Y 允许原龄（追溯）转换。如果 Julian 在签发五年后行使转换权，保单 Y 的财务机制与保单 X 相比如何？

opts.t: Policy Y sets the ongoing permanent premium at Julian's current age at conversion and requires no lump-sum back payment at all.
opts.w: 把现龄转换（attained-age conversion）的机制安在了原龄转换上。按转换当时年龄计费且无需一次性补缴差额的是保单 X（现龄转换）。

opts.t: Policy Y prices the permanent premium at Julian's younger issue age, but requires a lump-sum payment for the retroactive difference.
opts.w: 正确。原龄转换（original-age conversion / retroactive conversion）按最初投保定期险时的年龄计算转换后的永久险保费，但投保人须按合同一次性补缴过去五年的保费差额（或应累积现金价值）及可能利息；考试口径下现龄转换为市场默认设计，实务中须把前期溢价、一次性补款与未来保费合并比较。

opts.t: Policy Y guarantees a lower total lifetime cost than Policy X, because its initial term premiums and its conversion charges are both lower.
opts.w: 误触「盲信原龄转换必然更划算」陷阱。原龄可转换定期险在投保之初的定期险保费本就比现龄可转换定期险更贵，再加上转换时可观的一次性补缴款，总成本未必更低。

opts.t: Policy Y allows Julian to convert at his original issue-age rate only if he passes a new medical examination at year five.
opts.w: 混淆了转换定价算法与核保要求。无论现龄转换还是原龄转换，只要在合同约定的转换窗口内行使转换权，均无需提供新的可保性证明（proof of insurability）。

main.pt: 分清续保权与转换权的机制及年龄上限
main.trap: 混淆续保权与转换权
main.stem: Arthur, age 69, owns a 10-year renewable and convertible term life policy. Under his contract, the conversion privilege expires at age 65, while the renewal privilege continues up to age 85. As his current 10-year term expires this month, Arthur's health has declined and he wants to keep coverage without medical underwriting. What option is available to him under this policy?
main.zh: 69 岁的 Arthur 持有一份 10 年期可续可转定期寿险保单。根据合同，转换权在 65 岁届满，而续保权可持续至 85 岁。随着当前 10 年期限本月到期，Arthur 的健康状况已下降，他希望免核保继续保留保障。在这份保单下他可以采取什么做法？

opts.t: He can convert the policy to a permanent whole life contract without proof of insurability because his renewal right is still active.
opts.w: 误触「混淆续保权与转换权」陷阱。转换权（convertibility）与续保权（renewability）各自有独立的年龄上限，Arthur 已满 69 岁，超过了合同规定的 65 岁转换上限，不能再免核保转成永久险。

opts.t: He has lost both privileges because passing the age 65 conversion cutoff automatically cancels future term renewals.
opts.w: 误触「混淆续保权与转换权」陷阱。续保权与转换权是两项彼此独立的合同权利，错过 65 岁转换窗口不影响他在 85 岁前继续行使续保权。

opts.t: He can renew the policy for another term without proof of insurability, with premiums calculated at his attained age of 69.
opts.w: 正确。考试口径下转换与续保年龄上限按题干合同数字作答（实务中须查具体保单条款）；Arthur 虽已超过 65 岁转换权（convertibility）上限，但仍在 85 岁续保权（renewability）上限内，可免核保按 69 岁当时的年龄费率续保定期险。

opts.t: He can renew the term policy up to age 85 while paying the same premium rate he paid ten years ago.
opts.w: 误解续保费率规则。行使续保权（renewability）免核保，但保费必须按续保时的年龄（69 岁）重新计算，不能沿用十年前的旧费率。

main.pt: 客户体检异常时转换权的行使时机
main.trap: 误认转换会重置两年时钟
main.stem: Three years into a 10-year convertible term policy (convertible before age 65), Nadia informs her insurance agent that a routine physical revealed a suspicious nodule and her doctor has ordered follow-up diagnostic tests. Nadia is worried that she may become uninsurable for permanent estate coverage. How does her policy's conversion privilege apply right now?
main.zh: 在持有 10 年期可转换定期寿险（65 岁前可转换）的第三年，Nadia 告知保险代理人，常规体检查出一个可疑结节，医生已安排进一步诊断检查。Nadia 担心自己以后可能无法通过核保买到用于遗产规划的永久保障。她保单的转换权在当下如何适用？

opts.t: She must wait until the follow-up diagnostic tests are completed and disclosed before the insurer can process a conversion.
opts.w: 误以为行使转换权像新投保一样要先核实检查结果。转换权（convertibility）的核保豁免与她当前的体检异常或待查安排无关，不需要等检查结果出来。

opts.t: The insurer can place a medical exclusion on the permanent policy for any condition under investigation on the conversion date.
opts.w: 违反转换权免核保原则。行使转换权是原合同权利的延续，保险公司不得要求新的可保性证明（proof of insurability），也不得因转换时的健康变化新增除外责任。

opts.t: She can exercise the conversion privilege only at the end of the 10-year term if the test results turn out to be benign.
opts.w: 混淆了期满续保时间点与转换窗口。只要在合同规定的转换年龄上限（65 岁）及期限内，随时可行使转换权，且无需体检结果良性这一前提。

opts.t: She can exercise her conversion privilege immediately without proof of insurability, regardless of the pending medical tests.
opts.w: 正确。转换权（convertibility）的核心价值就是免交可保性证明（proof of insurability）；只要 Nadia 在 65 岁转换窗口期内提出转换，无论体检是否异常、是否正在等待进一步检查，保险公司都必须按合同办理永久险转换。

main.pt: 递减定期险保费特征与按揭寿险辨析
main.trap: 误认递减定期险保费随保额递减
main.stem: Liam and Chloe are taking out a 20-year amortizing mortgage and want life insurance to cover the declining loan balance. They compare an individual 20-year decreasing term policy with the mortgage life insurance offered by their lending institution. Which statement correctly compares these two contracts?
main.zh: Liam 和 Chloe 正在办理一笔 20 年期逐年摊还的按揭贷款，希望配置寿险以覆盖递减的贷款余额。他们将一份个人 20 年期递减定期寿险与贷款机构提供的按揭寿险进行比较。哪项陈述正确比较了这两份合同？

opts.t: The individual decreasing term policy allows the policyholder to choose the beneficiary and keeps premiums level while the death benefit declines.
opts.w: 正确。个人递减定期寿险（decreasing term）虽然身故给付（death benefit）随时间下降，但保费在合同期内通常保持固定不变（定价时已将整段期限的平均风险算入固定保费），且投保人（policyholder）可自主指定受益人并具备可携带性；考试口径将贷款人按揭险定性为赔付给贷款人且不可携带的团体递减定期险。

opts.t: The individual decreasing term policy reduces its annual premium each year in exact proportion to the declining mortgage balance.
opts.w: 误触「误认递减定期险保费随保额递减」陷阱。递减定期险下降的是保额（death benefit），保费在合同期内通常保持恒定，不会随保额同步递减。

opts.t: The lender's mortgage life insurance pays a level death benefit to the surviving spouse so any excess over the loan balance is kept by the family.
opts.w: 混淆了贷款人按揭寿险与个人平额定期险（level term）。贷款机构的按揭寿险通常只按剩余贷款余额赔付，且受益人固定为贷款人（lender），不会向配偶支付超出贷款余额的差额。

opts.t: The lender's mortgage life insurance is fully portable and allows the borrowers to name their children as beneficiaries when switching lenders.
opts.w: 混淆了贷款机构按揭寿险与个人定期寿险。贷款机构的按揭寿险绑定该笔贷款，受益人固定为贷款机构且不可自由携带或改名子女为受益人。

main.pt: 联合首身故机制与离婚后保单控制权归属
main.trap: 混淆被保险人身份与投保人控制权
main.stem: Five years ago, Mei applied for and became the sole policyholder of a joint first-to-die 20-year term policy insuring both her own life and the life of her husband, Daniel, to cover their shared mortgage. After their divorce this year, Daniel wants to change the beneficiary on the policy to his new partner. What determines whether Daniel can make this change?
main.zh: 五年前，Mei 申请并成为一份联合首身故 20 年期定期寿险的唯一投保人，以她本人和丈夫 Daniel 两人的生命为被保险人，覆盖共同房贷。今年两人离婚后，Daniel 想把该保单的受益人变更为自己的新伴侣。是什么决定了 Daniel 能否做出这一变更？

opts.t: Because a divorce automatically terminates a joint first-to-die policy, neither former spouse can change the beneficiary any longer.
opts.w: 误解婚姻状态对保单效力的影响。联合首身故（joint first-to-die）保单以两人生命为承保标的，离婚不会自动终止保单。

opts.t: Because Daniel is one of the two lives insured under the joint policy, he automatically holds an equal right to change the beneficiary.
opts.w: 误触「混淆被保险人身份与投保人控制权」陷阱。联合首身故是指两人同为被保险人（life insured）且任一人先身故即赔一次，并不代表两名被保险人自动共同拥有投保人（policyholder）的变更权。

opts.t: Because Mei is the sole policyholder, Daniel has no right to change the beneficiary and would need his own policy for his new partner.
opts.w: 正确。保单权利归属取决于投保人（policyholder）身份（并受不可撤销受益人、质押或家庭法院命令限制），与婚姻关系变化是两条独立的线；丈夫仅是被保险人（life insured）而非投保人，对该保单没有受益人变更权。

opts.t: Because a joint first-to-die policy always pays two separate death benefits, Daniel can unilaterally redirect his half of the coverage.
opts.w: 误解联合首身故（joint first-to-die）的赔付结构及控制权。联合首身故只约定一份保额、任一人先身故即赔一次（这正是其保费低于两张个人单的原因），并非各自独立拥有一半保单变更权。

main.pt: 需求时间窗口测量与期限及保额形态选择
main.trap: 误认递减定期险保费随保额递减
main.stem: An agent is completing a needs analysis for a client who wants temporary coverage for two distinct needs: a 20-year income replacement period while her children are growing up, and a liability that is expected to grow with inflation over time. How do standard term insurance death benefit modalities address these needs?
main.zh: 一名代理人正在为客户做需求分析，客户有两项明确的临时保障需求：子女成长期间 20 年的收入替代期，以及一项预计随时间因通胀而扩大的责任缺口。标准的定期寿险身故给付形态如何对应这些需求？

opts.t: A decreasing term policy best matches the child dependency income need, while level term is designed exclusively for amortizing mortgages.
opts.w: 把平额（level）与递减（decreasing）的适用场景彻底颠倒。按揭余额逐年下降适合用递减定期险省保费，而抚养期收入替代或遗产规划等不随时间递减的需求适合用平额定期险。

opts.t: Level term fits the constant dependency need; a growing need is met by increasing term or, more often in Canada, a rider or added policies.
opts.w: 正确。平额定期险（level term）保额始终不变，适合子女抚养费等恒定需求；递增定期险（increasing term）用于覆盖随通胀或收入增长扩大的缺口，但考试口径与加拿大市场实务中独立递增定期险较少见，通常改用附加险（rider）或分批追加平额保单来实现。

opts.t: Increasing term policies are the most common standalone term contracts in Canada, and they carry a decreasing annual premium over time.
opts.w: 与加拿大市场事实相反。平额定期险（level term）才是最常见的形态，独立递增定期险（increasing term）在加拿大市场并不常见，且保额递增不会伴随保费递减。

opts.t: Any temporary need lasting between 10 and 20 years must be covered by whole life insurance because term policies only exist for 1-year or 5-year periods.
opts.w: 违背定期寿险的基本定位。定期寿险（term life insurance）的核心就是覆盖一段已知或可估算的时间窗口（考试常见档位含 1/5/10/20 年，现行市场还可按年定制），无需为临时窗口强制购买终身寿险。

main.pt: 分红保单权利与自由裁量权
main.trap: 混淆合同参与权与分红金额
main.stem: Nadia is reviewing a participating whole life policy proposal and asks her advisor whether the annual policy dividends shown in the current column of the illustration are legally guaranteed once the contract is signed. How should the advisor explain the legal nature of policy dividends?
main.zh: Nadia 正在审阅一份分红终身寿险建议书，询问顾问：一旦签署合同，演示件当前栏（current column）中显示的年度保单红利在法律上是否受到保证。顾问应如何解释保单红利的法律性质？

opts.t: The right to share in surplus is contractual, but whether a dividend is declared, and how much, is left to the board's discretion each year.
opts.w: 正确。分红保单（participating policy, par）持有人享有写进合同的盈余分配参与权，但每年分不分、分多少，完全由保险公司董事会自行裁定（at the sole discretion of the Board of Directors），属于非保证利益。

opts.t: Both the right to receive a dividend every year and a minimum dividend scale interest rate are written into the policy contract as promises.
opts.w: 掉入「混淆合同参与权与分红金额」陷阱。将写进合同的参与权误等同于每年必发红利或保证最低分红率（dividend scale interest rate），事实上红利在极端情况下甚至可能阶段性归零。

opts.t: Dividends are locked in unless the insurer suffers an overall corporate loss, in which case policyholders must contribute to the deficit.
opts.w: 掉入「亏损分摊误解」陷阱。无论分红（par）还是不分红（non-par）保单，持有人都不承担保司亏损，已经写进合同的保证保额和保证现金价值表绝不会因公司经营不善而缩水。

opts.t: Policy dividends are identical to corporate shareholder dividends and must be paid out in any year that the insurer's stock price rises.
opts.w: 掉入「股东分红混淆」陷阱。保单红利（policy dividend）源于分红账户精算盈余分配，与公司股东分红（corporate shareholder dividend）在法律性质和税务处理上完全不同。

main.pt: 增额已缴清保险（PUA）免核保
main.trap: 把 PUA 当成需核保的附加险
main.stem: Liam, age 46, bought a $400,000 participating whole life policy ten years ago. Last year he was diagnosed with a serious chronic illness that makes him uninsurable for new coverage. He wants to use his annual policy dividends to permanently increase his death benefit and cash value without undergoing medical underwriting. Which dividend option should he use?
main.zh: 46 岁的 Liam 十年前买了一份 $400,000 的分红终身寿险。去年他被诊断出患有严重慢性疾病，无法再通过核保购买新保险。他希望利用每年的保单红利永久增加身故保额和现金价值，且无需进行医学核保。他应该使用哪种红利选项？

opts.t: Premium reduction, which lowers his annual out-of-pocket premium and at the same time automatically increases the base face amount.
opts.w: 掉入「红利选项机制混淆」陷阱。抵扣保费（premium reduction / offset）只是用当年红利冲抵下一期应缴保费，完全不会增加保单的身故保额。

opts.t: Paid-up additions, which use each dividend as a single premium to buy small paid-up permanent coverage with no proof of insurability.
opts.w: 正确。购买增额已缴清保险（paid-up additions, PUA）将当年宣布的红利作为趸缴保费，买下一小笔已缴清永久险，永久增加总保额与未来现金价值，且完全免核保（无需提供可保性证明）；按考试口径陈述，超过 90% 的分红保单采用此选项（注：该比例属考试口径历史陈述，实务中无公开统计佐证）。

opts.t: Accumulate at interest, which locks in the insurer's dividend scale interest rate and later converts the balance into a permanent rider.
opts.w: 掉入「把 PUA 当成需核保的附加险」与「利率误用」双重陷阱。累积生息（accumulate at interest）只是把红利留在保司账户按另定的存款利率计息，随时可提取，既不适用分红率，也不会变成永久保险。

opts.t: Cash payout, with the cash then used to purchase a separate paid-up term rider that attaches to the base contract without any medicals.
opts.w: 掉入「把 PUA 当成需核保的附加险」陷阱。单独购买附加险（rider）或新保单使用的是投保人额外支付的资金且通常需要核保，而 PUA 直接用红利免核保购入已缴清永久险。

main.pt: 现金退保价值与保单贷款计算
main.trap: 混淆准备金、退保价值与贷款扣减
main.stem: Hannah owns a whole life policy with a $300,000 face amount and a current cash surrender value (CSV) of $80,000. Under standard exam rules where the maximum policy loan is 90% of CSV, she borrows $50,000. Two years later, when accrued loan interest reaches $6,500, Hannah dies without having repaid the loan. How much will her beneficiary receive?
main.zh: Hannah 持有一份保额 $300,000、当前现金退保价值（CSV）为 $80,000 的终身寿险。在最高保单贷款为 CSV 的 90% 的标准考试规则下，她借款 $50,000。两年后，当累计贷款利息达到 $6,500 时，Hannah 在未偿还贷款的情况下身故。她的受益人将收到多少身故给付？

opts.t: $300,000, because policy loans are secured solely against the cash surrender value and do not reduce the death benefit.
opts.w: 掉入「贷款不扣身故金」陷阱。保单贷款（policy loan）是保司提供、以保单价值支持的借款，如果未还清，贷款本金和累计利息会同时从退保价值和身故给付中扣除。

opts.t: $323,500, which equals the $300,000 face amount plus the remaining $23,500 net cash surrender value.
opts.w: 掉入「身故金叠加现金价值」陷阱。传统终身寿险身故时赔付的是保额（扣除未还贷款本息），现金退保价值（CSV）是生前退保请求权，身故时不会在原保额之外重复发放 CSV。

opts.t: $243,500, which equals the $300,000 face amount minus the $50,000 unpaid loan principal and $6,500 accrued interest.
opts.w: 正确。保单贷款（policy loan）本息若未还清，在被保险人身故时会从身故给付中一并扣除：$300,000 - ($50,000 + $6,500) = $243,500（注：考试口径常以 CSV 的 90% 即 $72,000 为借款上限示例，实务中具体上限及贷款利率按所持合同条款核定）。

opts.t: $250,000, because only the $50,000 loan principal is deducted from the death benefit while accrued interest is waived at death.
opts.w: 掉入「漏算贷款利息」陷阱。保单准备金不是为客户单独保管的免息存款，保单贷款按现行利率计息，未偿还的本金与累计利息（$56,500）必须同时从身故给付中扣除。

main.pt: 停缴保费与不丧失利益四选项
main.trap: 减额缴清与展期定期张冠李戴
main.stem: Arthur, age 58, has held a $350,000 whole life policy for 22 years and has accumulated a substantial cash surrender value. Following an early retirement, he refuses to pay any future premiums and does not want to accrue loan interest, but he insists on keeping the full $350,000 death benefit for as long as his existing policy value can support it. Which non-forfeiture option fits his objective?
main.zh: 58 岁的 Arthur 持有一份 $350,000 的终身寿险已达 22 年，积累了可观的现金退保价值（CSV）。提前退休后，他拒绝再缴任何未来保费，也不想产生贷款利息，但他坚持在现有保单价值能支撑的期限内保留完整的 $350,000 身故保额。哪项不丧失利益选项符合他的目标？

opts.t: Automatic premium loan (APL)
opts.w: 掉入「APL 与缴清选项混淆」陷阱。自动垫缴保费（automatic premium loan, APL）是忘缴保费时用 CSV 贷款垫付保费以防失效的临时手段，会产生贷款利息且未解决停止缴费的诉求。

opts.t: Reduced paid-up insurance
opts.w: 掉入「减额缴清与展期定期张冠李戴」陷阱。减额已缴清保险（reduced paid-up insurance）虽然终身不再缴费，但保额会大幅缩水，无法满足 Arthur 保住原保额 $350,000 的要求。

opts.t: Cash surrender value payout
opts.w: 掉入「退保清零」陷阱。直接提取现金退保价值（CSV）会导致保单彻底终止，身故保障立即归零。

opts.t: Extended term insurance
opts.w: 正确。展期定期保险（extended term insurance）使用现有的现金退保价值（CSV）作为趸缴保费，按原始保额（$350,000）购买一段有限期限的定期寿险，期限长短取决于 CSV 金额与被保险人当时的年龄，且不再缴费、不计贷款利息。

main.pt: 保费抵消演示与双栏披露规则
main.trap: 保费抵消演示当成合同承诺
main.stem: Fifteen years ago, Warren bought a participating whole life policy after reviewing an illustration showing that dividends and paid-up additions would offset all premiums starting in year 15. Because the insurer reduced its dividend scale interest rate several times over the past decade, the insurer notifies Warren that he must continue paying premiums for at least another seven years to keep the policy in force without loans. Which statement best explains Warren's position?
main.zh: 十五年前，Warren 在看了一份显示从第 15 年起红利与增额已缴清保险（PUA）即可抵消全部保费的演示件后，购买了一份分红终身寿险。由于过去十年保司多次下调分红率（dividend scale interest rate），保司通知 Warren 他必须至少再继续缴费七年才能在不产生贷款的情况下维持保单有效。下列哪项最准确地解释了 Warren 的处境？

opts.t: Premium offset is a contractual feature fixed at signing, so the insurer must waive all premiums after year 15 at its own expense.
opts.w: 掉入「保费抵消演示当成合同承诺」陷阱。保费抵消（premium offset / vanishing premium）从来不是合同保证的固定年限，而是基于某一年分红率假设的非保证演示。

opts.t: Offset projections rest on non-guaranteed dividends, so a lower scale pushes back the offset point and Warren still owes premiums.
opts.w: 正确。保费抵消（premium offset）建立在非保证的分红假设之上，当分红率下行时，累积红利与 PUA 现金价值不足以按原计划冲抵保费，抵消所需年数会自动顺延；这也正是监管要求演示件（illustration）与年度对账单必须并列展示保证栏与非保证栏的原因。

opts.t: The policy automatically converts to a paid-up contract in year 15, but the face amount is reduced to reflect the dividend shortfall.
opts.w: 掉入「混淆保费抵消与限期缴」陷阱。只有写进合同的 15 年限期缴（15-pay）才会在第 15 年自动成为已缴清（paid-up）保单；终身缴保单做保费抵消演示不会自动变成已缴清合同。

opts.t: Warren can force the insurer to keep applying the dividend scale interest rate that was in effect on the date he signed the application.
opts.w: 掉入「锁定历史分红率误解」陷阱。红利表（dividend scale）由董事会每年根据实际死亡率、费用和投资经验重新裁定，投保人无权要求锁定签单当年的分红率。

main.pt: T-100 产品定位与终身寿险对比
main.trap: 混淆 T-100 与终身寿险的现金价值弹性
main.stem: Gordon, age 54, owns a family vacation cottage that will trigger an estimated $200,000 capital gains tax liability upon his death, and he also wants to leave a fixed $100,000 bequest to a registered charity. He has ample retirement income and liquid savings, so he explicitly states that he will never need to borrow from or surrender the policy for cash during his lifetime. He simply wants the lowest level premium for guaranteed lifetime coverage of $300,000. Which policy is most suitable?
main.zh: 54 岁的 Gordon 拥有一处家庭度假小屋，预计在他身故时会产生 $200,000 的资本利得税负债，同时他还想给一家注册慈善机构留下一笔固定的 $100,000 遗赠。他拥有充足的退休收入和流动储蓄，明确表示生前绝不需要向保单借款或退保套现，只想用最低的固定保费获得 $300,000 的终身保障。哪种保单最合适？

opts.t: A 10-year renewable term policy, because renewing it every ten years avoids the permanent reserve funding cost built into lifetime plans.
opts.w: 掉入「定期险保终身」陷阱。定期险（term insurance）各续保期保费会大幅跳涨且到一定年龄（如 65–80 岁）到期终止，无法覆盖身故时必定发生的遗产税与终身慈善捐赠承诺。

opts.t: A 20-pay participating whole life policy, because building paid-up additions gives it the lowest initial premium of the options here.
opts.w: 掉入「限期缴分红险低保费误解」陷阱。限期缴（20-pay）叠加参与分红（par）和现金价值积累，其单期保费在同类产品中是最高的，不符合 Gordon 放弃生前现金价值以换取最低固定保费的诉求。

opts.t: A Term-100 policy, because it gives lifetime coverage at a level premium below whole life by giving up cash surrender value.
opts.w: 正确。T-100 采用平准保险成本（level cost of insurance, LCOI）定价，保费固定缴至 100 岁封顶并覆盖终身，因通常不建立可退保现金价值（CSV）和不丧失利益而使保费低于终身寿险，最适合覆盖资本利得税或确定金额慈善捐赠这类不需要生前提现弹性的终身需求。

opts.t: A non-participating whole life policy, because T-100 coverage expires without any payout if the insured dies before reaching age 100.
opts.w: 掉入「T-100 满期才赔误解」陷阱。T-100 按身故先到还是 100 岁先到定价，只要按时缴费即覆盖终身，任何年龄身故均赔付保额。

main.pt: T-100 停缴失效与无现金价值后果
main.trap: T-100 失效套用终身寿险缓冲
main.stem: Keith has held a standard Term-100 (T-100) policy for 14 years. While travelling abroad for three months, he misses his premium due date and fails to pay before the 30-day grace period expires. According to standard exam rules for a T-100 policy with no cash surrender value, what is the immediate consequence once the grace period ends?
main.zh: Keith 持有一份标准 T-100 保单已有 14 年。在出国旅行三个月期间，他错过了保费到期日，且未能在 30 天宽限期届满前补缴。根据无现金退保价值 T-100 保单的标准考试规则，宽限期结束后立即发生的后果是什么？

opts.t: The insurer automatically triggers an automatic premium loan (APL) funded from the internal policy reserve to keep the policy in force.
opts.w: 掉入「T-100 失效套用终身寿险缓冲」陷阱。虽然 T-100 内部存在精算准备金以维持平准保费，但对投保人不开放现金退保价值（CSV），因此无法触发自动垫缴保费（APL）。

opts.t: The policy converts automatically into reduced paid-up permanent insurance in proportion to the 14 years of premiums already paid.
opts.w: 掉入「T-100 失效套用终身寿险缓冲」陷阱。没有现金退保价值（CSV），就不可能凭空购买减额已缴清保险（reduced paid-up insurance）或展期定期保险。

opts.t: The policy ends with nothing paid out, as a standard T-100 has no cash value to fall back on, though reinstatement may be sought later.
opts.w: 正确。按考试口径，通常无现金退保价值（CSV）的 T-100 无法靠 APL 垫缴或转为缴清保障，超过宽限期即失效归零，部分合同可在约 2 年内申请复效（注：考试口径仅笼统提及部分合同约 2 年内可重新激活，而现行 BC《保险法》s.57 规定普通个人寿险宽限期满失效后再有 30 天生存补缴复效期及 2 年附条件法定复效权）。

opts.t: The insurer refunds 90% of the level cost of insurance premiums paid over the past 14 years, minus a surrender charge for early exit.
opts.w: 掉入「虚构保费退还」陷阱。T-100 没有不丧失利益（non-forfeiture benefit）和现金退保价值，失效后保司不退还过往已缴保费。

main.pt: 账户价值不足与保单失效的四类触发情形
main.trap: YRT前期低价幻觉
main.stem: Clara purchased a universal life policy ten years ago and chose to keep her payments at the minimally funded level while allocating her accumulating fund entirely to equity-linked index accounts. After taking a partial withdrawal last year and experiencing negative market returns this year, she receives a notice from the insurer asking for additional deposits. Why is Clara's policy now at risk of lapsing?
main.zh: Clara 十年前购买了一份万能寿险，选择长期按最低缴费水平支付保费，并将累积账户全部配置于权益联动指数账户。去年她进行了一次部分提取，今年又遇上市场负回报，随后收到保险公司要求追加缴款的通知。为什么 Clara 的保单现在面临失效风险？

opts.t: The fund must keep covering monthly insurance and admin charges; minimum funding, a withdrawal and negative returns have drained that buffer.
opts.w: 万能寿险（universal life insurance）存续的底线是累积账户（accumulating fund）价值必须始终盖得住每月扣除的保险成本（COI）与管理费。长期只缴最低缴费（minimally funded）、大额或部分提取账户价值、以及指数账户出现负回报，会同时触发「账户不增长」与「净风险保额（NAAR）居高不下导致扣费不降」，加速耗尽账户价值并引发失效风险。

opts.t: Taking a partial withdrawal automatically breaches the exemption test, so the insurer must end the coverage unless back premiums are paid.
opts.w: 属于范围误判陷阱：免税测试（exemption test）限制的是超额多存钱，而非提取资金；部分提取（partial withdrawal）威胁保单存续是因为削弱了账户价值和良性循环，而非违反免税测试。

opts.t: Index-linked accounts carry a 0% floor, so the shortfall can only have come from the 6% modal factor applied to her monthly deposits.
opts.w: 同时犯了两处错误：一是只有日息账户（DIA）和保证投资账户（GIA）保底通常为 0%，指数或基金联动账户可能发生亏损；二是万能寿险没有 6% 的按期系数（modal factor）。

opts.t: Because the policy is minimally funded, the insurer must keep the death benefit in force to age 100 whatever happens to the account value.
opts.w: 混淆了设计目标与合同保证：考试口径说明最低缴费（minimally funded）虽常以维持至指定年龄（例为 100 岁）为设计目标，但绝不等于合同承诺终身有效，实际回报转负和提款后仍会因余额不足而失效。

main.pt: 免税测试上限与2017年前旧单代次风险
main.trap: 老客户增额免核保误区
main.stem: Hannah owns a universal life policy issued before 2017 that has accumulated significant cash value under maximum funded rules. In 2026, she asks her advisor to replace the life insured on the contract and substantially increase the coverage amount. Beyond medical underwriting, what major tax-related risk must the advisor investigate before making these changes?
main.zh: Hannah 持有一份 2017 年以前签发的万能寿险，在最高缴费规则下已积累了可观的现金价值。2026 年，她要求顾问更换合同上的被保险人并大幅提高保额。除了核保之外，顾问在动手修改前必须先核查哪项重大的税务相关风险？

opts.t: Whether the changes would cost the older policy its grandfathered generation status and move it onto the stricter post-2017 test rules.
opts.w: 免税测试（exemption test）精算参数在 2017 年 1 月 1 日经历重大更新，与保单代次（G1/G2/G3 policy classification）直接挂钩。对 2016 年及以前签发的存量保单进行增加保额、转换保单类型或更换被保险人等操作，可能导致旧保单丧失既得权利而发生代次「降级」，永久失去原本更宽松的免税测试空间。

opts.t: Whether changing the life insured will cause the insurer to retroactively apply a 6% modal factor to every deposit made since the issue date.
opts.w: 落入期缴溢价假定陷阱：万能寿险不存在按期系数（modal factor），更不会因合同变更而追溯加收。

opts.t: Whether going over the exemption test limit automatically cancels the death benefit while still letting the cash value stay tax-sheltered.
opts.w: 因果与范围完全颠倒：违反免税测试（exemption test）且未及时处理的结果是保单可能永久丧失免税身份（税基受影响），而不是自动取消身故保障的同时保留免税储蓄。

opts.t: Whether the central bank's 2.25% policy rate in 2026 automatically resets the policy's adjusted cost basis to zero once the insured changes.
opts.w: 概念拼凑错误：加拿大央行现行政策利率 2.25% 属于宏观利率环境，与保单调整后成本基础（ACB）及免税测试代次判定无关。

main.pt: YRT与LCOI成本曲线及持有期限匹配
main.trap: YRT前期低价幻觉
main.stem: A 40-year-old female business owner applies for a $500,000 universal life policy. Under the exam's benchmark illustration, the first-year mortality charge is approximately $563 under yearly renewable term (YRT) costing—rising to about $54,521 by year 50—whereas level cost of insurance (LCOI) is fixed at approximately $3,720 per year for life. If her primary objective is permanent estate liquidity at death and predictable lifelong mortality deductions, which costing option is appropriate and why?
main.zh: 一位 40 岁的女性企业主投保一份保额 $500,000 的万能寿险。按考试口径的基准演示举例，逐年更新定期成本（YRT）第 1 年保险成本约为 $563，到第 50 年急剧攀升至约 $54,521；而平准保险成本（LCOI）终身固定约为每年 $3,720。如果她的首要目标是终身的遗产流动性保障并锁定可预期的终身死亡成本扣费，应选择哪种成本结构，为什么？

opts.t: YRT costing, because the $563 initial charge guarantees lower total cumulative mortality deductions over a 50-year holding period even if she only ever pays the minimum premium.
opts.w: 落入「YRT前期低价幻觉」：YRT 按当年年龄重新定价，后期费用急剧攀升（举例第 50 年达 $54,521），若打算终身持有且只缴最低保费，后期暴涨的 COI 会反噬并抽干账户价值。

opts.t: LCOI costing, because it spreads the mortality cost evenly to lock in a fixed $3,720 rate for life, protecting a long-term estate plan from the steep late-life cost escalation of YRT.
opts.w: 选择 YRT 还是平准保险成本（level cost of insurance, LCOI）的核心在于计划持有期限。客户目标是终身遗产规划且希望避免后期费用暴涨风险，LCOI 按发单时精算将整个保障期成本摊平（举例终身固定约 $3,720），最契合长期终身持有需求（考试口径按「短中期选 YRT、长期选 LCOI」作答；柜台实务还需核查合同是否含有可调整费率条款及增幅上限）。

opts.t: LCOI costing initially, with a plan to exercise the standard contractual right to switch back to YRT costing after 10 to 15 years to accelerate cash value growth.
opts.w: 记反了转换方向与现金价值增速：早期现金价值增长更快的是扣费低的 YRT 而非 LCOI；且部分合同虽允许从 YRT 转为 LCOI，但一般不允许从 LCOI 转回 YRT。

opts.t: Either option is identical over the long run because insurers are prohibited from adjusting mortality charges even under an open-ended adjustable-rate clause.
opts.w: 混淆了定价方式与可调整费率条款：YRT 与 LCOI 的成本曲线截然不同；此外，部分万能寿险合同允许保司按实际理赔经验调整费率，无上限（open-ended）合同甚至在 LCOI 下也存在事后上调风险。

main.pt: 平额与平额加账户价值对NAAR和扣费的影响
main.trap: NAAR与给付方式倒置
main.stem: Two clients of the same age and health each purchase a $500,000 universal life policy and build $120,000 in their accumulating funds. Client P selected the level death benefit option, while Client Q selected the level death benefit plus account value option. How do their net amounts at risk (NAAR) and resulting monthly cost of insurance (COI) deductions compare at this point?
main.zh: 两位年龄和健康状况相同的客户各买了一份保额 $500,000 的万能寿险，且都在累积账户中积累了 $120,000。客户 P 选择了「平额死亡给付」，而客户 Q 选择了「平额加账户价值」。此时两人的净风险保额（NAAR）及每月保险成本（COI）扣费相比如何？

opts.t: Both have a net amount at risk of $500,000 and pay identical monthly charges, because the accumulating fund belongs to the insurer until surrender.
opts.w: 落入「NAAR与给付方式倒置」陷阱：平额给付下账户价值的增长会直接扣减净风险保额（NAAR），只有「平额加账户价值」的 NAAR 才维持在 $500,000。

opts.t: P has a $500,000 net amount at risk and pays more, while Q's net amount at risk shrinks to $380,000 because the beneficiary also gets the fund.
opts.w: 把两种给付方式的机制彻底颠倒了：受益人多拿账户价值的正是客户 Q，因此保险公司在客户 Q 身上承担的净风险敞口反而没有减少。

opts.t: P's net amount at risk falls to $380,000, lowering charges; Q's stays at $500,000, so Q pays more but would leave $620,000 at death.
opts.w: 净风险保额（net amount at risk, NAAR）＝ 身故给付 − 账户价值。客户 P 选择平额死亡给付（level death benefit），身故给付固定为 $500,000，扣除 $120,000 账户价值后 NAAR 降至 $380,000，触发「账户越涨、扣费越低」的良性循环；客户 Q 选择平额加账户价值（level death benefit plus account value），身故总给付为 $500,000 ＋ $120,000 ＝ $620,000，减去 $120,000 账户价值后 NAAR 恒等于 $500,000，故扣费更高但受益人拿得更多。

opts.t: Both have a net amount at risk of $380,000, because NAAR always subtracts the fund from the original face amount whatever option is chosen.
opts.w: 错记了 NAAR 公式的被减数：NAAR 等于「当期总身故给付」减去「账户价值」，在平额加账户价值下，总身故给付本身已经加上了账户价值，一加一减相互抵消，NAAR 不会缩减。

main.pt: 投资账户分类、保底规则与退保费用机制
main.trap: YRT前期低价幻觉
main.stem: A conservative client asks her advisor how the investment accounts inside a universal life policy work and what happens if she decides to surrender the policy four years after issue. Based on the exam rules for universal life accounts and surrender rights, which explanation is accurate?
main.zh: 一位保守型客户向顾问咨询万能寿险内部的投资账户是如何运作的，以及如果她在保单签发四年后决定退保会发生什么。根据万能寿险账户与退保权利的考试口径规则，哪项解释是准确的？

opts.t: DIA and GIA accounts always guarantee at least the central bank's 2.25% rate, and surrendering the policy in year 4 triggers no fee at all.
opts.w: 错误有二：日息账户（DIA）与保证投资账户（GIA）的保底利率通常为 0% 而非央行政策利率 2.25%；且保单前 5–10 年退保通常会收取退保费用（surrender charge）。

opts.t: Index-linked accounts give her direct legal ownership of fund units, and early surrender charges can exceed the fund, leaving her owing money.
opts.w: 两处均与规则相反：保单内指数或基金联动账户的记账收益不等于直接持有相应基金份额；且退保费用（surrender charge）绝不会超过当时的账户价值。

opts.t: Only LCOI policies can use guaranteed investment accounts, and surrender charges apply for the whole life of the contract until age 100.
opts.w: 无依据限制：YRT 与 LCOI 均可配置各类投资账户；且退保费用（surrender charge）通常只在前 5–10 年收取并逐年递减，不会持续到 100 岁。

opts.t: DIA and GIA usually have a 0% floor and linked accounts can lose; a year-4 surrender usually brings a declining charge capped at the fund.
opts.w: 万能寿险的日息账户（daily interest account, DIA）和保证投资账户（guaranteed investment account, GIA，机制类似 GIC）保底通常为 0%，而指数或基金联动账户可能亏损；在保单前 5–10 年内退保（surrender）通常有逐年递减的退保费用（surrender charge），按 LCOI 年扣费的倍数计算，且最高不超过账户价值。

main.pt: 保单贷款、担保转让与保费抵消的机制差异
main.trap: 杠杆化与担保转让混淆
main.stem: An entrepreneur owns a universal life policy with an accumulating fund of $120,000 and an adjusted cost basis (ACB) of $40,000. She needs $30,000 for temporary business cash flow and is comparing a direct policy loan from the insurer against assigning the policy to a bank as collateral for a $30,000 bank loan. How do these two options compare?
main.zh: 一位创业者持有一份万能寿险，其累积账户价值为 $120,000，调整后成本基础（ACB）为 $40,000。她需要 $30,000 用于公司临时周转，正在比较「直接向保险公司申请保单贷款」与「用保单向银行做担保转让申请 $30,000 银行贷款」。这两种方案相比有何异同？

opts.t: Both the policy loan and the collateral assignment are ignored for tax purposes whatever their size, and neither one reduces the beneficiary's payout.
opts.w: 落入「杠杆化与担保转让混淆」陷阱：保单贷款（policy loan）本身在税法上属于处置（只是本题 $30,000 未超过 ACB $40,000 故无当期应税利得），且无论哪种贷款，只要身故时尚未偿还，都会扣减受益人最终到手的净额。

opts.t: A policy loan is limited to 25% of the cash value and makes the full $30,000 taxable at once, while an assignment transfers ownership to the bank.
opts.w: 数字与法律性质均错：保单贷款（policy loan）通常可借现金价值的 50%–90%（而非 25%），且 $30,000 小于 ACB $40,000 不产生当期应税利得；担保转让（collateral assignment）只是抵押担保而非永久转让保单所有权。

opts.t: The loan stays under the $40,000 ACB, so no gain arises now, but unpaid amounts cut the death benefit; the assignment usually is not a disposition.
opts.w: 向保司申请保单贷款（policy loan，可借现金价值的 50%–90%）在税法上属于处置，但因借款额 $30,000 未超过 ACB $40,000，不产生当期应税利得，未偿本息会在身故时从身故给付中扣除；而向银行做担保转让（collateral assignment）单纯作借款担保通常不构成处置，保单内 $120,000 现金价值继续免税增值，银行仅按尚欠余额受偿，最终留给受益人的净额与保单贷款路径可能有实质差异。

opts.t: A collateral assignment requires the insurer to cash out $30,000 from the fund and charge a surrender fee, while a policy loan leaves it untouched.
opts.w: 颠倒了资金来源：担保转让（collateral assignment）是由银行发放贷款，保单内的 $120,000 累积账户并不被赎回或扣除退保费，而是继续留在保单内滚动增值。

main.pt: 万能寿险无按期系数（modal factor）规则
main.trap: 期缴溢价假定陷阱
main.stem: A client who currently pays an annual premium into a universal life policy asks his advisor how much extra he will be charged in modal factors if he switches to monthly deposits of one-twelfth of his planned annual amount. Unlike a traditional term or whole life policy—where an exam example shows monthly payments costing roughly 6% more per year than an annual payment—how does a universal life policy treat monthly deposits?
main.zh: 一位目前按年向万能寿险缴纳保费的客户询问顾问：如果他改为按月存入年计划金额的十二分之一，会因为按期系数被多收多少钱。不同于传统定期险或终身寿险（考试口径某例题显示月缴年化总额比年缴高约 6%），万能寿险如何对待按月缴费？

opts.t: Universal life applies the same 6% modal factor as term insurance, which is deducted upfront alongside provincial premium tax.
opts.w: 直接掉入「期缴溢价假定陷阱」：6% 是定期险与传统终身寿险在考试口径某月缴例题中的年化溢价幅度，万能寿险（universal life insurance）根本没有按期系数（modal factor）。

opts.t: Universal life charges a higher modal factor of 10% to 15% unless the policyholder selects level cost of insurance (LCOI).
opts.w: 凭空捏造数字与规则：10–15 年是考试资料中讨论 YRT 短中期持有期的年数，万能寿险无论选 YRT 还是 LCOI 均不收取按期系数（modal factor）。

opts.t: Universal life eliminates the modal factor only if the policyholder maintains a minimum balance of $40,000 in a guaranteed investment account.
opts.w: 拼凑无关数字：$40,000 是案例三中的调整后成本基础（ACB）金额，万能寿险无按期系数（modal factor）是产品本身的结构特征，不附带最低存款门槛。

opts.t: Universal life policies do not apply a modal factor; monthly, quarterly, or semi-annual deposits annualized equal the exact same total as an annual payment.
opts.w: 万能寿险没有按期系数（modal factor）。因为万能寿险把保费拆分为入账后按月/按年实际扣除保险成本（COI）与管理费，客户选择月缴、季缴、半年缴在年化后的缴费总额与年缴完全相同，不会像传统捆绑产品那样产生期缴附加溢价。

main.pt: 加速身故金扣减身故金与独立重疾对比
main.trap: 预支与另付混淆（产品混淆）
main.stem: Victor and Elena each own a $50,000 life insurance policy. Victor's policy includes an accelerated dread disease (DD) benefit with a 50% advance limit ($25,000) and a 30-day survival waiting period. Elena did not add any riders to her life policy, but she owns a separate $25,000 stand-alone critical illness (CI) insurance policy. Both Victor and Elena suffer a severe stroke covered under their respective contracts, survive for more than 30 days, and each receives a $25,000 lump-sum payout. If both pass away later while their policies are in force, how much death benefit will each of their beneficiaries receive?
main.zh: Victor 和 Elena 各自持有一份保额为 $50,000 的寿险保单。Victor 的保单包含一项加速身故金下的重疾给付（DD）补充保障，预支上限为面额的 50%（即 $25,000），存活等待期为 30 天。Elena 没有在她的寿险保单上添加任何附加险，但她另有一份保额 $25,000 的独立重疾险（CI）保单。Victor 和 Elena 均突发各自合同承保的严重中风，存活超过 30 天，且各自获得了一笔 $25,000 的一次性给付。如果两人日后在保单有效期内身故，他们各自的受益人将获得多少身故金？

opts.t: Victor's beneficiary receives $50,000, and Elena's beneficiary receives $50,000.
opts.w: 错在「预支与另付混淆（产品混淆）」陷阱。把 Victor 的加速身故金·重疾给付（accelerated death benefit: dread disease, DD）当成了额外赔付，忽略了 DD 本质上是从最终身故金中提前预支（advance），必须从 $50,000 中扣减已领取的 $25,000。

opts.t: Victor's beneficiary receives $25,000, and Elena's beneficiary receives $50,000.
opts.w: 正确。加速身故金下的重疾给付（dread disease, DD benefit）属于生前预支机制，Victor 领取的 $25,000 会等额减少最终身故金（$50,000 - $25,000 = $25,000）；而 Elena 持有的是独立重疾险（stand-alone critical illness, CI insurance），按独立合同赔付，绝不预支或扣减其寿险保单的 $50,000 身故金。

opts.t: Victor's beneficiary receives $25,000, and Elena's beneficiary receives $25,000.
opts.w: 错在「预支与另付混淆（产品混淆）」陷阱。误以为独立重疾险（stand-alone CI insurance）也会像加速身故金（accelerated death benefit）一样扣减寿险身故金；实际上独立 CI 保单与寿险保单是两份平行合同，互不扣减。

opts.t: Victor's beneficiary receives $10,000, and Elena's beneficiary receives $50,000.
opts.w: 错在扣减金额计算错误（limitations and exclusions）。Victor 按 50% 比例预支了 $25,000，身故金只等额扣减已预支的 $25,000（剩余 $25,000），而不会扣减至 $10,000。

main.pt: 投保人≠被保险人时的豁免条款选择
main.trap: 豁免对象张冠李戴（条款错配）
main.stem: Tariq is the sole income earner in his household, while his spouse Nadia stays home to care for their young children. Tariq applies for a $300,000 term life insurance policy on Nadia's life, naming himself as the policyholder and payor, so he could afford childcare if Nadia were to pass away. Tariq wants to make sure that if he becomes totally disabled or dies prematurely, the premiums on Nadia's policy will be waived. Which benefit must Tariq attach to Nadia's policy, and whose insurability must be underwritten for it?
main.zh: Tariq 是家里的唯一收入来源，他的配偶 Nadia 全职在家照顾年幼的孩子。Tariq 为 Nadia 的生命投保了一份 $300,000 的定期寿险，将自己列为投保人和付款人，以便万一 Nadia 去世时他能负担得起雇人照顾孩子的费用。Tariq 希望确保万一自己完全伤残或过早身故，Nadia 这份保单的保费能够获得豁免。Tariq 必须在 Nadia 的保单上附加哪一项保障，且该保障需要对谁进行核保？

opts.t: A standard waiver of premium for total disability benefit, which requires underwriting only on Nadia as the life insured.
opts.w: 错在「豁免对象张冠李戴（条款错配）」陷阱。在 Nadia 作为被保险人（life insured）的保单上，普通完全伤残豁免保费（waiver of premium for total disability）只会在 Nadia 本人完全伤残时触发，根本无法解决付款人 Tariq 伤残或身故后无人交费的问题。

opts.t: A standard waiver of premium for total disability benefit, because it automatically covers whoever pays the premiums without extra underwriting.
opts.w: 错在「豁免对象张冠李戴（条款错配）」与忽略核保要求。普通完全伤残豁免（waiver of premium for total disability）并不自动跟随付款人，且任何保他人风险的附加条款都必须对该风险承受人进行核保。

opts.t: A parent/payor waiver benefit, which triggers upon Tariq's death or total disability and requires Tariq himself to undergo underwriting.
opts.w: 正确。当投保人/付款人（policyholder/payor）与被保险人（life insured）不是同一人时，必须配置父母/代付人豁免附加险（parent/payor waiver benefit）；其触发条件是代付人（Tariq）本人身故或伤残，因此代付人 Tariq 本人也必须接受核保。

opts.t: An accidental death rider on Tariq's own life policy, which automatically waives premiums on all family policies if Tariq is disabled.
opts.w: 错在混淆险种功能。意外身故附加险（accidental death, AD rider）只在意外死亡时追加身故金，既不管伤残，也不会豁免另一张保单的保费。

main.pt: 子女附加险起保期、固定保费与转换权
main.trap: 子女附加险转换窗口与计费误解
main.stem: Liam and Maya have two children aged 8 and 10, and they attach a $10,000 family/child coverage rider to Liam's life insurance policy. Shortly afterward, Maya gives birth to twins. Tragically, one twin passes away 10 days after birth due to a congenital defect, while the surviving twin is diagnosed with a serious heart condition at age 8. Under standard exam conventions for a child coverage rider, which statement accurately describes the rider's premium, the deceased twin's claim, and the surviving twin's future conversion option?
main.zh: Liam 和 Maya 有两个分别为 8 岁和 10 岁的孩子，他们在 Liam 的寿险保单上附加了一份 $10,000 的家庭/子女附加险。不久后，Maya 生下了一对双胞胎。不幸的是，其中一个双胞胎在出生 10 天后因先天缺陷夭折，而幸存的双胞胎在 8 岁时被诊断出患有严重心脏病。按照子女附加险的考试口径常规规则，下列哪项准确描述了该附加险的保费、夭折双胞胎的理赔以及幸存双胞胎未来的转换权？

opts.t: One flat premium covers all the children; nothing is paid for the twin who died at 10 days; the other twin can convert up to 5 times, no medicals.
opts.w: 正确。按考试口径，家庭/子女附加险（family/child coverage rider）按固定单位收费、不随子女人数增加保费；新生儿须满 15 天（出生后头 2 周内身故不赔）才自动受保，故出生 10 天夭折不赔；在 21 或 25 岁附加险到期前，患病子女可行使子女附加险转换权（converting child coverage rider），免核保转为最高达原附约保额 5 倍（即最高 $50,000）的个人永久险。

opts.t: The premium doubles once the twins are born; the twin who died is covered from birth; and the surviving twin is barred from converting at all.
opts.w: 错在三处同时踩坑：第一，子女附加险（family/child coverage rider）保费固定，不按子女人数加收；第二，出生未满 15 天（前 2 周内）身故不赔；第三，转换权（converting child coverage rider）的核心价值正是保护已变得实质不可保的孩子免核保获得永久险。

opts.t: The premium stays flat; the claim for the twin who died is paid in full; and the surviving twin can convert up to 5 times only after full underwriting.
opts.w: 错在忽略了新生儿满 15 天起保的等待天数（出生 10 天身故不赔），且误以为转换权（converting child coverage rider）在原保额 5 倍以内还需要重新提交健康证明（实际上免核保，只有超出合同允许放大倍数的部分才需常规核保）。

opts.t: The premium rises for each child; nothing is paid for a death in the first 2 weeks; and the surviving twin can convert only on the day he turns 25.
opts.w: 错在计费方式误解与「时限压缩」陷阱。子女附加险保费不随人数增加，且转换权（converting child coverage rider）的行使期是「附加险到期前（before expiry）」的一段合同窗口，而非仅仅到期日当天。

main.pt: 保证可保利益（GIB）的行权与定价
main.trap: GIB把免核保当免费或随时加保（术语与双口径误读）
main.stem: At age 25, Felix purchased a life insurance policy with a guaranteed insurability benefit (GIB) rider. Five years later, on the 5th policy anniversary, Felix has developed a chronic medical condition, and he decides to exercise his GIB option to purchase additional coverage. For the purpose of the licensing exam, what triggers the right to exercise a standard GIB rider, and how will the insurer determine the premium for Felix's new coverage?
main.zh: Felix 在 25 岁时购买了一份附带保证可保利益（GIB）附加险的寿险保单。五年后，在第 5 个保单周年日，Felix 患上了一种慢性疾病，他决定行使 GIB 选择权加保。按照牌照考试口径，标准 GIB 附加险的行权触发条件是什么，且保险公司将如何确定 Felix 新加保部分的保费？

opts.t: It is triggered any time the insured is diagnosed with an illness, and the added coverage is priced at the original age-25 rate for life.
opts.w: 错在「GIB把免核保当免费或随时加保（术语与双口径误读）」陷阱。保证可保利益（guaranteed insurability benefit, GIB）既不是生病时随时触发，也不会锁定 25 岁投保时的原始年龄费率。

opts.t: It is triggered on set anniversaries such as the 5th or 10th, but Felix must pass a new medical exam because his health has since changed.
opts.w: 错在违背了保证可保利益（guaranteed insurability benefit, GIB）锁住可保性的核心功能。GIB 的存在正是为了对冲健康转差的风险，在约定周年日行权时免除任何健康证明（no medical evidence required）。

opts.t: It is triggered on set anniversaries, and the added coverage needs no extra premium because its cost was already paid through the rider fee.
opts.w: 错在「术语误读」陷阱。保证可保利益（GIB）的「保证」指的是免核保（without evidence of insurability），绝不是免费送保额；客户为 GIB 付的附约费只是买下未来加保的权利，实际加保时必须为新保额另行交费。

opts.t: It is triggered on set anniversaries within the contract's limits, and the added coverage is priced at his attained age without medicals.
opts.w: 正确。考试口径下，保证可保利益（guaranteed insurability benefit, GIB）在合同预定的固定周年日（如第 5、10 周年日）行权并受单次限额与累计限额约束（尽管现行市场部分新品允许毕业、结婚、生子、收养后 31 天内行权，但考场仍按固定周年日加财务上限的口径作答）；加保时免核保，保费按行权当时的实际年龄（attained age）按标准费率计算。

main.pt: 定期险附加险覆盖阶段需求与依附性
main.trap: 附加险当独立保单（类别错配）
main.stem: Cheng is a business owner who has a permanent estate tax liability upon death as well as a 10-year commercial loan. Instead of buying a separate whole life policy and a separate 10-year term policy, his advisor recommends buying one whole life base policy and attaching a 10-year term insurance rider to cover the loan. Why is this single-policy structure typically less expensive than two standalone policies, and what happens when the 10-year loan is paid off?
main.zh: Cheng 是一位企业主，他既有身故时的终身遗产税负债，又有一笔 10 年期的商业贷款。他的顾问没有建议他分别购买一份终身寿险和一份独立的 10 年期定期寿险，而是建议购买一份终身寿险主险，并附加一份 10 年期定期险附加险来覆盖该贷款。为什么这种单一保单结构通常比两份独立保单更便宜？当 10 年后贷款还清时会发生什么？

opts.t: It is cheaper because the insurer waives underwriting on Cheng's life entirely, and after 10 years the base whole life policy expires with the rider.
opts.w: 错在颠倒主从关系与核保规则。主险与附加险仍需对 Cheng 进行一次核保（而非完全免核保），且 10 年后只有定期险附加险（term insurance rider）到期，终身寿险主险会继续有效。

opts.t: One underwriting and one policy fee replace two; after 10 years the rider ends while the whole life base keeps covering the tax liability.
opts.w: 正确。用终身寿险主险搭配定期险附加险（term insurance rider）覆盖 10 年期阶段性需求，能够把原本两份独立保单的两次核保成本与两笔保单年费（annual policy fee，常见 $50–$100）压缩为一笔；10 年后贷款还清，定期险附加险到期停止收费，而终身寿险主险继续终身有效。

opts.t: It is cheaper because the term rider builds cash value that offsets the loan, and after 10 years the rider continues for life at no extra cost.
opts.w: 错在混淆险种属性。定期险附加险（term insurance rider）只提供限定期限的临时纯保障，不产生现金价值，且 10 年期满即终止，不会免费变成终身保障。

opts.t: It is cheaper because each part can be surrendered on its own, so Cheng can cancel the base policy in year 5 and keep the term rider in force.
opts.w: 错在「附加险当独立保单（类别错配）」陷阱。定期险附加险（term insurance rider）用失去独立性换取更低价格，它严格依附于主险存续；如果第 5 年把终身寿险主险取消或退保，定期险附加险会同时失效。

main.pt: 意外身故附加险理赔条件与需求分析
main.trap: 靠意外双倍赔付凑基础保额（范围夸大与以偏概全）
main.stem: A comprehensive needs analysis shows that Gordon requires $1,000,000 of life insurance to support his family if he dies. To save money on premiums, Gordon proposes buying a $300,000 base term policy and adding an accidental death (AD) double indemnity rider, arguing that an unexpected death is his main concern. Two years later, Gordon dies from a sudden heart attack. Why was Gordon's planning strategy flawed, and how much will his beneficiary receive if his policy had a $300,000 base and an AD rider?
main.zh: 一份全面的需求分析显示，Gordon 需要 $1,000,000 的寿险保额才能在他去世时保障家人的生活。为了节省保费，Gordon 提议只购买一份 $300,000 的基础定期保单，并附加一份意外身故（AD）双倍赔付附加险，理由是他最担心的是突发死亡。两年后，Gordon 因突发心脏病去世。为什么 Gordon 的规划策略存在缺陷？如果他的保单是 $300,000 主险加 AD 附加险，他的受益人将获得多少赔付？

opts.t: The family's need does not depend on the cause of death, and a heart attack is illness, not accident, so only the $300,000 base is paid.
opts.w: 正确。需求分析的核心原则（value of coverage）是：遗属实际需要的钱不因被保险人死于意外还是疾病而改变，保额缺口应由基础保额全额覆盖，绝不能靠意外身故附加险（accidental death, AD rider）去凑数；同时心脏病发属于疾病而非意外，不触发 AD 双倍赔付（double indemnity），受益人只能拿到 $300,000 基础身故金。

opts.t: The strategy was sound, because a sudden illness counts as an unexpected accident, so the beneficiary receives twice the $300,000 base.
opts.w: 错在「范围夸大」陷阱。意外身故附加险（accidental death, AD rider）严格区分外来的意外事故与内在疾病；突发心脏病属于疾病身故，绝不会触发 2 倍身故金的双倍赔付（double indemnity）。

opts.t: The AD rider only pays if death occurs more than 1 year after an accident, so the beneficiary receives the $300,000 base benefit only.
opts.w: 错在记反了意外身故（AD rider）的时间限制条件。AD 附加险要求死亡必须是意外所致，且发生在事故后的限定时间内（常见为 1 年内，within 1 year），而不是超过 1 年。

opts.t: A heart attack is one of the Big 4 conditions, so the AD rider automatically turns into a dread disease payout and adds an extra $50,000.
opts.w: 错在混淆险种边界。意外身故附加险（AD rider）与重疾给付（dread disease, DD benefit）是完全不同的条款，AD 不会因为死因属于「Big 4」重疾就自动变成重疾给付。

main.pt: 第三人附加险单独核保与收费方式区分
main.trap: 误以为买主险就自动免核保保配偶及豁免必免费
main.stem: When Simon applies for a whole life insurance policy on his own life, he wants to attach a 10-year term insurance rider covering his wife, Rachel, as well as a waiver of premium for total disability benefit. Simon assumes that because he is already undergoing medical underwriting for the base policy, Rachel will be covered automatically without underwriting, and that the waiver of premium is always included free of charge. How should the advisor correct Simon?
main.zh: 当 Simon 为自己申请一份终身寿险保单时，他希望在保单上附加一份覆盖妻子 Rachel 的 10 年期定期险附加险，以及一项完全伤残豁免保费条款。Simon 以为既然自己已经为主险接受了医学核保，Rachel 就会自动获得保障而无需核保，并且以为保费豁免条款总是免费包含在内的。顾问应当如何纠正 Simon？

opts.t: Simon is right that Rachel needs no separate underwriting, but the waiver of premium always requires an extra premium in every contract.
opts.w: 错在忽略了第三人核保规则。当定期险附加险（term insurance rider）覆盖的是主险被保险人以外的其他人（如配偶 Rachel）时，该被保险人必须单独接受核保。

opts.t: Rachel must undergo separate underwriting, while the waiver of premium is required by law to be included free in all life contracts.
opts.w: 错在「定价误解（cost of coverage）」陷阱。完全伤残豁免保费（waiver of premium for total disability）未必免费，在许多合同中它是需要另外付费选购的附约。

opts.t: Rachel must be underwritten herself since the rider insures her, and the quote must show whether the waiver costs extra.
opts.w: 正确。核保阶段（underwriting）的规则是：覆盖被保险人本人的定期险附加险通常沿用主险核保结果，但覆盖配偶或其他人的定期险附加险（term insurance rider）必须对该「其他人（Rachel）」单独核保；同时不能凭名字判断收费方式（cost of coverage），保费豁免可能是另行收费的附约，报价时须逐项核对。

opts.t: A term insurance rider can never cover a spouse under any circumstances, so Rachel must buy her own separate whole life policy.
opts.w: 错在捏造投保禁令。定期险附加险（term insurance rider）或家庭附加险可以覆盖配偶，前提是配偶本人按合同要求单独通过核保。

main.pt: 保费与身故金税务规则
main.trap: 跨险种税务方向记反
main.stem: Hannah is a senior analyst at an engineering firm in Vancouver, BC, earning $110,000 per year. Under her employer's group plan, senior analysts receive basic group life coverage of 2 times annual salary. The annual premium for Hannah's basic group life coverage is $1,200, paid 50% by the employer and 50% by Hannah. Which statement correctly describes the income tax treatment of the premiums and the death benefit?
main.zh: Hannah 是 BC 省温哥华一家工程公司的高级分析师，年薪 $110,000。根据雇主的团体计划，高级分析师享有 2 倍年薪的团体基础寿险保额。Hannah 团体基础寿险的年度总保费为 $1,200，由雇主和 Hannah 各付 50%。下列哪项正确描述了保费与身故保险金的所得税处理？

opts.t: Neither the employer's $600 nor Hannah's $600 is a taxable benefit today, but 50% of the $220,000 death benefit will be taxable if Hannah dies.
opts.w: 错误。落入『跨险种税务方向记反』陷阱：把团体周期性收入替代计划（WLRP）在给付端收税的规则误套到团体寿险上，且错误地按保费比例切分寿险身故金。

opts.t: The employer's $600 is a taxable benefit on Hannah's T4, her own $600 is not deductible, and the $220,000 death benefit is received tax-free.
opts.w: 正确。在团体寿险中，雇主支付的保费（$600）计入员工当年应税收入，构成应税福利（taxable benefit）；员工自付的保费（$600）不可抵扣也不产生应税福利；寿险身故保险金本金（2 倍年薪即 $220,000）不论保费谁付，通常全额免所得税。

opts.t: The employer's $600 contribution is a taxable benefit to Hannah, and she can deduct her own $600 contribution against her employment income.
opts.w: 错误。落入『误以为员工自付保费可抵税』陷阱：员工自付的那部分团体寿险保费不可在个人报税时抵扣（not deductible）。

opts.t: If Hannah elected to pay 100% of the $1,200 premium herself, the death benefit would switch from taxable to tax-free.
opts.w: 错误。落入『员工全额自付才免税』陷阱：团体寿险身故保险金本金原本就免所得税，与谁付保费无关；员工全额自付消除的是保费端的应税福利（taxable benefit），而不是改变身故金本身的免税属性。

main.pt: 离职免核保转换上限与窗口
main.trap: 转换上限当成固定保额或漏看缴付条件
main.stem: Tariq, age 44, is laid off from his accounting job in Burnaby, BC on October 1, which is also the date his $150,000 basic group life coverage terminates. Since developing a heart condition last year, Tariq is uninsurable on the individual market. Under the standard non-Quebec conversion rules tested on the exam, what are Tariq's rights?
main.zh: 44 岁的 Tariq 于 10 月 1 日从 BC 省本拿比的会计岗位被裁员，当日也是他 $150,000 团体基础寿险保障终止之日。由于去年患上心脏病，Tariq 在个人寿险市场上已无法通过核保。根据考试考查的非魁北克省标准转换规则，Tariq 享有什么权利？

opts.t: He can convert the full $150,000 with no medical evidence if the application and first premium arrive within 31 days, priced at his current age.
opts.w: 正确。根据转换权（conversion privilege）及 CLHIA Guideline G3 标准，非魁省地区 65 岁前终止保障的成员可在 31 天内免健康证明转换为个人保单，上限为 $200,000 或原保额中较小者（Tariq 原保额 $150,000 低于 $200,000，故可全额转换），须在窗口内交表并缴清首期保费，新保单保费按当前年龄重新计算。

opts.t: He can automatically increase his converted coverage to $200,000 without medical evidence because $200,000 is the guaranteed minimum conversion amount in BC.
opts.w: 错误。落入『把 $200,000 转换上限当成固定或保底保额』陷阱：$200,000 是免核保转换的上限（取 $200,000 与原保额中较小者），原保额 $150,000 不能借转换权调高到 $200,000。

opts.t: He only needs to notify his employer verbally within 31 days that he intends to convert, and he can keep paying his old subsidized group premium rate.
opts.w: 错误。落入『以为口头决定即可且保费不变』陷阱：必须在 31 天窗口内向保险人递交申请并缴清首期保费（不是只通知意向），且转换后的个人保单按当前年龄定价，通常明显高于原团体保费。

opts.t: Because he developed a heart condition before the layoff, the insurer can require medical underwriting and decline his conversion application.
opts.w: 错误。落入『忽略转换权免核保核心价值』陷阱：转换权（conversion privilege）的本质就是在限定额度与 31 天窗口内无需提供健康证明（no evidence of insurability），保险公司不得因他健康恶化而拒保。

main.pt: 主保单持有人与BC查阅权
main.trap: 主保单查阅权与总合同边界混淆
main.stem: Gavin is an architect in BC who participates in a group life insurance plan sponsored by his professional association. When a dispute arises over how his coverage schedule is defined, Gavin relies on the summary in his benefit booklet, which conflicts with the master contract held by the association. Under the contract rules and BC Insurance Act provisions explained in the lecture, what is the legal position?
main.zh: Gavin 是 BC 省一名建筑师，参加了由其职业协会发起的团体寿险计划。当对保额表的定义产生争议时，Gavin 依据其福利手册中的摘要主张权利，但该摘要与协会持有的总合同存在冲突。根据讲义说明的合同规则及 BC《Insurance Act》条文，法律立场是什么？

opts.t: A professional association cannot legally act as a group plan sponsor because only corporate employers can hold a group master contract.
opts.w: 错误。落入『窄化团体发起人范围』陷阱：除雇主外，职业协会、校友会、商会等具有保险公司认可共同特征的组织均可作为计划发起人（plan sponsor）订立团体主保单。

opts.t: The benefit booklet automatically overrides the master contract in every dispute, and Gavin is himself a signatory party to that master contract.
opts.w: 错误。落入『误以为福利手册就是总合同且会员签了字』陷阱：总合同（master contract）载明实际条款，由计划发起人与保险人签署，福利手册（benefit booklet）只是摘要。

opts.t: The association holds the master contract that sets the actual terms, and BC law lets Gavin obtain a copy of the group policy from the insurer on reasonable notice.
opts.w: 正确。考试口径强调魁省的说明不能被扩写为 BC 没有这项权利：协会作为计划发起人（plan sponsor）持有载明实际条款的总合同（master contract），而依 BC《Insurance Act》s41(5)(b) 及 s41(7)，团体被保险人在给予合理通知后有权向保险人查阅并取得主保单副本，首份副本免费。

opts.t: Outside Quebec, group members have no right to inspect or request a copy of the master policy from the insurer under any circumstances.
opts.w: 错误。落入『将魁省说明反向扩写为 BC 无查阅权』陷阱：BC《Insurance Act》s41(5)(b) 与 s44 明确规定了团体被保险人或索赔人的查阅及取得主保单副本权利（受合理通知、隐私及索赔相关性限制）。

main.pt: 入职资格与逆选择控制
main.trap: 自选追加保额与在职要求过度推定
main.stem: Owen was hired by a BC manufacturing firm on January 2, subject to a standard 3-month probationary period before group life coverage begins on April 2. On April 1, Owen is hospitalized after an accident and remains off work in the hospital through mid-April. Meanwhile, his co-worker Liam, who joined the plan two years ago, now wants to add optional additional life coverage after learning he has high blood pressure, even though the plan's 60-day initial enrolment window closed long ago. Which statement is correct?
main.zh: Owen 于 1 月 2 日被 BC 省一家制造企业录用，需先经过标准的 3 个月试用期，团体寿险保障原定于 4 月 2 日开始。4 月 1 日，Owen 因意外住院，并在 4 月中旬之前一直住院未上班。与此同时，两年前加入计划的同事 Liam 在得知自己患有高血压后，现在想加购自选追加寿险保额，尽管计划规定的 60 天初始申请窗口早已关闭。下列哪项陈述是正确的？

opts.t: Owen's coverage automatically takes effect on April 2 regardless of his hospitalization, and Liam can add optional coverage without medical evidence at any time.
opts.w: 错误。同时忽略了在职要求（actively-at-work requirement）与自选追加保额（optional additional coverage）的限定期核保规则。

opts.t: Owen's start date turns on the contract's actively-at-work rule, and Liam must give evidence of insurability because the 60-day window has closed.
opts.w: 正确。满 3 个月试用期（probationary period）后还须按合同判断是否满足在职要求（actively-at-work requirement）；而为防止健康变差才投保的逆选择（adverse selection），自选追加保额（optional additional coverage）一旦超过限定申请窗口（如 60 天示例）再申请，必须走核保程序。

opts.t: Owen must restart a brand-new 3-month probationary period from the day he leaves the hospital, while Liam is permanently barred from ever applying for optional coverage.
opts.w: 错误。在职要求影响的是保障生效时点而非重新计算整个试用期；错过免核保窗口的会员仍可申请自选追加保额，只是需要接受医疗核保而非终身禁止申请。

opts.t: Group basic life insurance allows each employee to freely choose any coverage amount without limit so that adverse selection is eliminated.
opts.w: 错误。落入『反向理解逆选择机制』陷阱：正因为要防止逆选择（adverse selection），团体基础保额才由计划条款硬性限定，会员对基础保额几乎没有自由选择的自主权。

main.pt: 家属寿险与遗属给付及AD&D
main.trap: 家属险计费与遗属给付概念混淆
main.stem: Victor has $200,000 of basic group life and basic AD&D coverage through his employer in BC. He also participates in the plan's dependant life coverage (which uses a flat family premium rate), voluntary family AD&D (using the exam schedule of 50% for a spouse alone, or 40% spouse / 15% per child when both spouse and children are covered), and optional survivor income benefits. Victor is married to Elena (age 41) and they have three eligible children: a 10-day-old newborn, a 16-year-old high school student, and a 22-year-old full-time university student. Which statement is correct?
main.zh: Victor 通过其在 BC 省的雇主享有 $200,000 的团体基础寿险和基础 AD&D 保障。他还参加了计划的家属寿险（采用统一家庭保费费率）、自选家庭 AD&D（采用考试口径比例表：单独覆盖配偶为 50%，同时覆盖配偶与子女时配偶为 40%、每名子女为 15%）以及自选遗属收入给付。Victor 与 41 岁的 Elena 结婚，育有三名子女：一名出生 10 天的新生儿、一名 16 岁的高中生和一名 22 岁的全日制大学生。下列哪项陈述是正确的？

opts.t: All three children currently qualify as eligible dependants under the exam age rules, and Victor's flat-rate dependant life premium triples because he has three children.
opts.w: 错误。落入『漏看出生 14 天起点』与『家属险按人数加费』两个陷阱：考试口径中受养子女年龄起点为出生满 14 天（10 天新生儿尚未满 14 天），且统一家庭保费（flat family rate）不随合资格子女人数逐个增加。

opts.t: The 16- and 22-year-olds qualify but the 10-day-old does not yet, Elena's AD&D is $80,000, and her survivor income runs monthly to 65, remarriage or death.
opts.w: 正确。按考试口径：受养子女（dependant）从出生 14 天起至 18/19/21 岁，全日制在读可延至 23–25 岁（故 16 岁和 22 岁在读符合，10 天新生儿未满 14 天）；因同时覆盖配偶与合资格子女，配偶 AD&D 按 40% 计算即 $200,000 × 40% = $80,000；遗属收入给付（survivor income benefits）按月发放至配偶满 65 岁、再婚或身故为止。

opts.t: Elena's AD&D coverage is $100,000 (50% of $200,000), and the survivor income benefit is deducted directly from Victor's $200,000 lump-sum death benefit.
opts.w: 错误。落入『AD&D 百分比错配』与『把遗属月给付当成身故金一部分』陷阱：有合资格子女同保时配偶 AD&D 比例降为 40%（$80,000）而非无子女时的 50%（$100,000）；且遗属收入给付（survivor income benefits）是叠加在身故金之外的按月补贴，不从一次性身故金中扣减。

opts.t: The 22-year-old university student is too old to qualify as a dependant, and single employees with no spouse or children are always forced to pay the same dependant life family premium.
opts.w: 错误。全日制在读子女可延长受养资格至 23–25 岁；且实务中须先确认是否有家属及是否选择家庭保障，不能假定无家属的单身员工也必须付同样的家庭保费。

main.pt: 65岁退休转换与高龄保额递减
main.trap: 转换上限当成固定保额或漏看缴付条件
main.stem: Arthur, a quality supervisor at a BC plant with $240,000 of basic group life coverage, is planning to retire on his 65th birthday next month. Under his employer's group schedule of benefits, retirees who stay in a retiree class see their coverage reduce by 50% at age 65 and terminate completely at age 70. Arthur asks his advisor whether he can simply convert the full $240,000 on his 65th birthday without medical evidence or whether he should retire a week early solely to lock in a conversion. How should the advisor handle this situation?
main.zh: Arthur 是 BC 省一家工厂的品控主管，享有 $240,000 的团体基础寿险保额，计划在下个月 65 岁生日当天退休。根据雇主团体保额表，留在退休人员分级的会员其保额在 65 岁时减半，并在 70 岁时完全终止。Arthur 询问顾问，他是否可以在 65 岁生日当天免健康证明直接转换全部 $240,000 保额，或者他是否应该仅仅为了锁定转换权而提前一周退休。顾问应如何处理这一情况？

opts.t: Tell Arthur to immediately change his retirement date to one week before his 65th birthday, because every insurer in Canada prohibits conversion on or after age 65 and pension timing does not matter.
opts.w: 错误。落入『把单一保险须知的 65 岁限制当成全行业统一禁令并盲目建议提前退休』陷阱：退休日涉及养老金和雇佣福利，不能只靠一个保险转换规则就要求客户提前退休。

opts.t: Guarantee that Arthur can convert the entire $240,000 without medical evidence on his 65th birthday, and tell him that group retiree coverage never terminates at age 70.
opts.w: 错误。同时落入『忽略 $200,000 转换上限与 $40,000 缺口』、『忽略 65 岁当天边界差异』以及『忽略高龄保额到 70 岁完全终止』三个陷阱。

opts.t: Tell Arthur that once group coverage reduces by 50% at age 65, the insurer pays out the reduced $120,000 portion as a tax-free cash surrender value.
opts.w: 错误。落入『把团体定期寿险保额递减当成现金价值给付』陷阱：团体基础定期寿险的高龄阶梯递减（schedule of benefits reduction）只是保额下调，不产生任何现金退保价值给付。

opts.t: Confirm in writing whether coverage ending on his 65th birthday still qualifies, compare retiree coverage with the $200,000 cap and its $40,000 gap, and not push early retirement.
opts.w: 正确。考试口径写转换权适用于『65 岁前/时』，而现行部分保险人须知排除保障在 65 岁生日当天或之后终止者；顾问应在退休前取得书面合同条款核实最后工作日、退休日与保障终止日的关系，并列比较退休递减延续（至 70 岁终止）、$200,000 免核保转换上限（注意原保额 $240,000 存在 $40,000 缺口）及其他符合条件的产品，且绝不单凭保险上限要求客户提前退休。

main.pt: 计划终止保费豁免与债权人险
main.trap: 主保单查阅权与总合同边界混淆
main.stem: A BC logistics company decides to replace its group life insurer on July 1 and simultaneously eliminates the membership class for seasonal drivers. Mateo, a full-time warehouse worker, is currently off work on an approved disability waiver of premium under the old group policy. Meanwhile, the company controller asks about the exam cooling-off rule for group creditor insurance (CLHIA Guideline G7) versus individual life insurance (Guideline G10). Which statement is correct?
main.zh: BC 省一家物流公司决定于 7 月 1 日更换其团体寿险承保公司，并同时取消季节性司机这一会籍分级。全职仓库工人 Mateo 目前正根据原团体保单处于已获批的伤残保费豁免期内。与此同时，公司财务主管询问考试口径中关于团体债权人保险（CLHIA Guideline G7）与个人寿险（Guideline G10）冷静期规则的区别。下列哪项陈述是正确的？

opts.t: Mateo's disability waiver of premium is immediately cancelled when the employer switches insurers, and the seasonal drivers simply keep 50% of their old coverage under the new policy.
opts.w: 错误。落入『假定计划变动将已有伤残豁免一笔注销』与『把资格丧失当成保额降低』两个陷阱：已处于伤残保费豁免（waiver of premium）的会员即使雇主终止或更换合同，其豁免与保障仍须持续或核对责任归属；而被取消会籍分级的季节性司机在新计划下是直接失去参保资格，而非保留 50% 保额。

opts.t: Under group creditor insurance, the borrower is the master policyholder and the death benefit is paid to the borrower's spouse rather than applied to the outstanding loan balance.
opts.w: 错误。落入『团体债权人保险当事人与受益方向记反』陷阱：在团体债权人保险（group creditor insurance）中，金融机构为投保人，借款人为会员，身故金即未偿债务余额并用于清偿贷款。

opts.t: Mateo's waiver and coverage are not wiped out by the switch, eliminated-class members lose eligibility and must check conversion, and the exam cites a 20-day G7 refund period.
opts.w: 正确。对于已有伤残保费豁免（waiver of premium）的会员，即使雇主更换承保公司或终止合同，其豁免与保障仍须持续并核对新旧约责任归属；被取消会籍分级（membership class）的成员直接失去新计划资格，应取得通知并比较转换或延续路径；考试口径引用 CLHIA Guideline G7 第 6(d) 项写收到证明后 20 天全额退款（不同于个人寿险 G10 的 10 天冷静期），而现行公开页仅确认 G7 适用范围且法条优先，实务办理须核对当前团体合同。

opts.t: The exam conversion window is uniformly written as 45 days across every chapter of the manual, and replacement contracts always force healthy active employees to complete a new 3-month probationary period.
opts.w: 错误。考试口径内部对转换窗口天数写的是 31 天（两处）与 30 天（一处），并非 45 天；且更换承保公司的新约（replacement contract）旨在确保合资格在职会员不出现保障空窗。

main.pt: 全额退保的ACB与应税保单利得计算
main.trap: 保单利得误套资本利得50%计入率
main.stem: Clara, a resident of Vancouver, purchased an exempt participating whole life policy in 2006 (a G2 policy). She has never taken a policy loan or cash dividend. According to the insurer's records, her cumulative premiums paid total $50,000, the cumulative net cost of pure insurance (NCPI) is $16,000, and the current cash surrender value (CSV) is $64,000. If Clara is in a 30% marginal tax bracket and fully surrenders the policy today, what is her approximate tax payable on this transaction (ignoring AMT and other credits)?
main.zh: 居住在温哥华的Clara于2006年购买了一张免税分红终身寿险保单（G2保单），从未申请过保单贷款或领取现金红利。根据保险公司记录，她累计缴纳保费$50,000，累计纯保险净成本（NCPI）为$16,000，当前现金退保价值（CSV）为$64,000。若Clara当年的边际税率为30%，并在今天全额退保，忽略替代最低税（AMT）及其他抵免，这笔交易大约需缴纳多少税款？

opts.t: $9,000, because the $30,000 policy gain over her $34,000 ACB is 100% included in taxable income.
opts.w: 正确。首先计算调整后成本基础（adjusted cost basis, ACB）＝累计保费$50,000 − 累计纯保险净成本（NCPI）$16,000 ＝ $34,000；其次计算保单利得（policy gain）＝ 处置所得（CSV $64,000）− ACB（$34,000）＝ $30,000；保单利得100%计入应税收入，按30%边际税率估算应纳税额为$30,000 × 30% ＝ $9,000。

opts.t: $4,500, because 50% of the $30,000 gain is included in taxable income as a capital gain.
opts.w: 错误。落入了「保单利得误套资本利得50%计入率」的头号陷阱；寿险退保产生的是保单利得（policy gain），必须100%计入应税收入，不适用资本利得（capital gain）50%计入率。

opts.t: $4,200, because her ACB is equal to the $50,000 cumulative premiums paid, resulting in a $14,000 gain.
opts.w: 错误。误把已缴保费（$50,000）直接当成ACB，漏减了累计纯保险净成本（NCPI $16,000），导致少算应税保单利得。

opts.t: $0, because proceeds from an exempt whole life policy are completely tax-free to the policyowner.
opts.w: 错误。混淆了身故给付（death benefit）与生前退保处置（disposition）；免税保单（exempt policy）仅在持有期间免于按年计提增值，全额退保时超出ACB的部分必须纳税。

main.pt: 保单贷款超ACB计税与利息抵扣条件
main.trap: 保单贷款误判为免税或混淆利息抵扣
main.stem: Liam, a resident of Surrey, holds a G3 universal life policy with a cash surrender value (CSV) of $60,000 and an adjusted cost basis (ACB) of $14,000. He takes a $20,000 policy loan from the insurer to pay for his daughter's wedding reception. What are the tax consequences of this policy loan and the interest he pays on it?
main.zh: 居住在素里的Liam持有一张G3万能寿险保单，现金退保价值（CSV）为$60,000，调整后成本基础（ACB）为$14,000。他向保险公司申请了一笔$20,000的保单贷款，用于支付女儿的婚宴费用。这笔保单贷款及他支付的贷款利息有何税务后果？

opts.t: No taxable policy gain arises because the $20,000 loan is less than the $60,000 CSV, and the interest is non-deductible.
opts.w: 错误。判断保单贷款（policy loan）是否产生应税利得，是比较贷款金额与调整后成本基础（ACB $14,000），而不是与现金退保价值（CSV $60,000）比较。

opts.t: He reports a $6,000 taxable policy gain, his ACB falls to $0, and the interest is not deductible because the money funds personal spending.
opts.w: 正确。保单贷款（policy loan）属于处置（disposition）：贷款$20,000超过ACB $14,000的部分（$6,000）为应税保单利得，100%计入所得，同时ACB降至$0；此外，贷款利息能否抵税取决于借款用途，用于女儿婚宴属个人消费而非赚取应税收入，因此利息不可抵税。

opts.t: He must report a $6,000 taxable policy gain, and the loan interest is tax-deductible because the loan was already taxed as a disposition.
opts.w: 错误。落入了将「贷款本金是否超ACB应税」与「贷款利息能否抵扣」混为一谈的陷阱；这是两件独立的事，用于个人消费的贷款利息绝不因为本金触发了保单利得就变成可抵税。

opts.t: He must report a $3,000 taxable capital gain, his ACB remains $14,000, and the loan interest is non-deductible.
opts.w: 错误。超ACB的$6,000是保单利得（policy gain），须100%计入应税收入而非按50%算作$3,000，且贷款后ACB会降至$0而非保持$14,000不变。

main.pt: 担保转让与绝对转让及非免税单区分
main.trap: 担保转让与绝对转让混同
main.stem: Kevin needs a $50,000 business expansion loan from a commercial lender. The lender requires him to assign his exempt whole life insurance policy (CSV $65,000; ACB $25,000) as collateral security for the loan. How does this collateral assignment affect the taxation of Kevin's life insurance policy?
main.zh: Kevin需要向商业贷款机构申请一笔$50,000的业务扩张贷款。贷款机构要求他将其免税终身寿险保单（CSV $65,000；ACB $25,000）作为贷款的担保物进行担保转让（collateral assignment）。这一担保转让如何影响Kevin寿险保单的税务处理？

opts.t: It triggers an immediate taxable policy gain of $40,000 equal to the CSV minus the ACB.
opts.w: 错误。这是把担保转让（collateral assignment）当成全额退保或非公平交易绝对转让的陷阱；担保转让不触发处置，无须计算CSV减ACB。

opts.t: It triggers a taxable policy gain of $25,000 equal to the $50,000 bank loan minus the $25,000 ACB.
opts.w: 错误。混淆了向银行作担保转让（collateral assignment）与向保险公司申请保单贷款（policy loan）；银行贷款金额与保单ACB之差不产生保单利得。

opts.t: It does not constitute a disposition of the policy, and tax-deferred growth inside the exempt policy continues.
opts.w: 正确。用保单做贷款抵押的担保转让（collateral assignment）在税法上不是保单处置（disposition），只要保单符合免税保单（exempt policy）条件，保内增值继续享受税务递延。

opts.t: It causes the policy to fail the exempt test and become a non-exempt policy subject to annual accrual taxation.
opts.w: 错误。将保单抵押给贷款机构作担保转让并不会影响免税测试（exempt test）或导致保单变为非免税单。

main.pt: 企业寿险CDA计入额与T2054申报
main.trap: CDA免税额误算为全额身故给付
main.stem: Pacific Rim Contracting Ltd., a Canadian-controlled private corporation in Vancouver, owns and is the beneficiary of a $1,000,000 G3 whole life policy on one of its shareholders to fund a buy-sell agreement. When the shareholder dies, the policy's adjusted cost basis (ACB) is $150,000. How are the death benefit receipt by the corporation and the credit to its capital dividend account (CDA) determined?
main.zh: 温哥华的加拿大私人公司Pacific Rim Contracting Ltd.为融资买卖协议，持有一张以其中一名股东为被保险人的$1,000,000 G3终身寿险保单并作为受益人。该股东身故时，保单的调整后成本基础（ACB）为$150,000。公司收到的身故给付以及计入其资本红利账户（CDA）的金额如何确定？

opts.t: The corporation receives $850,000 tax-free, is taxed on the $150,000 ACB portion, and credits $850,000 to its CDA.
opts.w: 错误。身故给付（death benefit）$1,000,000进入公司本身是全额免税的，不会因为存在$150,000的ACB就对公司收款征税；ACB只影响计入CDA的额度。

opts.t: The corporation receives the full $1,000,000 tax-free and credits the entire $1,000,000 to its CDA for automatic tax-free distribution.
opts.w: 错误。落入了「全额身故给付都能进CDA且自动免税分给股东」的双重陷阱：计入CDA的金额必须扣除保单ACB（$150,000），且分配资本红利必须提交Form T2054选择申报。

opts.t: The corporation receives $1,000,000 tax-free, credits $150,000 to its CDA, and must distribute the remaining $850,000 as a taxable dividend.
opts.w: 错误。颠倒了计入CDA与不计入CDA的部分：计入CDA的是「身故给付 − ACB ＝ $850,000」，而不计入CDA的才是等于ACB的$150,000。

opts.t: It receives the full $1,000,000 tax-free, credits $850,000 to its CDA, and must file Form T2054 to pay a tax-free capital dividend.
opts.w: 正确。公司收到$1,000,000身故给付（death benefit）本身全额免税；能计入资本红利账户（capital dividend account, CDA）的部分为「身故给付 − ACB ＝ $1,000,000 − $150,000 ＝ $850,000」；且公司向股东免税分配CDA余额时，必须依ITA s.83(2)在股利应付日或实付日较早者当日或之前提交Form T2054选择申报。

main.pt: 配偶与子女保单生前展期条件及选择退出
main.trap: 配偶/子女展期条件与默认方向颠倒
main.stem: David and his wife Karen are both Canadian residents for tax purposes living in Burnaby. David owns a participating whole life policy with a statutory value and CSV of $70,000 and an ACB of $18,000 (with no policy loans). This year, David has a large deductible business loss from his sole proprietorship and transfers ownership of the policy to Karen for no consideration. How can David structure this transfer for tax purposes?
main.zh: 居住在本拿比的David和妻子Karen均为加拿大税务居民。David名下有一张分红终身寿险保单，法定保单价值与CSV均为$70,000，ACB为$18,000（无保单贷款）。今年David的独资企业有一笔巨额可抵扣营业亏损，他将保单无偿转让给Karen。David在税务上可以如何安排这次转让？

opts.t: The rollover at the $18,000 ACB applies by default, but David can elect out, report a $52,000 gain against his loss, and give Karen a $70,000 ACB.
opts.w: 正确。夫妻双方均为加拿大税务居民时，生前转让默认依ITA s.148(8.1)按ACB（$18,000）自动展期（spousal rollover），当期利得为零；但David可主动申报选择退出（opt out）自动展期，按s.148(7)以$70,000确定处置所得，产生$52,000保单利得来抵消其当年的营业亏损（还须综合测算边际税率与AMT），同时让Karen继承的ACB提高到$70,000。

opts.t: The transfer automatically triggers a $52,000 taxable policy gain unless David files an election to request a spousal rollover at $18,000.
opts.w: 错误。颠倒了默认规则与主动申报的方向：配偶生前展期在满足法定条件时是「默认自动适用」的，只有「选择退出（opt out）」才需要主动申报。

opts.t: David cannot opt out of the spousal rollover during his lifetime, so Karen must inherit the $18,000 ACB.
opts.w: 错误。ITA s.148(8.1)允许转让人主动选择退出配偶自动展期，利用当年亏损吸收保单利得并垫高受让配偶的ACB。

opts.t: If David opts out of the rollover, only 50% of the $52,000 gain ($26,000) is reported as a taxable capital gain.
opts.w: 错误。即使选择退出展期，触发的$52,000也是寿险保单利得（policy gain），必须100%计入应税收入，而非按50%计入。

main.pt: 具名受益人绕开BC遗嘱认证费与遗产规划
main.trap: 未指定具名受益人导致保单赔款进遗产交认证费
main.stem: An elderly resident of Maple Ridge, BC, dies leaving an ordinary life insurance policy with a $300,000 death benefit. Because the policy had no named beneficiary, the proceeds are paid into his estate, which had already exceeded $50,000 in other probatable assets. How does the lack of a named beneficiary affect the BC probate fees on the $300,000 insurance proceeds?
main.zh: 一位居住在BC省枫树岭的长者身故，名下有一张保额$300,000的普通寿险保单。由于保单没有指定具名受益人，这笔赔款进入了其遗产（其名下其他须经遗嘱认证的遗产已超过$50,000）。未指定具名受益人如何影响这$300,000保险赔款的BC省遗嘱认证费？

opts.t: The $300,000 proceeds remain exempt from BC probate fees because all life insurance death benefits bypass probate automatically.
