opts.w: 掉入「虚构转换规则」陷阱。T-100 是需要持续缴费至 100 岁的平准保费产品，不是终身寿险的不丧失利益（non-forfeiture benefit）缴清选项。

variants.pt: 保费抵消演示与双栏披露规则
variants.trap: 保费抵消演示当成合同承诺
variants.stem: When presenting a participating whole life policy illustration to a prospective client today, what disclosure standard must the advisor follow to prevent the misunderstandings seen in the historical 'vanishing premium' era?
variants.zh: 今天向准客户展示分红终身寿险保单演示件（illustration）时，顾问必须遵守什么披露标准，以防止重演历史上「消失保费（vanishing premium）」时代的误解？

opts.t: The illustration must show both guaranteed and non-guaranteed columns side by side, and the client must sign to acknowledge that non-guaranteed values are not promised.
opts.w: 正确。1970–80 年代消失保费丑闻后，监管与行业自律要求保单演示件（illustration）必须同时展示保证栏（guaranteed）与非保证栏（non-guaranteed），且客户必须签字确认已理解非保证部分不是承诺。

opts.t: The advisor may only show the non-guaranteed current dividend scale column as long as the dividend scale interest rate has been stable for three years.
opts.w: 掉入「只报喜不报忧」陷阱。任何时候都不能只展示看起来很美的乐观非保证预测，必须并列展示保证栏与非保证栏。

opts.t: The illustration must guarantee that premium offset will occur within 20 years regardless of future interest rate movements.
opts.w: 掉入「保费抵消演示当成合同承诺」陷阱。保费抵消（premium offset）取决于未来非保证分红表现，严禁在演示中把它说成合同写明的固定停缴年限。

opts.t: The advisor must compare the insurer's dividend scale interest rate directly against competitors' rates to prove which policy builds the highest cash value.
opts.w: 掉入「指标误用」陷阱。分红率（dividend scale interest rate）只是各保司内部精算参数，不是保证回报，也不能直接用来横向判定不同公司的实际现金价值高低。

variants.pt: T-100 产品定位与终身寿险对比
variants.trap: 混淆 T-100 与终身寿险的现金价值弹性
variants.stem: Sonia, age 42, is choosing between a non-participating whole life policy and a Term-100 (T-100) policy to cover a permanent estate need, but she also wants the flexibility to take a policy loan or opt for reduced paid-up insurance if her business cash flow tightens in her 60s. Why is T-100 unsuitable for Sonia?
variants.zh: 42 岁的 Sonia 正在不分红终身寿险和 T-100 保单之间做选择以覆盖一项永久遗产需求，但她同时希望如果 60 多岁时企业现金流吃紧，能够灵活申请保单贷款或选择减额已缴清保险。为什么 T-100 不适合 Sonia？

opts.t: T-100 premiums increase every year after age 60, because they are then based on yearly renewable term mortality rates.
opts.w: 掉入「把 T-100 当 YRT」陷阱。T-100 采用平准保险成本（level cost of insurance）定价，保费从签发起固定不变直到 100 岁交清，不会逐年上涨。

opts.t: T-100 usually builds no cash surrender value, so it offers no policy loan or reduced paid-up option.
opts.w: 正确。T-100 是刻意不做储蓄功能的永久险，早期多收的保费仅用于支撑终身平准费率，不对投保人开放现金退保价值（CSV）、保单贷款（policy loan）或减额已缴清等不丧失利益选项。

opts.t: T-100 requires the insured to pass a new medical underwriting exam every ten years to keep the coverage in force.
opts.w: 掉入「把 T-100 当定期续保」陷阱。T-100 属于永久险类别，不到期、不需要续保核保。

opts.t: T-100 death benefits are restricted to charitable organizations and cannot be paid to any family beneficiaries.
opts.w: 掉入「案例场景绝对化」陷阱。慈善捐赠和资本利得税覆盖只是 T-100 的典型用途，其受益人指定并不限于慈善机构。

variants.pt: T-100 停缴失效与无现金价值后果
variants.trap: T-100 失效套用终身寿险缓冲
variants.stem: Why does a traditional whole life policy have three layers of protection against accidental lapse after the 30-day grace period (APL, reduced paid-up, extended term), whereas a standard Term-100 (T-100) policy lapses outright once the grace period expires?
variants.zh: 为什么传统终身寿险在 30 天宽限期过后还有三道防失效或保底缓冲（APL、减额已缴清、展期定期），而标准 T-100 保单一旦超过宽限期就会直接失效？

opts.t: Whole life builds an accessible cash value that funds APL and non-forfeiture options; a T-100 typically has none.
opts.w: 正确。传统终身寿险的不丧失利益（non-forfeiture benefits）和自动垫缴保费（APL）全部以可动用的现金退保价值（CSV）为资金来源；T-100 通常不建立 CSV，因此宽限期满未缴费即失效（注：考试口径强调 T-100 无 CSV 保底直接终止，BC 实务中普通个人寿险仍须核查《保险法》s.57 的法定复效权）。

opts.t: T-100 is classified by regulators as a short-term renewable contract rather than as permanent life insurance.
opts.w: 掉入「产品分类混淆」陷阱。监管与行业将 T-100 归入永久险（permanent insurance）类别，因为它不到期且无需续保核保，它缺的是 CSV 而非永久险身份。

opts.t: Whole life policies have no 30-day grace period, so insurers provide non-forfeiture options as a substitute.
opts.w: 掉入「宽限期缺失误解」陷阱。普通个人寿险（无论终身寿险还是 T-100）漏缴非首期保费时均有不计到期日的 30 天宽限期（工业保险为 28 天）。

opts.t: T-100 policyholders waive their statutory reinstatement rights when applying in exchange for a lower modal factor.
opts.w: 掉入「法定权利放弃误解」陷阱。投保 T-100 放弃的是现金退保价值（CSV）与不丧失利益这层储蓄弹性，并未放弃法定复效权。

variants.pt: 账户价值不足与保单失效的四类触发情形
variants.trap: YRT前期低价幻觉
variants.stem: Victor holds a universal life policy and decides to pause his premium payments for several years while his accumulating fund is invested in mutual fund-linked accounts. During a prolonged market downturn, what combined mechanism accelerates the depletion of his policy's accumulating fund?
variants.zh: Victor 持有一份万能寿险，在累积账户配置于共同基金联动账户期间决定暂停缴纳保费数年。在持续的市场低迷期，哪项叠加机制会加速消耗他保单的累积账户价值？

opts.t: Pausing premiums immediately triggers a surrender charge equal to 5 to 10 times the annual LCOI deduction, taken from the account value.
opts.w: 混淆了停缴保费与退保：退保费用（surrender charge）仅在保单前 5–10 年正式退保时收取，暂停缴费（只要账户价值足够支付扣费）不会直接触发退保费。

opts.t: The insurer automatically switches his death benefit option to level plus account value whenever a scheduled premium deposit is missed.
opts.w: 无中生有：停缴保费不会自动改变死亡给付方式，保单只是依靠现有累积账户（accumulating fund）余额继续支付每月扣费。

opts.t: Fund losses shrink the account while the net amount at risk stays high, so insurance charges stay high and no new money comes in.
opts.w: 当基金联动账户表现不佳甚至亏损且客户停缴保费时，会同时触发双重不利因素：累积账户（accumulating fund）自身缩水，同时因为账户价值未能压低净风险保额（net amount at risk, NAAR），每月扣除的保险成本（COI）维持在高位，两者叠加会迅速抽干账户价值。

opts.t: Provincial premium tax keeps being deducted every month from the accumulating fund, even during the years when no premiums are paid.
opts.w: 错记了保费税（premium tax）的征收时点：保费税仅在客户实际缴入保费时按整笔保费扣除，停缴期间没有新保费进入，不会按月从账户余额中扣保费税。

variants.pt: 免税测试上限与2017年前旧单代次风险
variants.trap: 老客户增额免核保误区
variants.stem: Noah wants to deposit a large lump sum into his universal life policy to maximize tax-sheltered growth, but the insurer notifies him that the deposit would push the accumulating fund above the maximum funded threshold on the policy anniversary. Why does this statutory ceiling exist, and how is an excess handled?
variants.zh: Noah 想向其万能寿险存入一大笔资金以最大化免税增值，但保险公司通知他，这笔存款会使累积账户在保单周年日超过最高缴费上限。为什么会存在这一法定上限，且超额部分通常如何处理？

opts.t: The ceiling lets the insurer collect higher surrender charges in the first 5 to 10 years, and any excess deposit is forfeited to its reserves.
opts.w: 混淆了免税测试与退保费用（surrender charge）：最高缴费上限源于税法对免税储蓄空间的限制，超额款项绝不会被保司直接没收。

opts.t: It stops the policy being used mainly as a tax shelter; the excess may be refused, refunded or moved to a taxable side account.
opts.w: 最高缴费（maximum funded）受免税测试（exemption test）约束，目的是划分保障功能与超额投资功能，防止万能寿险沦为纯免税储蓄账户。每个保单周年日比对假想基准保单后，对超额部分保险人可能拒收、退款或按合同转入保单外应税侧基金，否则保单可能永久丧失免税身份。

opts.t: The ceiling protects the policyholder from negative returns in daily interest accounts, and any excess raises the face amount without underwriting.
opts.w: 错误有二：免税测试（exemption test）保护的是政府税基而非客户的投资回报，且增加保额通常需要核保，不能假定超额存款一律自动免核保增额。

opts.t: The ceiling applies only to level cost of insurance, so Noah could avoid the exemption test entirely by switching his policy to YRT costing.
opts.w: 错误有二：一是通常不允许从 LCOI 转回 YRT；二是无论采用 YRT 还是 LCOI，所有享受免税增值的万能寿险都必须遵守免税测试（exemption test）上限。

variants.pt: YRT与LCOI成本曲线及持有期限匹配
variants.trap: YRT前期低价幻觉
variants.stem: Liam needs universal life insurance mainly for a 10- to 15-year business obligation and wants as much of his early premium deposits as possible to enter the accumulating fund to build medium-term cash value, while keeping the option to lock in level rates later if his need becomes permanent. Which cost of insurance structure fits his plan?
variants.zh: Liam 购买万能寿险主要是为了覆盖一项 10–15 年的商业责任，他希望前期缴入的保费尽可能多地进入累积账户以快速积累中短期现金价值，同时保留未来若需求变为终身时锁定平准费率的可能。哪种保险成本结构符合他的计划？

opts.t: YRT costing, since low early charges leave more money to grow over 10 to 15 years, and some contracts allow a later switch to LCOI.
opts.w: 逐年更新定期成本（yearly renewable term costing, YRT）在早期按较年轻的当年年龄定价，扣费很低，能让更多保费进入累积账户（accumulating fund）实现短中期（10–15 年）更快增长；同时考试口径说明部分保单允许未来从 YRT 按转换当时年龄重新定价转为平准保险成本（LCOI）（实务中需核查具体合同的转换窗口与年龄上限）。

opts.t: Level cost of insurance, because its higher initial deductions build a faster accumulating fund balance during the first 10 to 15 years than YRT.
opts.w: 因果颠倒：LCOI 早期扣费显著高于 YRT，挤占了进入投资账户的资金，因此在短中期（10–15 年）内现金价值积累速度比 YRT 更慢。

opts.t: Level cost of insurance for the first 10 years, followed by a mandatory switch to YRT costing once the accumulating fund reaches $120,000.
opts.w: 转换方向错误：合同规则一般只允许从 YRT 单向转为 LCOI，不允许从 LCOI 转回 YRT。

opts.t: YRT costing, because YRT locks in the issue-age mortality rate, so a later switch to LCOI is priced at his original age rather than attained age.
opts.w: 混淆了转换重定价年龄：从 YRT 申请转为 LCOI 时，是按转换当时的实际年龄（attained age）重新定价，而非沿用最初投保时的年龄。

variants.pt: 平额与平额加账户价值对NAAR和扣费的影响
variants.trap: NAAR与给付方式倒置
variants.stem: Elena wants a universal life policy where every dollar of investment growth in her accumulating fund directly reduces the insurer's mortality exposure so that her ongoing insurance deductions stay as low as possible during her lifetime. Which death benefit option accomplishes this goal?
variants.zh: Elena 希望购买一份万能寿险，使其累积账户中每一块钱的投资增长都能直接降低保险公司的死亡风险敞口，从而让她在世期间的持续保险扣费尽可能压到最低。哪种死亡给付方式能实现这一目标？

opts.t: Level death benefit plus account value, because adding the account value to the payout rewards the policyholder with discounted mortality rates.
opts.w: 落入「NAAR与给付方式倒置」陷阱：平额加账户价值（level death benefit plus account value）下净风险保额（NAAR）不会随账户增长而下降，扣费反而更高。

opts.t: Level death benefit, because as the accumulating fund grows, the net amount at risk decreases dollar for dollar, lowering the basis on which cost of insurance is calculated.
opts.w: 在平额死亡给付（level death benefit）下，受益人只拿固定保额，累积账户（accumulating fund）每增长一元的直接效果就是等额压低净风险保额（net amount at risk, NAAR），从而降低每期保险成本（COI）扣费，最适合希望在世时把保费成本压到最低的客户。

opts.t: Either option works identically, because the virtuous circle depends only on choosing a guaranteed investment account (GIA) rather than the death benefit structure.
opts.w: 混淆了投资账户选择与死亡给付方式：良性循环能否通过压低 NAAR 减少扣费，首先取决于死亡给付方式是不是平额型（level death benefit）。

opts.t: Neither option reduces the net amount at risk until the policyholder reaches age 90 and the cost of insurance is fully paid up.
opts.w: 张冠李戴：只要选择平额死亡给付（level death benefit），从保单首年起任何账户价值增长都会即时降低当期净风险保额（NAAR），无需等到 90 岁。

variants.pt: 投资账户分类、保底规则与退保费用机制
variants.trap: YRT前期低价幻觉
variants.stem: Anxious about financial institution failures, a client asks his advisor whether the accumulating fund inside his universal life policy is protected if the life insurance company becomes insolvent, and how that topic is treated in the licensing exam manual.
variants.zh: 一位对金融机构倒闭感到担忧的客户询问顾问：如果人寿保险公司破产，他万能寿险里的累积账户价值是否受到保障，以及牌照考试资料是如何处理这一话题的？

opts.t: Assuris protects policyholders' death benefits and cash values up to set limits if an insurer fails, though the exam manual never mentions it.
opts.w: 在加拿大实务中，Assuris 作为人寿与健康保险公司的破产保障组织，为保单持有人的死亡给付和现金价值提供一定上限内的保障；但考试资料全书没有提及 Assuris，顾问在柜台面对客户提问时不能回答「保司绝不会倒闭」，而应准确说明 Assuris 机制的存在。

opts.t: Because the accounts are unbundled, the accumulating fund is covered by bank deposit insurance rather than by an insurance industry protection plan.
opts.w: 混淆了监管与保障体系：即便保证利率投资账户（GIA）机制类似银行 GIC，万能寿险依然属于人寿保险合同，受保险业 Assuris 机制保障，而非银行存款保险。

opts.t: The exam manual states that life insurers are legally immune from insolvency, so no protection organization for policyholders exists in Canada.
opts.w: 违背事实与执业规范：任何保险公司都存在理论上的偿付能力风险，加拿大设有 Assuris 提供破产保障，顾问绝不能向客户宣称「保司依法不会倒闭」。

opts.t: Insolvency protection applies only if the policyholder chose level cost of insurance and made no partial withdrawals in the first 5 to 10 years.
opts.w: 凭空捏造限制条件：破产保障机制覆盖合格保单的死亡给付和现金价值，不以选择 LCOI 或未曾提款为前提。

variants.pt: 保单贷款、担保转让与保费抵消的机制差异
variants.trap: 杠杆化与担保转让混淆
variants.stem: After twenty years of funding her universal life policy, Maya has built a substantial accumulating fund and wishes to stop paying out-of-pocket premiums while keeping her insurance coverage in force without triggering a taxable withdrawal. Which contractual right allows her to do this, and what condition must hold?
variants.zh: 在为万能寿险缴费二十年后，Maya 已经积累了可观的账户价值，她希望停止自掏腰包缴纳保费，同时维持保单保障有效且不触发应税提款。哪项合同权利允许她这样做，且必须满足什么条件？

opts.t: Partial withdrawal, which lets her take out 50% to 90% of the cash value tax-free each year and send it back to the insurer as premium.
opts.w: 混淆了部分提取、保单贷款比例与保费抵消：部分提取（partial withdrawal）视为部分退保，可能产生应税所得；50%–90% 是保单贷款（policy loan）的额度比例。

opts.t: Premium offset, letting the account pay ongoing insurance and admin charges, as long as its value stays enough to cover them.
opts.w: 保费抵消（premium offset）是累积账户六项权利之一：当账户价值积累到一定程度后，保单持有人可以停缴保费，靠账户自身留存价值及回报覆盖未来的保险成本（COI）与管理费，前提是账户价值始终足以支付每月扣费，否则保单仍可能失效。

opts.t: Collateral assignment, which obliges the insurer to waive all future cost of insurance deductions until the insured reaches age 100.
opts.w: 概念张冠李戴：担保转让（collateral assignment）是用保单向第三方银行抵押借款，与停缴保费由账户自付扣费的保费抵消（premium offset）毫无关系。

opts.t: Leveraging, which permanently locks in a 0% cost of insurance charge so that the policy can never lapse whatever the investment returns.
opts.w: 混淆了杠杆化（leveraging）与保费抵消：杠杆化是向银行抵押连续借款用于退休现金流，既不能免除保单内部的 COI 扣费，更不能消除投资不佳导致保单失效或银行追偿的风险。

variants.pt: 万能寿险无按期系数（modal factor）规则
variants.trap: 期缴溢价假定陷阱
variants.stem: An advisor is reviewing four statements about how universal life insurance operates compared with traditional bundled permanent policies. Which statement is free from common exam misconceptions?
variants.zh: 一位顾问正在审阅四条关于万能寿险与传统捆绑型永久寿险运作差异的陈述。哪一条陈述没有落入常见的考试误区？

opts.t: Switching from annual to quarterly deposits in a universal life policy raises the total yearly outlay, because the insurer applies a modal factor.
opts.w: 落入「期缴溢价假定陷阱」：万能寿险没有按期系数（modal factor），季缴年化总额与年缴完全一致。

opts.t: Unlike bundled whole life, UL has no modal factor, and its mortality charge is based on the net amount at risk, not the face amount alone.
opts.w: 准确概括了两大核心防坑要点：第一，万能寿险没有按期系数（modal factor），分期缴纳年化总额与年缴相同；第二，每期死亡风险扣费（COI）是基于净风险保额（net amount at risk, NAAR ＝ 身故给付 − 账户价值）与适用费率计算，而非简单等同于身故给付本身。

opts.t: Choosing the level death benefit plus account value option creates a virtuous circle that lowers the net amount at risk as the account grows.
opts.w: 落入「NAAR与给付方式倒置」陷阱：只有平额死亡给付（level death benefit）才会随账户价值增长压低净风险保额（NAAR），平额加账户价值下 NAAR 恒等于固定保额。

opts.t: Failing the annual exemption test automatically ends the policy's death benefit coverage on that policy anniversary, with no chance to correct it.
opts.w: 落入范围误判陷阱：免税测试（exemption test）限制的是免税多存钱的空间，失去免税资格影响的是整张保单的税务待遇，并不等于身故保障自动终止。

variants.pt: 加速身故金扣减身故金与独立重疾对比
variants.trap: 预支与另付混淆（产品混淆）
variants.stem: Arthur owns a $50,000 whole life insurance policy that includes a terminal illness (TI) accelerated death benefit allowing an advance of 50% of the face amount ($25,000). After Arthur's physician certifies that his life expectancy falls within the policy's stipulated terminal period, Arthur applies for and receives the $25,000 TI benefit. When Arthur passes away later, what happens to the remaining death benefit?
variants.zh: Arthur 持有一份面额为 $50,000 的终身寿险保单，其中包含一项绝症给付（TI）加速身故金条款，允许预支面额的 50%（即 $25,000）。在医生证明 Arthur 的预期寿命已进入保单规定的绝症期限后，Arthur 申请并领取了 $25,000 绝症给付。当 Arthur 去世时，剩余的身故金会如何处理？

opts.t: The beneficiary receives the full $50,000 because a terminal illness benefit is paid in addition to the face amount.
opts.w: 错在「预支与另付混淆（产品混淆）」陷阱。绝症给付（terminal illness, TI benefit）属于加速身故金（accelerated death benefit），机制是把将来才兑现的身故金提前搬到现在用，而不是额外多给一笔。

opts.t: The policy terminates immediately upon payment of the $25,000 TI benefit, leaving nothing for the beneficiary.
opts.w: 错在误以为领取部分预支金会导致整张保单作废。绝症给付（TI benefit）只预支了 50%（$25,000），保单剩余的身故保额依然有效并留待身故时赔付。

opts.t: The beneficiary receives $10,000 because exercising the TI benefit incurs a 30% administrative penalty.
opts.w: 错在编造行政罚金规则。绝症给付（TI benefit）按实际预支的 $25,000 从 $50,000 面额中等额扣减，不会额外扣除所谓 30% 罚金。

opts.t: The beneficiary receives $25,000, because the $25,000 TI advance is deducted directly from the $50,000 death benefit.
opts.w: 正确。绝症给付（terminal illness, TI benefit）是加速身故金（accelerated death benefit）的一种，付给投保人本人的 $25,000 属于预支款项，被保险人身故时最终赔付给受益人的身故金须等额扣减至 $25,000。

variants.pt: 投保人≠被保险人时的豁免条款选择
variants.trap: 豁免对象张冠李戴（条款错配）
variants.stem: Grace purchases a permanent life insurance policy on the life of her 8-year-old daughter, Chloe, and attaches a standard waiver of premium for total disability benefit instead of a parent/payor waiver benefit. Three years later, Grace suffers a severe illness and becomes totally disabled for more than 6 months, while Chloe remains in perfect health. How will the insurer handle the premiums on Chloe's policy?
variants.zh: Grace 为她 8 岁的女儿 Chloe 购买了一份永久寿险保单，并附加了普通的完全伤残豁免保费条款，而不是父母/代付人豁免条款。三年后，Grace 患上重病并完全伤残超过 6 个月，而 Chloe 依然非常健康。保险公司会如何处理 Chloe 保单的保费？

opts.t: It will not waive them, because a standard waiver responds only to the life insured (Chloe) becoming disabled, not the payor.
opts.w: 正确。这是典型的「豁免对象张冠李戴（条款错配）」案例：普通完全伤残豁免保费（waiver of premium for total disability）针对的是被保险人（Chloe）的伤残；因为投保人/代付人（Grace）未配置父母/代付人豁免（parent/payor waiver benefit），Grace 伤残时保费不会被豁免。

opts.t: It will waive the premiums until Chloe reaches age 21, because Grace is the legal policyholder and the person paying the premiums.
opts.w: 错在「豁免对象张冠李戴（条款错配）」陷阱。不能仅凭所有权关系（ownership）推断豁免对象；只有配置了父母/代付人豁免（parent/payor waiver benefit），才会在代付人伤残时豁免保费至子女达到约定年龄（如 18/21/25 岁）。

opts.t: It will waive half of the premiums, since Grace has already satisfied the 6-month waiting period that the waiver requires.
opts.w: 错在编造折中赔付规则。条款触发对象错配时，即使代付人伤残满 6 个月等待期（waiting period），也不满足被保险人伤残的合同条件，保司一分钱保费都不会豁免。

opts.t: It will automatically convert the standard waiver into a payor waiver retroactively once Grace submits her medical proof.
opts.w: 错在违背核保与合同原则。父母/代付人豁免（parent/payor waiver benefit）要求投保时对代付人本人核保，出险后不可能事后追溯更改合同条款。

variants.pt: 子女附加险起保期、固定保费与转换权
variants.trap: 子女附加险转换窗口与计费误解
variants.stem: Owen adds a $10,000 child coverage rider to his whole life policy. His daughter, Zoe, develops an incurable autoimmune condition at age 8. When Zoe is 22 years old—before the rider's expiry at age 25—Owen exercises the rider's conversion privilege with an insurer that permits maximum conversion up to 5 times the rider's face amount, requesting $50,000 of permanent coverage for Zoe. How will the insurer process this conversion?
variants.zh: Owen 在他的终身寿险保单上附加了一份 $10,000 的子女附加险。他的女儿 Zoe 在 8 岁时患上了无法治愈的自身免疫性疾病。当 Zoe 22 岁时（在该附加险 25 岁到期前），Owen 向允许最高转换至原附约保额 5 倍的保险公司行使转换权，为 Zoe 申请 $50,000 的永久寿险保障。保险公司将如何处理这项转换申请？

opts.t: Decline the application because Zoe became medically uninsurable at age 8, long before the conversion request.
opts.w: 错在忽略了子女附加险转换权（converting child coverage rider）锁住可保性的核心功能。只要在附加险到期前行使，即使孩子在 8 岁已实质不可保，保险公司也必须免核保承保。

opts.t: Approve only the original $10,000 without underwriting and require full medical evidence for any increase up to the $50,000 maximum.
opts.w: 错在记混了免核保放大额度。既然该保司合同允许转换保额放大至原附加险保额的 5 倍（5 times the rider face amount），那么 $10,000 × 5 = $50,000 全额都在免核保转换范围内，只有超出 5 倍以上的额外部分才需常规核保。

opts.t: Issue the $50,000 individual permanent policy without medical underwriting, charging standard rates based on Zoe's age of 22 at conversion.
opts.w: 正确。根据子女附加险转换权（converting child coverage rider）规则，在到期前（25 岁前）行使转换可免核保转为个人永久险，且在该保司允许的 5 倍额度（$50,000）内无需健康证明，保费按转换时年龄（22 岁）的标准费率计算，不因疾病加费。

opts.t: Issue the $50,000 individual permanent policy without medical underwriting, but apply a 25% substandard health rating due to her condition.
opts.w: 错在以为免核保转换仍可按次标准体加费。子女附加险转换权（converting child coverage rider）承诺按转换时年龄的标准费率（standard rates）定价，不得因健康恶化额外加费。

variants.pt: 保证可保利益（GIB）的行权与定价
variants.trap: GIB把免核保当免费或随时加保（术语与双口径误读）
variants.stem: Sonia, a young professional with a limited budget today but rising income potential, buys a life policy with a guaranteed insurability benefit (GIB). Her contract is a modern version that allows exercising the GIB either on fixed policy anniversaries or upon designated life events such as marriage or childbirth. When Sonia gets married, she wants to add coverage under her GIB without a medical exam. What procedural deadline and pricing rule must Sonia follow under this contract?
variants.zh: Sonia 是一位目前预算有限但未来收入增长潜力较大的年轻职场人士，她购买了一份附带保证可保利益（GIB）的寿险保单。她的合同属于现代新式条款，允许在固定保单周年日或指定人生事件（如结婚或生子）发生时行使 GIB。当 Sonia 结婚时，她希望利用 GIB 免体检加保。在这份合同下，Sonia 必须遵守怎样的申请时限和定价规则？

opts.t: She can submit the application at any time within 1 year of her marriage, and the new premium is locked in at her original issue age.
opts.w: 错在混淆了意外身故（AD）的 1 年限期与 GIB 的申请时限，且掉入「术语误读」陷阱。新式保证可保利益（GIB）虽然放宽了触发条件，但申请时限严格限制在 31 天内，且保费按加保时年龄计算。

opts.t: Her advisor must apply within 31 days of the marriage, and the added coverage is priced at her attained age at that time.
opts.w: 正确。虽然实务中此类新式保证可保利益（guaranteed insurability benefit, GIB）将触发条件从固定周年日放宽到包含毕业、结婚、生子、收养等人生事件（注：考场通用题仍按固定周年日作答），但申请时限并未放宽，须在事件发生后或对应周年日后 31 天内由代理人提交，且新保额按行权当时的实际年龄定价。

opts.t: She must wait 15 days after the marriage, and then receives the added coverage free, with no increase in her monthly premium.
opts.w: 错在把子女附加险的新生儿 15 天起保期套用到 GIB 上，且误以为 GIB 加保不需要交新保费（术语误读）。

opts.t: Her advisor must submit the application within 30 days, and Sonia must pass a simplified medical questionnaire to qualify.
opts.w: 错在记混了重疾给付（DD）的 30 天存活期与 GIB 的 31 天提交期，且违背了保证可保利益（GIB）免除健康证明（no medical evidence required）的核心机制。

variants.pt: 定期险附加险覆盖阶段需求与依附性
variants.trap: 附加险当独立保单（类别错配）
variants.stem: Five years ago, Brenda bought a whole life base policy to cover final expenses and attached a 10-year term insurance rider to cover a business debt. This year, Brenda decides to let the whole life base policy lapse because she finds the permanent premiums too high, assuming she can keep paying only the lower premium for the remaining 5 years of the term insurance rider. Is Brenda's assumption correct?
variants.zh: 五年前，Brenda 购买了一份终身寿险主险来覆盖身后最终费用，并附加了一份 10 年期定期险附加险来覆盖一笔生意债务。今年，Brenda 觉得永久险保费太高，决定让终身寿险主险失效，并以为自己可以在剩下的 5 年里只继续缴纳较低的定期险附加险保费。Brenda 的想法正确吗？

opts.t: Yes, because the 10-year term rider has its own 10-year term and can stand on its own once it has been issued with the base policy.
opts.w: 错在「附加险当独立保单（类别错配）」陷阱。虽然定期险附加险（term insurance rider）有自己的 10 年期限，但它不是独立保单，不能脱离主险单独存在。

opts.t: Yes, provided she separately pays the $50–$100 annual policy administration fee for the rider once the base policy has lapsed.
opts.w: 错在「附加险当独立保单（类别错配）」陷阱。附加险的依附性是合同结构决定的，主险失效后无法靠补交 $50–$100 的保单年费（policy fee）让附加险单独存续。

opts.t: No, because a term rider depends on the base policy and ends automatically if the base policy lapses or is surrendered.
opts.w: 正确。定期险附加险（term insurance rider）的核心限制就是依附性（dependency）：附加险用失去独立性换取捆绑低价，一旦主险因未交费而失效（lapse）或被退保（surrender），挂在主险上的定期险附加险会同时失效。

opts.t: No, unless she converts the term rider into an accidental death rider within 30 days of the lapse of the base whole life policy.
opts.w: 错在捏造转换规则。定期险附加险（term insurance rider）不能转换为什么意外身故附加险（AD rider）来规避主险失效的后果。

variants.pt: 意外身故附加险理赔条件与需求分析
variants.trap: 靠意外双倍赔付凑基础保额（范围夸大与以偏概全）
variants.stem: Julian owns a $25,000 life insurance policy with an accidental death (AD) rider that provides double indemnity (2 times the face amount) if death results from an accident within 1 year of the event. Julian is injured in a car crash while fleeing the scene of a bank robbery he committed, and he dies from his injuries 10 days later. How much will the insurer pay under the AD rider, and why?
variants.zh: Julian 持有一份 $25,000 的寿险保单，并附带一份意外身故（AD）附加险，约定若在事故发生后 1 年内因意外导致身故可获双倍赔付（2 倍保额）。Julian 在实施银行抢劫后驾车逃逸途中发生车祸受伤，并于 10 天后伤重不治身亡。保险公司在 AD 附加险项下会赔付多少，为什么？

opts.t: An extra $25,000, because a car crash is an accident and Julian died well within the 1-year time limit set by the rider.
opts.w: 错在忽略了意外身故附加险（accidental death, AD rider）的合同除外条款（limitations and exclusions）。虽然死亡发生在 1 年限期内，但因犯罪行为导致的事故属于明确除外情形。

opts.t: An extra $10,000, because criminal activity reduces the double indemnity benefit by 50% instead of cancelling it outright.
opts.w: 错在编造按比例扣减规则。一旦触发除外责任（exclusions），意外身故附加险（AD rider）直接拒赔，不存在部分折算赔付。

opts.t: Nothing under either the base policy or the AD rider, because dying in a car crash within 15 days voids the entire contract.
opts.w: 错在把子女附加险的新生儿 15 天起保等待期生搬硬套到成人车祸理赔上，混淆了不同附加条款的规则。

opts.t: Nothing under the AD rider, because AD riders exclude deaths caused by criminal acts, as well as suicide and war.
opts.w: 正确。意外身故附加险（accidental death, AD rider）在合同订立时就将自杀、自伤、战争以及犯罪行为（criminal acts）列为明确除外情形（limitations and exclusions）；Julian 在实施犯罪逃逸时发生车祸身亡，即使在 1 年限期内，AD 附加险也不予赔付。

variants.pt: 第三人附加险单独核保与收费方式区分
variants.trap: 误以为买主险就自动免核保保配偶及豁免必免费
variants.stem: While reviewing two life insurance quotes, Paula notices that Policy X includes a terminal illness (TI) benefit at no extra itemized fee, whereas Policy Y lists a waiver of premium benefit with a separate monthly charge. Paula asks her advisor whether all supplementary benefits are supposed to be free simply because they are called "benefits" rather than "riders". What is the correct explanation?
variants.zh: 在比较两份寿险报价单时，Paula 注意到保单 X 包含一项不额外单列收费的绝症给付（TI），而保单 Y 则将保费豁免列为一项单独按月收费的条款。Paula 询问顾问，是不是所有被称为「补充保障（benefits）」而不是「附加险（riders）」的条款都应该是免费的。正确的解释是什么？

opts.t: Yes, any feature called a supplementary benefit is free by law, so Policy Y is overcharging her for the waiver of premium benefit.
opts.w: 错在「定价误解（cost of coverage）」陷阱。不能按「附加险（rider）」或「补充保障（supplementary benefit）」的名称来判断收费方式。

opts.t: No, whether a feature is built in or charged separately depends on the contract, not its label, so each item should be broken out.
opts.w: 正确。不能凭「rider / supplementary benefit」的名称判断收费方式（cost of coverage）：某些绝症给付（TI benefit）内建在基础合同里（成本已计入主险保费），而保费豁免（waiver of premium）常作为另外付费选购的附约；顾问报价时应将基础保费、每项附约费用及内建权益逐一对应说明。

opts.t: Yes, terminal illness benefits and premium waivers are always free, while only accidental death riders ever carry an extra cost.
opts.w: 错在「定价误解」陷阱。保费豁免（waiver of premium）在多数公开产品指南中属于可选付费保障，并非一律免费。

opts.t: No, built-in benefits such as Policy X's terminal illness benefit each require a separate $50–$100 annual policy fee from the client.
opts.w: 错在混淆了保单年费（annual policy fee，$50–$100）与内建保障成本。内建免费附加保障的成本已经包含在主险保费中，不会按每个内建条款重复收取保单管理年费。

variants.pt: 保费与身故金税务规则
variants.trap: 跨险种税务方向记反
variants.stem: Lucas works for a software company in Kelowna, BC where the group life insurance plan requires employees to pay 100% of the basic life premiums ($540 per year for $150,000 of coverage), while the employer pays 100% of the group disability income plan premiums. How are Lucas's group life premiums and group life death benefit treated for tax purposes?
variants.zh: Lucas 在 BC 省基洛纳一家软件公司工作，该公司的团体寿险计划要求员工 100% 自付基础寿险保费（$150,000 保额每年保费 $540），而雇主 100% 支付团体伤残收入计划的保费。Lucas 的团体寿险保费和团体寿险身故金在税务上如何处理？

opts.t: Lucas's $540 group life premium is tax-deductible because he pays the entire cost himself, and the $150,000 death benefit is tax-free.
opts.w: 错误。落入『员工全额自付即可抵税』陷阱：员工自付的团体寿险保费不可抵扣，仅是不产生应税福利（taxable benefit）。

opts.t: Lucas's $540 payment creates a $540 taxable benefit on his T4, and the $150,000 death benefit is taxable because the employer funds the disability plan.
opts.w: 错误。落入『跨险种税务混淆』陷阱：员工自己付的保费不会产生应税福利，雇主为伤残计划付保费也绝不会使团体寿险身故金变成应税。

opts.t: His $540 is neither deductible nor a taxable benefit, and the $150,000 death benefit is tax-free, just as if the employer had paid it.
opts.w: 正确。员工全额自付团体寿险保费时，该保费不可抵扣且不产生应税福利（taxable benefit）；寿险身故保险金本金（$150,000）无论由雇主还是员工付保费，通常均全额免所得税。

opts.t: Only half of the $150,000 death benefit is tax-free because the employer and employee split the overall benefit package costs across the two plans.
opts.w: 错误。落入『按比例切分寿险身故金』陷阱：寿险身故保险金本金通常全额免税，不会按福利包分摊比例切分征税。

variants.pt: 离职免核保转换上限与窗口
variants.trap: 转换上限当成固定保额或漏看缴付条件
variants.stem: Sonia, age 52, resigns from her executive role in Surrey, BC on March 15, terminating her $320,000 basic group life coverage. She has diabetes and wants to convert as much coverage as possible without providing medical evidence under the standard non-Quebec CLHIA Guideline G3 rules. What is the maximum she can convert without medical evidence, and by what deadline must she submit the application and first premium?
variants.zh: 52 岁的 Sonia 于 3 月 15 日辞去 BC 省素里的高管职务，其 $320,000 的团体基础寿险保障随之终止。她患有糖尿病，希望根据非魁省 CLHIA Guideline G3 标准规则，在不提供健康证明的情况下尽可能多地转换保额。她免健康证明最多能转换多少保额，且必须在什么期限内提交申请并缴纳首期保费？

opts.t: $320,000 within 60 days of March 15.
opts.w: 错误。落入『超上限转换』与『窗口天数混淆』陷阱：免健康证明转换不能超过 $200,000 上限，且标准转换窗口为 31 天而非 60 天。

opts.t: $400,000 within 31 days of March 15.
opts.w: 错误。落入『错用魁北克省上限』陷阱：$400,000 是魁省转换上限，BC 省等非魁省地区的免核保转换上限为 $200,000 且不得超过原保额。

opts.t: $200,000 within 31 days of March 15, with only the application form required during the 31 days and the first premium payable within 90 days.
opts.w: 错误。落入『漏看窗口内缴清首期保费条件』陷阱：必须在 31 天窗口内同时完成申请与首期保费缴纳。

opts.t: $200,000 within 31 days of March 15, with both the application and the first modal premium received within that 31-day window.
opts.w: 正确。Sonia 原保额 $320,000 高于非魁省免核保转换上限 $200,000，因此按转换权（conversion privilege）规则取较小者即最多免核保转换 $200,000，且申请与首期保费均须在 31 天窗口内送达。

variants.pt: 主保单持有人与BC查阅权
variants.trap: 主保单查阅权与总合同边界混淆
variants.stem: Lin is the designated beneficiary and claimant under her late husband's group life insurance policy in BC. The insurer denies part of the claim based on a clause in the master contract that was not printed in full in the employee benefit booklet. Lin requests a copy of the relevant master policy provisions from the insurer for the first time. How does BC law treat her request?
variants.zh: Lin 是她已故丈夫在 BC 省团体寿险保单下的指定受益人和索赔人。保险公司依据总合同中某项未在员工福利手册中完整印出的条款拒绝了部分理赔。Lin 首次向保险公司请求提供相关主保单条款的副本。BC 法律如何处理她的请求？

opts.t: As a claimant she may, on reasonable notice, inspect and copy the policy information relevant to the claim or denial, with the first copy free.
opts.w: 正确。考试口径提及魁省成文规则，但 BC《Insurance Act》s41(5)(b) 明确规定团体被保险人或合同索赔人（claimant）在合理通知后可向保险人查阅并取得团体主保单（master contract）副本，s41(7) 规定首份免费，s41(9) 将索赔人查阅范围限于与索赔或拒赔有关的信息。

opts.t: She has no right to obtain any part of the master contract because only the employer as policyholder can communicate with the insurer.
opts.w: 错误。落入『误以为非投保人无任何法定查阅权』陷阱：BC《Insurance Act》直接赋予团体被保险人及合同索赔人向保险人请求查阅和取得副本的法定权利。

opts.t: She is entitled to obtain the confidential medical records of all other employees in the group plan along with the master policy.
opts.w: 错误。忽略了 BC《Insurance Act》s41(8) 与 s41(9) 的限制：法条保护他人隐私，且将索赔人的查阅范围限定在与该索赔或拒赔有关的信息。

opts.t: The benefit booklet is legally the only binding contract in BC, so the master policy does not exist as a separate document.
opts.w: 错误。落入『把福利手册当成总合同』陷阱：福利手册（benefit booklet）只是摘要，总合同（master contract）才是发起人与保险人订立的主保单原件。

variants.pt: 入职资格与逆选择控制
variants.trap: 自选追加保额与在职要求过度推定
variants.stem: Why do group life insurance plans strictly limit basic coverage amounts by a schedule of benefits (such as 1x or 2x salary) and restrict non-medical optional coverage to a short initial window (such as 60 days)?
variants.zh: 为什么团体寿险计划通过保额表（如 1 倍或 2 倍年薪）硬性限定基础保额，并将免健康证明的自选追加保额限制在一个很短的初始窗口（如 60 天）内？

opts.t: To control adverse selection: if members could pick high amounts or wait until their health declines, group pricing would break down.
opts.w: 正确。团体基础保障免核保是依靠大数法则（law of large numbers）与团体整体特征定价；若允许会员自由选择高保额或拖到限定窗口（如 60 天）之后健康变差才免核保加购，逆选择（adverse selection）就会破坏精算平衡。

opts.t: To comply with the all-source maximum offset rule, which caps group life death benefits at a share of the member's pre-disability net income.
opts.w: 错误。落入『跨险种概念混用』陷阱：全来源上限（all-source maximum）是团体伤残险特有的抵消条款，团体寿险身故金无此限制。

opts.t: Because BC provincial premium tax increases from 2% to 9% whenever an employee selects coverage after 60 days.
opts.w: 错误。捏造税率规则：BC 省持牌保险人保费税固定为 2%，9% 是考试口径表格中魁北克省的销售税率。

opts.t: Because group members are legally prohibited from owning any individual life insurance while covered under an employer group plan.
opts.w: 错误。团体计划硬性限定保额是为了控制团体内部的逆选择（adverse selection），并不禁止员工在个人市场上另行核保购买个人寿险。

variants.pt: 家属寿险与遗属给付及AD&D
variants.trap: 家属险计费与遗属给付概念混淆
variants.stem: Grace has $150,000 of basic group life and voluntary family AD&D coverage under her employer's plan, which uses the exam AD&D percentages (50% for spouse only; 40% for spouse and 15% per child when both are covered). Grace has a spouse and no children. She also purchased optional survivor income benefits. If Grace dies in an illness, what happens to the survivor income benefit for her 45-year-old spouse, and what is her spouse's own AD&D coverage amount while Grace is alive?
variants.zh: Grace 在雇主计划下享有 $150,000 的团体基础寿险和自选家庭 AD&D 保障，该计划采用考试口径的 AD&D 百分比（仅覆盖配偶时为 50%；同时覆盖配偶与子女时配偶为 40%、每名子女为 15%）。Grace 有配偶但无子女，且购买了自选遗属收入给付。如果 Grace 因病身故，她 45 岁配偶的遗属收入给付如何发放，且在 Grace 在世期间她配偶本人的 AD&D 保额是多少？

opts.t: Her spouse receives a monthly survivor income benefit until age 65, remarriage, or death, and the spouse's AD&D coverage amount while Grace is alive is $75,000.
opts.w: 正确。遗属收入给付（survivor income benefits）是叠加在一次性身故金之外按月给付的补贴，配偶给付至 65 岁、再婚或身故为止；因 Grace 仅有配偶而无子女，配偶的家属 AD&D 按 50% 计算，即 $150,000 × 50% = $75,000。

opts.t: Her spouse receives a single lump-sum survivor income payment on top of the death benefit, and the spouse's AD&D coverage amount is $60,000.
opts.w: 错误。遗属收入给付（survivor income benefits）是按月发放而非一次性给付；且无子女时配偶 AD&D 比例为 50%（$75,000）而非有子女时的 40%（$60,000）。

opts.t: No survivor income benefit is payable because Grace died of an illness rather than an accident, and the spouse's AD&D coverage is $75,000.
opts.w: 错误。遗属收入给付（survivor income benefits）是团体寿险下的附加给付，并非仅限意外身故才赔付。

opts.t: Her spouse receives monthly survivor income payments for life even if the spouse remarries, and the spouse's AD&D coverage is $22,500.
opts.w: 错误。配偶的遗属收入给付在满 65 岁、再婚或身故时即停止，不会在再婚后继续终身发放；15%（$22,500）是每名子女的 AD&D 比例而非配偶比例。

variants.pt: 65岁退休转换与高龄保额递减
variants.trap: 转换上限当成固定保额或漏看缴付条件
variants.stem: Evelyn is reviewing her employer's group life insurance schedule of benefits in BC. She currently has $220,000 of basic coverage at age 64. The schedule states that active coverage reduces by 50% on a member's 65th birthday and reduces to zero at age 70. Regarding the exam conversion rule ('before or at age 65' up to $200,000) and real-world contract verification, which statement is accurate?
variants.zh: Evelyn 正在审阅其 BC 省雇主的团体寿险保额表。她目前 64 岁，享有 $220,000 的基础保额。保额表规定，保障在会员 65 岁生日时减少 50%，并在 70 岁时归零。关于考试口径转换规则（『65 岁前/时』最高 $200,000）以及实务合同核对，下列哪项陈述是准确的？

opts.t: Group life coverage for retirees must legally continue unchanged for life and can never terminate at age 70.
opts.w: 错误。落入『忽略高龄保额递减与终止规则』陷阱：退休或高龄会员的团体保额几乎都会递减，并通常在特定年龄（如考试口径举例的 70 岁）完全终止。

opts.t: On the exam the privilege covers up to $200,000 before or at 65; in practice some insurers exclude coverage ending on the 65th birthday, so check the contract.
opts.w: 正确。双口径对比：考场若未给特殊合同细节，按考试口径『65 岁前/时』及最高 $200,000 免核保转换上限（conversion privilege）作答；而实务中部分公司须知排除 65 岁生日当天或之后终止者，且 $220,000 原保额超过 $200,000 上限的部分（$20,000 缺口）需另行核对安排。

opts.t: When her coverage reduces from $220,000 to $110,000 at age 65, the insurer automatically pays her $110,000 in cash as a living benefit.
opts.w: 错误。高龄保额阶梯递减（schedule of benefits reduction）是保障额度的下调，团体定期寿险没有现金价值或递减现金给付。

opts.t: Even if her group contract allows conversion, she can convert $220,000 without medical evidence because the $200,000 limit does not apply to members over age 60.
opts.w: 错误。非魁省免健康证明转换上限为 $200,000 或原保额中较小者，并不会对 60 岁以上会员取消 $200,000 上限。

variants.pt: 计划终止保费豁免与债权人险
variants.trap: 主保单查阅权与总合同边界混淆
variants.stem: Paul takes out a business loan through a lending institution in BC and enrols in the lender's group creditor life insurance plan. At the same time, his sister Rosa is on an approved disability waiver of premium under her employer's group life plan when her employer terminates the master contract. According to the lecture's rules on group creditor insurance and waiver of premium on plan termination, which statement is accurate?
variants.zh: Paul 通过 BC 省一家贷款机构办理了一笔商业贷款，并加入了该贷款机构的团体债权人寿险计划。与此同时，他的姐姐 Rosa 在雇主终止团体寿险总合同时，正处于已获批的伤残保费豁免期内。根据讲义关于团体债权人保险及计划终止时保费豁免的规则，下列哪项陈述是准确的？

opts.t: The lender is the policyholder and the benefit equals the unpaid loan balance, and Rosa's approved waiver and coverage continue despite the termination.
opts.w: 正确。团体债权人保险（group creditor insurance）以金融机构为投保人、借款人为会员，身故金即未偿债务余额；考试口径引用 CLHIA Guideline G7 写收到证明后 20 天全额退款（现行公开页仅确认适用范围，实务须核对当前团体合同）；而处于伤残保费豁免（waiver of premium）的会员即使雇主终止合同，豁免与保障仍须持续。

opts.t: Paul is the master policyholder of the group creditor contract, and Rosa loses her group life coverage the midnight her employer cancels the master policy.
opts.w: 错误。团体债权人保险的投保人是金融机构而非借款人 Paul；且已获批伤残保费豁免（waiver of premium）的会员不会因雇主终止主保单而立即失去保障。

opts.t: Group creditor insurance death benefits remain level even as the loan is paid down, paying the excess to Paul's estate, and Guideline G7 is the 10-day individual life cooling-off rule.
opts.w: 错误。团体债权人保险的身故金等于未偿债务余额（随贷款偿还而递减）；且 10 天冷静期是个人寿险的 Guideline G10，不要与债权人团体险的 G7 混用。

opts.t: Rosa must pay back all previously waived premiums to the insurer when her employer terminates the group plan.
opts.w: 错误。伤残保费豁免（waiver of premium）无需会员在计划终止时补缴以往豁免的保费，且其保障与豁免责任仍须依条款持续。

variants.pt: 全额退保的ACB与应税保单利得计算
variants.trap: 保单利得误套资本利得50%计入率
variants.stem: Owen owns an exempt whole life policy acquired in 2008 with no prior loans or dividends. He has paid $32,000 in cumulative premiums, the insurer's cumulative NCPI is $9,000, and the current CSV is $38,000. If Owen is in a 40% marginal tax bracket and surrenders the entire policy today, what is his approximate tax liability from the surrender?
variants.zh: Owen持有一张2008年购入的免税终身寿险保单，无过往贷款或红利领取。他累计缴纳保费$32,000，保险公司累计NCPI为$9,000，当前CSV为$38,000。若Owen处于40%边际税率档并在今天全额退保，因退保产生的大约税负是多少？

opts.t: $2,400, using cumulative premiums of $32,000 as the ACB.
opts.w: 错误。未从累计保费$32,000中扣除累计纯保险净成本（NCPI $9,000），误将ACB算作$32,000。

opts.t: $3,000, applying a 50% capital gains inclusion rate to the $15,000 policy gain.
opts.w: 错误。误将保单利得（policy gain）当作资本利得按50%计入应税收入；保单利得必须100%计入。

opts.t: $6,000, based on a 100% inclusion of the $15,000 policy gain over the $23,000 ACB.
$7,600, applying a 50% capital gains inclusion rate to the entire $38,000 CSV.
opts.w: 错误。既没有扣除ACB（$23,000），又错误套用了50%的资本利得计入率。

variants.pt: 保单贷款超ACB计税与利息抵扣条件
variants.trap: 保单贷款误判为免税或混淆利息抵扣
variants.stem: Hannah owns an exempt whole life policy with a CSV of $48,000 and an ACB of $19,000. She takes a $15,000 policy loan from the insurer (not used to pay premiums on the policy) and invests the entire $15,000 in a rental condo that generates taxable rental income, with the insurer verifying the interest paid on Form T2210. What is the tax result?
variants.zh: Hannah持有一张免税终身寿险保单，CSV为$48,000，ACB为$19,000。她向保险公司申请$15,000保单贷款（非用于缴纳本单保费），并将全部$15,000投入一套产生应税租金收入的出租公寓，且保险公司在T2210表上核实了当年已付利息且未计入ACB。税务后果是什么？

opts.t: She has no taxable policy gain, her ACB is reduced to $4,000, and the policy loan interest is deductible against her taxable income.
opts.w: 正确。虽然保单贷款（policy loan）属于处置，但贷款金额$15,000 ≤ ACB $19,000，因此当期无应税保单利得，ACB等额减少至$19,000 − $15,000 ＝ $4,000；同时借款用于产生应税租金收入且经T2210核实，贷款利息可按规则抵税。

opts.t: She must report a $15,000 taxable policy gain because all policy loans are fully taxable dispositions.
opts.w: 错误。保单贷款虽属处置，但在贷款金额不超过ACB（$15,000 ≤ $19,000）时仅扣减ACB，不产生应税保单利得。

opts.t: She has no taxable policy gain and her ACB stays at $19,000, because borrowing below ACB is not a disposition.
opts.w: 错误。无应税利得不等于未发生处置；贷款金额在ACB以内时仍属处置，必须把ACB从$19,000扣减至$4,000。

opts.t: She has no taxable policy gain, her ACB is reduced to $4,000, but interest on a policy loan is never tax-deductible.
opts.w: 错误。保单贷款用于赚取应税投资收入（如租金或股息，而非仅资本利得）且由保险人在T2210核实已付利息未计入ACB时，利息可以抵税。

variants.pt: 担保转让与绝对转让及非免税单区分
variants.trap: 担保转让与绝对转让混同
variants.stem: Instead of using his policy as collateral for a bank loan, Kevin transfers full legal ownership of his exempt life policy (CSV $65,000; ACB $25,000) to an unrelated business partner in an arm's-length sale for $65,000 cash. How is this absolute assignment treated for tax purposes?
variants.zh: Kevin没有将保单用作银行贷款抵押，而是以$65,000现金的公平交易价格，将其免税寿险保单（CSV $65,000；ACB $25,000）的全部法定所有权绝对转让（absolute assignment）给一名无关联的商业合伙人。这一绝对转让在税务上如何处理？

opts.t: It is treated the same as a collateral assignment, resulting in no taxable disposition.
opts.w: 错误。绝对转让（absolute assignment）转移了保单所有权，与仅作抵押的担保转让（collateral assignment）完全不同，会立即触发保单处置。

opts.t: It is a taxable disposition generating a $40,000 policy gain, 100% of which is included in Kevin's taxable income.
opts.w: 正确。按公平交易向独立第三方绝对转让（absolute assignment）保单属于处置（disposition），处置所得为实际对价$65,000，减去转让前ACB $25,000后产生$40,000保单利得（policy gain），100%计入应税收入。

opts.t: It qualifies for an automatic tax-free rollover at the $25,000 ACB because it is transferred to a business partner.
opts.w: 错误。生前按ACB自动展期（rollover）仅适用于符合条件的配偶/同居伴侣或直接过户给子女，无关联商业合伙人之间不适用展期。

opts.t: It generates a $40,000 capital gain, of which $20,000 is included in Kevin's taxable income.
opts.w: 错误。转让寿险保单产生的正差额属于保单利得（policy gain），须100%计入应税收入，不能套用资本利得50%计入率。

variants.pt: 企业寿险CDA计入额与T2054申报
variants.trap: CDA免税额误算为全额身故给付
variants.stem: Cascade Engineering Inc., a private Canadian corporation, owns a $600,000 term life insurance policy on its key shareholder. Despite having no cash surrender value, the term policy still has an insurer-reported ACB of $18,000 when the shareholder dies. How much is added to Cascade Engineering's capital dividend account (CDA) from this life insurance payout?
variants.zh: 加拿大私人公司Cascade Engineering Inc.持有一张保额$600,000的关键股东定期寿险保单。尽管定期险没有现金退保价值，但该股东身故时保险公司出具的保单ACB仍为$18,000。这笔寿险赔款能为Cascade Engineering的资本红利账户（CDA）增加多少额度？

opts.t: $600,000, because term life insurance policies have no cash surrender value and therefore always credit 100% of the death benefit to the CDA.
opts.w: 错误。讲义明确提醒：定期险（term insurance）没有现金退保价值，不等于它的ACB必定为零；只要保险人出具的实际ACB非零（$18,000），计算CDA增加额时就必须扣除。

opts.t: $582,000, calculated as the $600,000 death benefit minus the $18,000 ACB reported by the insurer.
opts.w: 正确。无论终身险还是定期险，计入资本红利账户（CDA）的金额均为身故给付减去保险人出具的实际ACB，即$600,000 − $18,000 ＝ $582,000。

opts.t: $291,000, because only 50% of the net insurance proceeds over ACB can enter the CDA.
opts.w: 错误。把寿险赔款计入CDA的规则与资本利得50%免税部分计入CDA的规则混为一谈；寿险身故给付超出ACB的差额是100%（$582,000）计入CDA。

opts.t: $0, because term life policies do not qualify for the capital dividend account mechanism.
opts.w: 错误。公司持有的定期寿险身故给付同样适用CDA机制，超出ACB的$582,000照常计入CDA。

variants.pt: 配偶与子女保单生前展期条件及选择退出
variants.trap: 配偶/子女展期条件与默认方向颠倒
variants.stem: Grace owns a whole life policy insuring the life of her 10-year-old son, Leo, with a CSV of $30,000 and an ACB of $12,000. She wants to transfer the policy for no consideration so that it qualifies for the tax-free intergenerational rollover to a child under ITA s.148(8). Which transfer method satisfies the rollover rule?
variants.zh: Grace持有一张以其10岁儿子Leo为被保险人的终身寿险保单，CSV为$30,000，ACB为$12,000。她希望无偿转让该保单并享受ITA s.148(8)下转给子女的免税按ACB展期规则。以下哪种转让方式符合该展期规定？

opts.t: Transferring ownership of the policy to an irrevocable family trust established exclusively for Leo.
opts.w: 错误。讲义第七节第6条明确强调：无偿转让给子女的展期，必须直接过户给子女本人，转入信托（trust）不适用s.148(8)展期规则。

opts.t: Transferring ownership of the policy to Leo's legal guardian to hold as trustee until Leo turns 19.
opts.w: 错误。转给监护人以受托人（trustee）身份代持同样不满足「直接过户给子女本人」的法定条件，无法享受s.148(8)按ACB展期。

opts.t: Selling the policy to Leo's adult sister for $30,000 fair market value consideration.
opts.w: 错误。s.148(8)子女展期要求是「无对价（for no consideration）」的生前转让，有偿出售（for consideration）不适用免税按ACB展期。

opts.t: Transferring it for no consideration directly to Leo, or to his adult sister, who is also Grace's child.
opts.w: 正确。依 ITA s.148(8)，非年金保单的被保险人是转让人（或受让人）的子女，且无对价直接过户给子女本人时，可按 ACB（$12,000）展期；Leo 本人或同为 Grace 子女的姐姐都可作受让人。

variants.pt: 具名受益人绕开BC遗嘱认证费与遗产规划
variants.trap: 未指定具名受益人导致保单赔款进遗产交认证费
variants.stem: Before passing away in Maple Ridge, BC, the same senior updated his $300,000 ordinary life insurance policy to name his niece directly as the revocable beneficiary. How are the $300,000 death benefit proceeds treated at his death?
variants.zh: 在BC省枫树岭去世前，这位长者更新了其$300,000普通寿险保单，将自己的侄女直接指定为可撤销具名受益人。他身故时这$300,000身故给付如何处理？

opts.t: The $300,000 is paid outside the estate directly to his niece, avoiding BC probate fees and received tax-free as a death benefit.
opts.w: 正确。明确指定具名受益人（named beneficiary，哪怕是侄女）后，身故给付（death benefit）通常在遗产之外直接支付给有效受益人，既绕开BC省遗嘱认证程序免交遗嘱认证费（probate fee），本金也不计入受益人的应税所得。

opts.t: Only an irrevocable spouse or child beneficiary bypasses probate, so naming a niece still triggers $4,200 in BC probate fees.
opts.w: 错误。绕开遗嘱认证程序只需要有有效的具名受益人（如案例三中的侄女），并不要求受益人必须是不可撤销或必须是配偶/子女。

opts.t: The $300,000 bypasses BC probate fees, but the niece must include 50% of the payout in her taxable income because she is not a spouse.
opts.w: 错误。普通免税寿险的身故给付（death benefit）本金对任何具名受益人均免征所得税，不因受益人是侄女而非配偶就征税。

opts.t: The $300,000 bypasses proportional probate fees, but the niece must pay the flat BC Supreme Court probate filing fee of $208 ($200 current) to claim the policy.
opts.w: 错误。具名受益人直接向保险公司申请理赔，无需向法院申请遗嘱认证，因此既不交按比例的认证费，也不交法院遗嘱认证提交费（考试口径印$208，2026现行法为$200）。

variants.pt: LCGE合格资产与考试双口径数字
variants.trap: 误把普通经营合伙权益当成LCGE合格资产或混用年度数字
variants.stem: In 2026, Fiona disposes of qualified farm and fishing partnership property and also surrenders a personal universal life policy at a gain. Under current 2026 federal tax rules described in the lecture, how do the capital gains inclusion rate, the 2026 LCGE limit, and the policy gain rule apply?
variants.zh: 2026年，Fiona处置了合格家族农渔业合伙财产，同时退保了一张个人万能寿险保单并产生利得。根据讲义所述的2026年现行联邦税法规则，资本利得计入率、2026年LCGE上限以及保单利得规则分别如何适用？

opts.t: The farm or fishing partnership can use the $1,275,000 LCGE, the general inclusion rate is 50%, and the policy gain is fully taxable with no LCGE.
opts.w: 正确。符合定义的家族农渔业合伙权益可属合格农渔业财产，2026年现行LCGE上限为$1,275,000（考试口径2022年QSBC上限为$913,630）；现行ITA s.38(a)一般资本利得计入率仍为50%；而寿险保单利得（policy gain）须100%计入应税收入且不可用LCGE抵消。

opts.t: No partnership interest of any kind can ever qualify for the LCGE, and both the property gain and the policy gain are included at the 50% rate.
opts.w: 错误。虽然普通经营合伙权益通常不合格，但符合定义的家族农场或渔业合伙权益属于合格农渔业财产；且保单利得是100%计入而非50%。

opts.t: The 2026 LCGE limit is still $1,250,000, and the policy gain can also be sheltered by the LCGE because it is a gain on property.
opts.w: 错误。$1,250,000 是 2025 年数值，不可直接沿用到 2026 年（2026 列为 $1,275,000）；寿险保单利得是保单利得而非资本利得，不能用 LCGE 抵消。

opts.t: The capital gains inclusion rate has risen to two-thirds for 2026, and the policy gain is likewise included at two-thirds.
opts.w: 错误。2024年提出的提高计入率至2/3方案已于2025年3月撤销，现行ITA s.38(a)资本利得一般计入率仍为50%，且保单利得始终是100%计入。

variants.pt: 随时可催收贷款与担保转让扣除
variants.trap: 随时可催收贷款到期前安全
variants.stem: Cedar Ridge Millwork Ltd. has a $450,000 commercial demand loan from a restricted financial institution to finance factory equipment. As a condition of the loan, the lender required the company to collaterally assign an existing $900,000 key person life insurance policy on its operations director. How does this collateral assignment affect the company's liquidity risk and tax deductions?
variants.zh: Cedar Ridge 木业有限公司从一家受限金融机构获得了一笔 $450,000 的商业随时可催收贷款用于购置工厂设备。作为贷款条件，贷方要求公司将其运营总监名下一份现有的 $900,000 关键人寿险保单进行担保转让。这项担保转让对公司的流动性风险和税务扣除有何影响？

opts.t: The collateral assignment converts the policy into a taxable absolute transfer, and the lender must wait until the end of the equipment's depreciation schedule before demanding repayment.
opts.w: 错误。担保转让（collateral assignment）不是绝对转让，不触发处置；且随时可催收贷款（demand loan）不受设备折旧年限束缚。

opts.t: The company can deduct 100% of the policy's cash surrender value growth each year because the lender holds a security interest in the policy.
opts.w: 错误。符合豁免条件（exempt）的保单内现金价值增长继续递延纳税，并非作为费用扣除项目。

opts.t: The lender may still call the loan under its terms if the director dies, and the company may deduct the part of the lesser of premium and NCPI tied to the $450,000 loan.
opts.w: 正确。随时可催收贷款（demand loan）在关键人身故时可能被贷方按约催收从而引发流动性危机；满足 ITA s.20(1)(e.2) 的担保转让（collateral assignment）可在保费与 NCPI 较小者中扣除合理对应贷款额（$450,000 / $900,000）的部分。

opts.t: The company can deduct the entire annual premium paid on the $900,000 policy as long as the loan balance remains above zero.
opts.w: 错误。不能因为存在贷款就扣除全部保费，必须在保费与 NCPI 较小者中按贷款占保额的合理对应比例计算扣除。

variants.pt: LCGE双口径计算与资格核验
variants.trap: LCGE资格与双口径混淆
variants.stem: Three cousins are reviewing whether their respective business holdings can utilize the lifetime capital gains exemption (LCGE) upon disposition: Liam holds an interest in an ordinary retail clothing partnership; Noah holds an interest in a qualified family fishing partnership under ITA s.110.6; and Maya holds shares in a CCPC whose assets consist almost entirely of passive stock market investments. Which of them may qualify for the LCGE?
variants.zh: 三位表兄妹正在核查各自持有的企业权益在处置时能否适用终身资本利得豁免（LCGE）：Liam 持有普通服装零售合伙企业的合伙权益；Noah 持有符合 ITA s.110.6 定义的家族渔业合伙企业权益；Maya 持有一家资产几乎全部为被动股市投资的 CCPC 股份。他们中谁可能符合 LCGE 适用资格？

opts.t: Noah only, since a qualified family fishing partnership can qualify, while ordinary partnerships and passive-asset CCPCs failing QSBC tests cannot.
opts.w: 正确。终身资本利得豁免（LCGE）不能只看“公司”或“合伙”标签：普通经营合伙权益通常不适用，但符合 ITA s.110.6 定义的家族农渔业合伙权益则可能适用；而 CCPC 身份本身不足以证明股份符合合格小企业公司股份（QSBC）资格。

opts.t: Maya only, because any corporation registered as a CCPC automatically qualifies for the LCGE regardless of how its assets are invested.
opts.w: 错误。误中“只看公司标签”陷阱：CCPC 身份本身不足以证明股份为合格小企业公司股份（QSBC），必须核验具体资产资格。

opts.t: Liam and Noah only, because all partnership interests in Canada are eligible for the LCGE while corporate shares are excluded.
opts.w: 错误。普通经营合伙权益（如零售服装合伙）通常不适用 LCGE，只有符合定义的家族农渔业合伙权益才是不能遗漏的例外。

opts.t: All three cousins qualify, because the LCGE applies universally to any privately held business interest in Canada.
opts.w: 错误。LCGE 须严格核查 QSBC 股份或合格农渔业财产定义，并非所有私人商业权益都适用。

variants.pt: 交叉持有与公司赎回的成本基础差异
variants.trap: 持股比例相同等于机制与税务相同
variants.stem: Two equal shareholders, Devon and Claire, funded their buy-sell agreement using the corporate share redemption method rather than a cross-purchase structure. After Devon died, the corporation received the insurance proceeds and redeemed and cancelled Devon's shares for $900,000. Five years later, Claire sells 100% of the company to an outside buyer. What is the primary disadvantage Claire now faces compared to having used a cross-purchase agreement?
variants.zh: 两名等额股东 Devon 和 Claire 采用公司股份赎回法而非交叉购买结构为买卖协议提供资金。Devon 身故后，公司收到保险赔款并以 $900,000 赎回并注销了 Devon 的股份。五年后，Claire 将公司 100% 股权出售给外部买家。与当初采用交叉购买协议相比，Claire 现在面临的主要劣势是什么？

opts.t: She must repay the $900,000 life insurance death benefit to the insurer because the corporation cancelled Devon's shares.
opts.w: 错误。保险赔款是因被保险人身故合法给付的，注销股份是公司赎回法的正常法律动作，无须退还保司。

opts.t: She got no step-up in the ACB of her shares when Devon's shares were redeemed, so her capital gain on the later sale is larger.
opts.w: 正确。公司赎回法（corporate redemption / share redemption）相对交叉持有的核心税务劣势，就是幸存股东没有亲自掏钱买股，因而拿不到成本基础提升（step-up in basis），原有股份 ACB 不变，日后出售公司时计算出的资本利得更高。

opts.t: She still only owns 50% of the voting rights in the corporation because cancelled shares remain held by Devon's estate.
opts.w: 错误。公司赎回并注销亡故股东股份后，总股数减少，幸存股东 Claire 的持股比例同样上升至 100%。

opts.t: The life insurance death benefit received by the corporation upon Devon's death was fully taxable as active business income.
opts.w: 错误。公司作为受益人收到的寿险身故给付同样是全额免税进入公司账户的。

variants.pt: 多股东保单数量与混合法机制
variants.trap: 多人交叉持有保单膨胀与结构错配
variants.stem: A specialty bakery in Richmond was originally owned by two partners who used a cross-purchase buy-sell agreement funded by two criss-cross policies. After expanding, they admitted a third equal partner. If they continue using a personal cross-purchase structure versus switching to corporate-owned policies, how does the required number of individual policies compare?
variants.zh: 列治文一家特色烘焙坊最初由两名合伙人共同经营，采用两张交叉互保保单为交叉购买买卖协议提供资金。扩张后，他们引入了第三位等额合伙股东。如果他们继续沿用个人交叉持有结构，与改为公司统一持有保单相比，所需的独立保单数量分别是多少？

opts.t: Continuing with cross-purchase requires 3 policies in total, while switching to corporate ownership requires 6 policies.
opts.w: 错误。把两种结构的保单数量算反了：三人互相投保需要 6 张，公司统一持有只需 3 张。

opts.t: Cross-purchase would need 6 policies, each partner insuring the other two, while corporate ownership needs only 3, one on each partner.
opts.w: 正确。三名股东采用交叉持有（cross-purchase）互相为对方投保时，每人需为另外两人各买一张，共需 3 × 2 = 6 张保单；而改为公司统一持有（corporate-owned）只需为每位股东各投保一张，共 3 张保单。

opts.t: Both structures require 3 policies, because the new partner simply joins the existing two policies as a contingent beneficiary.
opts.w: 错误。交叉持有要求每位股东对其他每位股东分别持有保单，不能靠简单添加顺位受益人解决三方互保问题。

opts.t: Continuing with cross-purchase requires 9 policies, while corporate ownership requires 1 individual policy covering all three lives separately.
opts.w: 错误。三人交叉互保是 6 张（3 × 2）而非 9 张，公司持有通常是每位股东各一张（共 3 张）。

variants.pt: 公司保单身故金与CDA计入规则
variants.trap: 免税身故金全额进 CDA
variants.stem: A corporate client tells his insurance agent: 'If my corporation buys a term life policy instead of a permanent policy to fund our buy-sell agreement, 100% of the death benefit is guaranteed to go into the capital dividend account (CDA) because term insurance has no cash surrender value (CSV).' How should the agent evaluate this statement?
variants.zh: 一位企业主客户对他的保险代理人说：“如果我的公司买定期寿险而不是永久寿险来为买卖协议提供资金，那么 100% 的身故给付都保证能进资本红利账户（CDA），因为定期险没有现金退保价值（CSV）。”代理人应当如何评估这一说法？

opts.t: The client is wrong; term coverage usually has no CSV but can still carry a non-zero ACB, and any actual ACB reduces the CDA credit.
opts.w: 正确。定期险（term insurance）虽然通常没有现金退保价值（CSV），但仍可能有非零的调整后成本基础（ACB）；无论是定期险还是永久险，都必须用实际 ACB 数据计算，只有超出 ACB 的身故金部分才能增加 CDA，不能把“无 CSV”当成全额进 CDA 的保证。

opts.t: The client is correct; because term policies never accumulate CSV, their ACB is permanently fixed at zero throughout the entire policy term.
opts.w: 错误。误以为没有 CSV 就一定没有 ACB：定期险在特定期间（如保费高于 NCPI 的年份）仍可能产生非零 ACB。

opts.t: The client is incorrect; proceeds from term life insurance policies are ineligible for the CDA and can only be paid out as taxable dividends.
opts.w: 错误。定期寿险的身故给付同样适用 CDA 规则，超出其实际 ACB 的部分完全可以计入 CDA。

opts.t: The client is correct, provided the corporation deducts the annual term life premiums as an operating expense on its tax return.
opts.w: 错误。用于买卖协议融资的公司寿险保费不可作为营业费用抵扣，且定期险也并非保证 100% 进 CDA。

variants.pt: 关键人保额核保与三种估算法
variants.trap: 保额凭空高报或简单取平均值
variants.stem: An agent is helping a construction company estimate the key person insurance amount needed for its lead project manager. The agent calculates the recruiter headhunting fee, the double-salary cost during the new hire's training period, and the outstanding balance of a commercial demand loan tied directly to the manager's personal guarantee. Which valuation approach is the agent applying, and who will own and be the beneficiary of this key person policy?
variants.zh: 一名代理人正在协助一家建筑公司估算其首席项目经理所需的关键人保险保额。代理人将猎头招聘费、新人培训期间的双薪成本，以及与该经理个人担保直接挂钩的商业随时可催收贷款余额直接加总。代理人运用的是哪种估算思路？这份关键人保单应由谁持有并作为受益人？

opts.t: The profit contribution method; the project manager owns the policy and names the construction company's bank as the irrevocable beneficiary.
opts.w: 错误。加总猎头培训成本与相关贷款余额属于替代与债务保障法，而非利润贡献法；且关键人保单由企业持有。

opts.t: The replacement and debt protection method; the company owns the policy and is its beneficiary, so the tax-free proceeds offset these losses.
opts.w: 正确。将招聘猎头费、新人培训期双薪成本以及个人担保的随时可催收贷款余额直接加总，属于替代与债务保障法；关键人保险（key person insurance）由企业持有并作受益人，免税身故金直接进入企业账户以弥补损失。

opts.t: The income multiple method; the project manager's spouse owns the policy and receives the tax-free death benefit.
opts.w: 错误。这不是按年薪倍数计算的收入倍数法，且由配偶持有并受益的是个人家庭寿险，而非企业关键人保险。

opts.t: The split-dollar valuation method; the other employees of the construction company jointly own the policy as a cross-purchase group.
opts.w: 错误。分成保单（split-dollar）是福利安排而非关键人保额估算方法，关键人保险也不由其他普通员工交叉持有。

variants.pt: 分成保单安排与小企业税率差
variants.trap: 分成保单保费分摊与小企业税率误区
variants.stem: Horizon Tech Inc. sets up a split-dollar permanent life insurance arrangement with its chief software architect. How are the policy rights and premium payments structured under this type of arrangement?
variants.zh: Horizon 科技有限公司与其首席软件架构师建立了一份分成保单（split-dollar）永久寿险安排。在这种安排下，保单权益和保费支付是如何构建的？

opts.t: The architect owns 100% of both the cash value and death benefit, while the corporation pays 100% of the premiums as a tax-free gift.
opts.w: 错误。如果员工拥有全部权益而公司全额付保费，那属于应税员工福利而非分成保单（split-dollar）的公允价值分摊安排。

opts.t: The corporation and the architect hold different interests in one policy, such as the face amount and the cash value, and split the premium by the fair value of each.
opts.w: 正确。分成保单安排（split-dollar arrangement）的核心机制是企业与核心员工分享同一张保单的不同权益（面额部分与账户价值部分分属不同权益人），并按公允市场价值分摊保费。

opts.t: The policy death benefit is automatically credited to the employee's personal capital dividend account (CDA) upon retirement.
opts.w: 错误。资本红利账户（CDA）是私人公司的税务账户，个人员工并不存在个人 CDA。

opts.t: A specific section of the Income Tax Act sets a fixed 50/50 statutory premium split regardless of the age of the insured or the value of the benefits.
opts.w: 错误。分成保单安排并无专门的成文税法固定比例条款，而是依据 CRA 行政观点按各自所获权益的公允市场价值分摊保费。

variants.pt: 基础费率分类与加费触发因素区分
variants.trap: 混淆基础费率分类与评级加费
variants.stem: Four applicants are applying for standard term life insurance policies. Applicant 1 is a 45-year-old daily cigarette smoker with an office job; Applicant 2 is a 30-year-old non-smoker who drinks wine at family dinners; Applicant 3 is a 50-year-old non-smoker with a clean driving record; Applicant 4 is a 29-year-old non-smoker who accumulated four serious speeding and reckless driving convictions in the past two years. Which applicant is most likely to receive a rated policy?
variants.zh: 四名申请人正在申请标准定期寿险保单。申请人1是45岁的坐班族，每天吸烟；申请人2是30岁非吸烟者，仅在家庭聚餐时喝红酒；申请人3是50岁非吸烟者，驾驶记录良好；申请人4是29岁非吸烟者，过去两年内累计有四次严重超速及鲁莽驾驶违规记录。哪一位申请人最可能收到加费保单（rated policy）？

opts.t: Applicant 1, because cigarette smoking is always treated as an extra rating on top of the non-smoker table.
opts.w: 错误。吸烟状态（smoker status）直接对应独立的吸烟人基础费率表，不属于在基础费率之上另行叠加的加费保单（rated policy）。

opts.t: Applicant 2, because any alcohol consumption requires a rated premium.
opts.w: 错误。家庭聚餐偶尔小酌不构成酒精滥用，不会触发加费（rated policy）。

opts.t: Applicant 3, because being age 50 automatically places an applicant into the rated risk category.
opts.w: 错误。年龄影响的是基础费率表定价，50岁健康非吸烟者依然适用标准费率（standard rate），而非加费档。

opts.t: Applicant 4, because multiple serious driving violations on a Motor Vehicle Record (MVR) trigger a rating.
opts.w: 正确。机动车记录（Motor Vehicle Record, MVR）反映3至10年的驾驶史，多次严重驾驶违规超出了常规标准费率框架，会导致保单被评级加费（rated）。

variants.pt: 临时保险协议（TIA）生效与拒签条件
variants.trap: 认为交了首期保费TIA就必然生效
variants.stem: Owen, age 42, completes a formal life insurance application, answers 'no' to all questions on the Temporary Insurance Agreement (TIA) questionnaire, and offers to pay the first monthly premium. However, during the interview, the agent observes that Owen is visibly short of breath, wheezing heavily, and mentions he has been coughing up blood for two weeks without seeing a doctor. What should the agent do regarding the TIA?
variants.zh: 42岁的Owen完成了正式寿险投保申请，在临时保险协议（TIA）问卷的所有问题上均回答「否」，并提出支付首月保费。但在面谈过程中，代理人观察到Owen明显呼吸急促、严重喘息，且随口提到自己已咳血两周但尚未看医生。关于TIA，代理人应当怎么做？

opts.t: Issue the TIA immediately because Owen answered 'no' to every formal TIA question and tendered the first monthly premium.
opts.w: 错误。代理人只有在「对申请没有疑虑」且「已收到首期保费」两个条件同时满足时才应签发TIA；面对明显严重症状仍签发属于失职。

opts.t: Issue the TIA but attach a respiratory exclusion clause that the agent drafts on the spot and initials with Owen.
opts.w: 错误。代理人无权自行起草或附加除外条款（exclusion clause），那是核保员的职责。

opts.t: Decline to issue the TIA because of the serious health concerns the agent observed, and record them for the underwriter.
opts.w: 正确。代理人在签发临时保险协议（TIA）这一步有实质裁量权：当观察到持续咳嗽等明显健康疑虑时，应拒绝签发过渡保障，并在代理人意见栏（agent's comments）如实记录交核保员评估。

opts.t: Reject the entire formal life insurance application on the spot so the insurer never has to review Owen's file.
opts.w: 错误。代理人可以拒绝签发核保期间的TIA过渡保障，但正式保单是否承保、延期或拒保仍由保司核保员决定。

variants.pt: MIB编码报告的使用限制与核实义务
variants.trap: 误认MIB报告可直接作为拒保依据
variants.stem: Last year, Gavin applied for life insurance with Insurer X and was declined after a medical exam revealed severe liver disease. This month, Gavin applies for coverage with Insurer Y and omits any mention of his liver condition. When Insurer Y checks the Medical Information Bureau (MIB), what information will Insurer Y find and what must its underwriter do?
variants.zh: 去年，Gavin向X保险公司申请寿险，在体检发现严重肝病后被拒保。本月，Gavin向Y保险公司申请保险，并隐瞒了自己的肝病史。当Y保险公司查询医疗信息局（MIB）时，会查到什么信息，其核保员又必须怎么做？

opts.t: Insurer Y will see a coded entry for the liver condition, and its underwriter must verify that fact independently before declining or rating.
opts.w: 正确。医疗信息局（MIB）共享的是具体的医疗或道德风险编码事实（而非「被某保司拒保」这一结论本身），且核保员必须先独立核实该医疗事实确实存在，不能仅凭MIB编码直接拒保。

opts.t: Insurer Y will only see that Insurer X declined Gavin, which legally bars Insurer Y from ever issuing a policy to him.
opts.w: 错误。MIB记录的是风险事实编码而非「被拒保」结论，且一家保司的拒保并不构成向另一家保司投保的法律障碍。

opts.t: Insurer Y can automatically reject Gavin's application the moment the MIB code appears on screen without ordering any tests or records.
opts.w: 错误。MIB报告不能单独作为拒保依据，必须经过核保员独立核实程序。

opts.t: Insurer Y will find nothing in the MIB because medical exam findings from declined applications are deleted after six months.
opts.w: 错误。MIB存在的目的正是保存编码化风险记录，防止申请人跨保司隐瞒同一病史重复投保。

variants.pt: 保单交付生效要件与可保性变化处理
variants.trap: 忽视交付时可保性未变的前提
variants.stem: An insurer approves Diana's life insurance application and sends the policy contract to her agent. Under standard policy delivery requirements, which combination of conditions must all be satisfied before the agent can complete delivery and put the policy into force?
variants.zh: 保险公司批准了Diana的寿险申请，并将保单合同寄给她的代理人。根据标准保单交付要求，必须同时满足哪组条件，代理人才能完成交付并使保单正式生效？

opts.t: Diana signs the delivery receipt, the 10-day free-look period expires, and the agent files a FINTRAC large cash report.
opts.w: 错误。保单在满足交付三要件时即生效，不需要等到10天审阅期结束才生效，且FINTRAC大额现金报告仅在收到$10,000及以上现金时触发。

opts.t: Diana accepts the policy, the first premium is paid in full, and her insurability has not changed between application and delivery.
opts.w: 正确。保单交付（policy delivery）生效须同时满足三个条件：①交付的保单被申请人/所有人接受；②首期保费全额付清；③从申请到交付之间被保险人的可保性（insurability）没有发生变化。

opts.t: Diana passes a second full medical examination on the delivery date and pays a full annual premium in cash.
opts.w: 错误。交付时只需确认健康、职业、爱好、财务状况无重大变化，并不要求在交单当天重做全面体检或必须年缴现金。

opts.t: The agent verifies the named beneficiary's government ID on the delivery date and guarantees that premiums will never change.
opts.w: 错误。具名受益人的身份核验并不一律发生在投保或交单当天，这也不是保单交付生效的三要件。

variants.pt: 无意错误与欺诈性虚报的2年不可抗辩期
variants.trap: 混淆无意错误与欺诈的2年不可抗辩规则
variants.stem: Three years ago, Wendy purchased a life insurance policy and innocently omitted an early-stage benign cyst that her doctor had never mentioned to her. She also accidentally wrote her birth year as 1982 instead of 1980, making her appear two years younger. Today, while Wendy is alive and the policy has been in force for three years, the insurer discovers both unintentional errors. How are these two mistakes handled?
variants.zh: 三年前，Wendy购买了一份寿险保单，并无意中漏报了一个医生从未向她提起过的早期良性囊肿。她还不小心把出生年份1980年写成了1982年，使自己看起来小了两岁。今天，在Wendy健在且保单已有效满三年时，保险公司发现了这两个无意错误。这两项错误应如何处理？

opts.t: The medical omission is protected because two years in force have passed during Wendy's lifetime, while the age misstatement leads to an adjusted benefit or premium.
opts.w: 正确。根据BC《Insurance Act》s52，不存在欺诈的一般无意错误（mistake / innocent misrepresentation）在合同于被保险人生存期间有效满2年后受不可抗辩保护；而年龄误报（misstatement of age）另按s54专门规则调整保障或保费。

opts.t: The insurer can void the entire contract immediately because any mistake on a life insurance application invalidates the coverage forever.
opts.w: 错误。无欺诈的一般无意错误在被保险人生存期间有效满2年后受到不可抗辩期保护，保司不能撤单。

opts.t: Both the medical omission and the age misstatement are completely locked in after two years, so no adjustment for her true age is allowed at all.
opts.w: 错误。年龄误报适用专门条款（s54），不受一般无意错误2年不可抗辩期的冻结限制，仍须按真实年龄调整保障。

opts.t: The insurer can cancel the policy for the age error but must pay a penalty for reviewing her medical file after two years.
opts.w: 错误。只要未超出可投保年龄上限，年龄误报通过调整保额处理而非撤单，也不存在所谓审查罚款。

variants.pt: 加速核保与简化承保的机制差异
variants.trap: 混淆加速核保与简化承保
variants.stem: A client tells his agent, 'I saw an online ad for no-medical-exam life insurance. Since there is no physical exam, I am guaranteed to get the lowest standard rate even though I have a risky hobby and poor driving history.' If the product uses accelerated underwriting, how should the agent clarify the rules?
variants.zh: 一位客户对代理人说：「我看到网上有免体检寿险广告。既然不用做身体检查，就算我有高风险爱好和不良驾驶记录，我也肯定能拿到最低的标准费率。」如果该产品采用的是加速核保（accelerated underwriting），代理人应当如何澄清规则？

opts.t: Confirm that skipping the medical exam means the insurer also waives all financial and moral hazard checks, so his hobby and driving record will not matter.
opts.w: 错误。加速核保只是省略传统体检，依然会通过问卷及MIB、MVR、信用记录等既有数据全面评估三类风险。

opts.t: Explain that accelerated underwriting only applies after the policy has been in force for two years, so his hobby and driving record are ignored at application.
opts.w: 错误。加速核保是投保时的承保流程，与2年不可抗辩期无关。

opts.t: Tell the client that any no-medical policy is legally prohibited from charging different rates to different applicants, whatever their hobbies or driving.
opts.w: 错误。加速核保明确保留优选、标准、加费等风险分级定价。

opts.t: Explain that accelerated underwriting still classifies risk using questionnaires and data such as MIB and MVR, so his hobby or driving record can still lead to a rating.
opts.w: 正确。加速核保（accelerated underwriting）虽然跳过传统体检，但仍通过既有数据（MIB、机动车记录MVR等）和算法做全面核保分级，危险爱好或严重驾驶违规依然可能被评为加费（rated policy）。

variants.pt: 可保利益的判定时点与离婚后效力
variants.trap: 把可保利益当成理赔时的持续要求
variants.stem: Six years ago, a software firm purchased a $1,000,000 key person life insurance policy on its lead architect, Martin, with the firm as policyowner and beneficiary. Last month, Martin resigned from the firm to retire completely. If the firm continues paying the premiums on the existing policy, what happens to the validity of that policy?
variants.zh: 六年前，一家软件公司为其首席架构师Martin购买了一份$1,000,000的关键人物寿险保单，公司为保单所有人兼受益人。上个月，Martin从该公司辞职并彻底退休。如果该公司继续按时缴纳现有保单的保费，该保单的效力会如何？

opts.t: The policy terminates on Martin's last day of employment because the employer-employee insurable interest has ended.
opts.w: 错误。可保利益（insurable interest）只需在保单签发时存在，雇佣关系事后终止不会导致已生效的保单自动失效。

opts.t: The policy remains valid and in force because insurable interest existed when the contract was originally issued.
opts.w: 正确。可保利益（insurable interest）只需在保单签发时（at the time of policy issue）存在，此后雇佣关系或婚姻关系的变化不溯及既往，已生效合同继续有效。

opts.t: The policy converts automatically into a simplified issue policy owned by Martin's spouse.
opts.w: 错误。保单所有权不会因被保险人离职而自动转移，也不会自动变成简化承保（simplified issue）保单。

opts.t: The insurer can void the policy for moral hazard under the two-year incontestability rule.
opts.w: 错误。被保险人6年后正常离职退休既不构成投保时的不实陈述，也不赋予保司事后撤单的权利。

variants.pt: 按揭余额与可用既有保障扣减
variants.trap: 用房价代替按揭余额
variants.stem: Maya, an administrative specialist in Richmond, wants to ensure her family's expenses are covered for 14 years until her child turns 18. After deducting approved CPP survivor and child benefits of $1,111.35 per month from projected post-death monthly expenses of $4,200, her monthly income shortfall is $3,088.65, which equals approximately $519,000 over 14 years under the simplified zero net real return drawdown method (compared with $2,155,000 under the capital retention method at 1.72%). She also has one-time capital needs of $20,000 for funeral costs and $8,000 to clear credit card debt, and she holds an eligible $150,000 employer group life insurance policy. What is Maya's recommended new life insurance coverage?
variants.zh: 在列治文担任行政专员的Maya希望确保家人在未来14年（直至孩子年满18岁）的开支得到保障。从身故后预计月开支$4,200中扣除已核定的CPP遗属与子女月给付合计$1,111.35后，她的月收入缺口为$3,088.65；按零实际净收益的简化资本耗尽法覆盖14年，资本化金额约为$519,000（若按1.72%资本保留法则为$2,155,000）。她还有$20,000丧葬费和$8,000清偿信用卡债务的一次性资本需求，且名下有一份可赔付的$150,000雇主团体寿险。Maya的建议新增寿险保额是多少？

opts.w: 错在落入「漏减可用既有保障」及漏算一次性需求陷阱：$519,000仅是14年收入缺口的资本化金额，既未加上丧葬费$20,000和信用卡清偿$8,000，也未减去雇主提供的$150,000团体寿险（existing coverage）。
错在混淆既有保障与建议新增保额：$150,000是Maya目前已有的雇主团体寿险保额，应当作为扣减项从总需求中减去，而非建议新增购买的保额。
错在落入「资本保留法与耗尽法混用」陷阱：对有明确14年终止期限的子女抚养需求误用了本金永存的资本保留法（capital retention method）得出$2,155,000，且未计入一次性需求与既有团体险扣减。
正确：按资本需求法（capital needs approach），将14年缺口资本化金额$519,000加上一次性资本需求（丧葬$20,000＋信用卡$8,000），再减去既有团体寿险$150,000，得出资本缺口（capital shortfall）即建议新增保额约$397,000。

variants.pt: 收入替代法四步回报率调整
variants.trap: 资本保留法与耗尽法混用
variants.stem: Hannah earns $84,000 in annual after-tax take-home pay. Her advisor is demonstrating the four-step progression of the income replacement approach using a 5% investment rate of return, a 25% marginal tax rate, and a 2% inflation rate. If the advisor accounts for the after-tax rate of return ONLY (before making any inflation adjustment), what is the resulting capitalized value?
variants.zh: Hannah每年的税后实得收入为$84,000。她的顾问正在用5%的投资回报率、25%的边际税率和2%的通胀率演示收入替代法的四步演化。如果顾问仅计入税后回报率（尚未进行任何通胀调整），算出的资本化价值是多少？

opts.w: 正确：仅计入税后回报率（after-tax rate of return）时，分母为5% × (1 − 25%)＝3.75%，因此资本化价值（capitalized value）＝$84,000 ÷ 3.75%＝$2,240,000。
错在未计入税率影响：$1,680,000是直接按名义回报率5%（$84,000 ÷ 5%）算出的未调整资本化价值。
错在混淆了仅通胀调整与仅税后调整：$2,856,000是仅计入2%通胀率而未扣减25%税率时的计算结果。
错在多做了一步通胀调整：$4,896,000是同时计入25%税率与2%通胀率双重调整后的结果，而非仅计入税后回报率一步的数字。

variants.pt: 资本保留法与资本耗尽法的适用场景
variants.trap: 资本保留法与耗尽法混用
variants.stem: An agent is comparing the income replacement approach and the capital needs approach for a client couple. Why does the LLQP exam explicitly recommend the capital needs approach over the income replacement approach for making a formal coverage recommendation?
variants.zh: 一名代理人正在为一对客户夫妻比较收入替代法与资本需求法。为什么LLQP考纲明确指出在提出正式保额建议时，资本需求法比收入替代法更被推荐？

opts.t: Because the income replacement approach requires detailed post-death household budgets and takes much longer to calculate.
opts.w: 错在颠倒两种方法的优缺点：需要详尽家庭财务信息、耗时更长的是资本需求法（capital needs approach），而收入替代法计算快、适合初步粗筛。

opts.t: Because the capital needs approach ignores existing insurance coverage and available assets, ensuring the client buys the maximum possible policy.
opts.w: 错在违背资本需求法核心公式：资本需求法（capital needs approach）必须减去身故时可用资产（assets available upon death）与既有保障，而容易算出偏高保额的是假设本金永不动用的收入替代法。

opts.t: Because the capital needs approach itemizes actual post-death expenses, survivor income, one-time capital needs, and duration, reflecting the family's true shortfall.
opts.w: 正确：资本需求法（capital needs approach）逐项列出遗属身故后的实际收支缺口、持续期限与一次性资本需求，再扣除可用资产与既有保障，能精确反映家庭真实需要，因此考试口径明确指出这是更被推荐的方法。

opts.t: Because the capital needs approach is legally mandated by the British Columbia Family Law Act for all married couples.
opts.w: 错在编造法律强制规定：资本需求法是行业与考纲推荐的专业财务分析方法，并非BC省《家庭法》对所有已婚夫妻强制规定的法定公式。

variants.pt: 前配偶赡养费义务与离婚协议核查
variants.trap: 以为协议没写投保则身故后抚养义务自动消失
variants.stem: Under British Columbia's Family Law Act s.170(e) and s.171, which statement accurately describes the relationship between support obligations, existing life insurance, and claims against a deceased payor's estate?
variants.zh: 根据BC省《家庭法》（Family Law Act）s.170(e)与s.171，下列哪项准确描述了抚养义务、既有寿险保单以及针对已故支付方遗产提出索赔之间的关系？

opts.t: A mediation agreement is identical to a court order and automatically grants the former spouse the full value of the deceased's estate if insurance is not mentioned.
opts.w: 错在混淆调解协议与法院判决：调解协议与法院判决是两回事，协议沉默时受供养人可向法院申请，但并非自动获准或自动取得全部遗产。

opts.t: Section 170(e) can require a payor to name a spouse or child on existing insurance and keep paying premiums, and under s.171 a silent agreement may still expose the estate.
opts.w: 正确：在BC省，Family Law Act s.170(e)可针对供养方已有的寿险（court-ordered insurance）要求指定配偶或子女为受益人并维持缴费；而根据s.171，若调解协议未写清楚抚养义务随身故终止，前配偶仍可能对遗产提出索赔。

opts.t: If a divorce agreement does not explicitly mention life insurance, the support obligation is legally void upon the payor's death in all circumstances.
opts.w: 错在误以为「没提保险就不用管」：即使协议没有明文要求投保，只要抚养义务本身没有随身故终止的明确措辞，前配偶依然可能对遗产提出索赔。

opts.t: The Family Law Act prohibits naming a former spouse or child from a prior marriage as a beneficiary once the payor remarries.
opts.w: 错在违背法律事实：为担保身故后配偶赡养费或子女抚养费持续支付，前配偶或前段婚姻子女通常被指定为保单受益人，再婚并不会令该指定违法。

variants.pt: 企业权益视同处置与LCGE适用边界
variants.trap: 考场旧口径与现行规则混淆
variants.stem: Simone is the sole shareholder of a CCPC. At her death in 2026, her shares have a fair market value of $650,000 and an adjusted cost base (ACB) of $10,000. Assuming the shares meet all QSBC conditions and Simone has never used any of her Lifetime Capital Gains Exemption (LCGE), how is the $640,000 capital gain treated under 2026 tax rules?
variants.zh: Simone是一家CCPC的唯一股东。若她在2026年身故，其股份的公允市值为$650,000，调整后成本基数（ACB）为$10,000。假定该股份符合所有QSBC条件，且Simone从未使用过她的终身资本利得豁免（LCGE），在2026年税法规则下，这笔$640,000的资本利得应如何处理？

opts.t: The $640,000 capital gain is completely ignored and never produces a taxable capital gain or any alternative minimum tax (AMT) consideration.
opts.w: 错在把豁免抵扣当成从未产生应税资本利得：股权身故视同处置先产生$640,000资本利得及其50%即$320,000应税资本利得，再由资本利得扣除抵减；虽在一般税计算下可抵消，但仍须另核替代最低税（AMT）。

opts.t: Because CCPC shares are treated identically to a general operating partnership, the entire $320,000 taxable capital gain is fully taxable with no LCGE available.
opts.w: 错在混淆CCPC股份与普通经营合伙：符合QSBC定义的CCPC股份可以使用终身资本利得豁免（LCGE），不能与普通经营合伙混为一谈。

opts.t: Only the $10,000 adjusted cost base is subject to deemed disposition, while the $640,000 growth is taxed as a corporate dividend.
opts.w: 错在混淆成本基数与资本利得公式：视同处置（deemed disposition）的资本利得等于公允市值$650,000减去ACB $10,000即$640,000，并非对ACB征税或按股息征税。

opts.t: Half of the $640,000 gain, or $320,000, is a taxable capital gain that the capital gains deduction can offset within the 2026 LCGE of $1,275,000, subject to AMT.
opts.w: 正确：股权身故时按市值视同处置（deemed disposition），资本利得＝$650,000 − $10,000＝$640,000，其50%即$320,000为应税资本利得；在2026年现行LCGE上限$1,275,000内可通过资本利得扣除抵消一般所得税，但实务中仍须另核替代最低税（AMT）。

variants.pt: 身故时可用资产池的剔除规则
variants.trap: 不可变卖资产混入可用资产池
variants.stem: During a capital needs analysis, a client lists a family cottage that she wants passed intact to her children, a retirement account that her surviving spouse will continue holding for retirement, and a high-interest savings account earmarked for debt repayment at death. Which rule governs which of these assets reduce the total capital need?
variants.zh: 在资本需求分析中，客户列出了一处希望原封不动传给子女的家族度假屋、一个未亡配偶将继续持有用于养老的退休金账户，以及一个专门留作身故清偿债务的高息储蓄账户。下列哪条规则决定了其中哪些资产可以扣减总资本需求？

opts.t: Exclude the cottage meant for the children and the retirement account the spouse keeps; deduct only the savings account available at death.
opts.w: 正确：身故时可用资产（assets available upon death）必须严格区分总资产与可用于需求的资产——要传给子女的家族物业、配偶要继续持有的退休金账户即使账面价值再高也不计入可变卖资产池，只能扣减真正可用于清偿债务的储蓄账户。

opts.t: Deduct the gross market value of the cottage, the retirement account, and the savings account without adjustment for taxes or selling costs.
opts.w: 错在落入「不可变卖资产混入可用资产池」陷阱：不仅把不可变卖的度假屋和配偶养老账户混入可用资产池，而且即便变卖资产也必须扣除债务、税费及交易成本后的净额而非毛市值。

opts.t: Deduct only the cottage and the retirement account, because liquid cash accounts are excluded from the capital needs approach.
opts.w: 错在完全颠倒可用资产规则：可随时动用清偿遗产债务的流动现金恰恰是身故时可用资产（assets available upon death），而保留不卖的物业与配偶继续持有的退休金账户才必须剔除。

opts.t: Ignore all three assets because the capital needs approach only deducts existing life insurance policies and never deducts client assets.
opts.w: 错在遗漏公式关键项：资本需求法的正确公式是建议保额＝总需求 − 身故时可用资产（assets available upon death）− 既有保障，可用资产与既有保障两项都要参与相减。

variants.pt: 政府遗属给付考试口径与双口径区分
variants.trap: 考场旧口径与现行规则混淆
variants.stem: Kendra is leaving her employer and wants to know how her group life insurance conversion privilege works when assessing her ongoing coverage needs in British Columbia. Which statement accurately explains the exam treatment and the actual regulatory rule in BC?
variants.zh: Kendra即将离职，在评估自己在BC省的持续保障需求时，她想了解团体寿险的离职转换权是如何运作的。下列哪项准确解释了考试口径与BC省的实际监管规则？

opts.t: BC's Insurance Act guarantees a mandatory 90-day statutory conversion window for all group life policies, matching the pension waiver period.
opts.w: 错在张冠李戴法条与天数：90天是BC省《养老金给付标准法》（PBSA）s.80下配偶签署放弃联合遗属年金豁免的期限，BC省并没有成文法强制规定团体寿险90天转换期。

opts.t: The exam cites a 30-day or 31-day conversion window (it is internally inconsistent), while in BC conversion rests on CLHIA industry guidelines, not statute.
opts.w: 正确：按既有保障核对（existing coverage review）的双口径规则，考试口径内部对团体寿险离职转换窗口有30天与31天两处不一致表述（考场按题干表述作答），而在BC省现行法律下团体寿险的可转换性只受CLHIA行业自律指引约束，并非成文法法定保护。

opts.t: Group life insurance automatically continues at the employer's expense for 14 years after an employee resigns.
opts.w: 错在虚构离职后免费延续期：团体寿险通常会随离职而终止，短期可能随离职消失的团体保障绝不会由原雇主免费延续14年，也不应无条件抵掉长期缺口。

opts.t: Converting a group life policy requires full medical underwriting within 60 days, and the exam states that conversion is prohibited before age 65.
opts.w: 错在违背团体险转换权基本机制：在规定的转换窗口（考试口径30天或31天）内行使转换权通常无需重新提供可保性证明，也不存在「60天内全面体检」或「65岁前禁止转换」的规定。

variants.pt: 按风险持续期与现金流选产品
variants.trap: 目标误置（把最贵最全当默认最优）
variants.stem: Liam and Nora are retired spouses whose mortgage is paid off and whose children are financially independent. Their sole insurance objective is to provide cash to pay the capital gains tax on their family cottage, which will only become payable upon the death of whichever spouse dies second. They have maxed out their RRSP and TFSA room. Which policy type is most appropriate?
variants.zh: Liam 与 Nora 是一对已退休夫妇，房贷已还清，子女也已经济独立。他们唯一的保险目标是提供现金来支付家庭度假屋的资本利得税，而这笔税款仅在两人中后去世的那位配偶身故时才须缴纳。他们已用满 RRSP 与 TFSA 额度。哪种保单类型最合适？

opts.t: A twenty-year term policy on the older spouse alone, since term insurance has the lowest initial premium.
opts.w: 错在忽视了风险持续期（duration of risk）。身故税负是终身存在的确定需求，定期险到期后若被保险人仍健在，保障将消失或面临高昂续保保费。

opts.t: Two separate short-term policies that must be renewed every five years until the cottage is sold.
opts.w: 错在用短期定期险去覆盖终身才触发的遗产税负，不仅违反按需求持续期配险种的原则，且高龄续保成本极高。

opts.t: A joint last-to-die permanent life insurance policy, which matches the lifelong duration of the tax liability triggered upon the second spouse's death.
opts.w: 正确。根据六步推荐流程与产品选择决策树，当配偶间资产可展期、税负递延至末位配偶身故（death of the second spouse）才触发，且需求终身存在、客户已用满 RRSP/TFSA 时，应配置联合末身故永久险（joint last-to-die permanent insurance）。

opts.t: Relying solely on an employer group life policy, because group coverage has no maximum limit and always continues unchanged throughout retirement.
opts.w: 错在误解了团体寿险（group life insurance）的特征。团体险保额通常有上限且随离职或退休而终止或受限于转换规则，不能用来解决终身遗产税负。

variants.pt: 累计成本比较与受益人默认规则
variants.trap: 管辖混淆（受益人默认可撤销与魁北克替换表格）
variants.stem: A policyholder in Quebec names his legally married spouse as the beneficiary of his individual life insurance policy in an application form (outside of a will) without checking either the revocable or irrevocable box. Meanwhile, his brother in British Columbia does the exact same thing on a BC policy. How do the default rules treat these two designations?
variants.zh: 魁北克省的一位保单持有人在投保单（遗嘱以外的书面文件）中指定自己的合法已婚配偶为个人寿险受益人，但未勾选可撤销或不可撤销栏位。与此同时，他在 BC 省的哥哥在 BC 保单上做了完全相同的操作。默认规则如何对待这两项指定？

opts.t: Quebec treats a married spouse named outside a will as irrevocable unless stated otherwise; BC treats the same designation as revocable by default.
opts.w: 正确。根据第七节考试陷阱清单，除魁北克外，全国默认所有受益人指定都是可撤销的（revocable），即使指定的是配偶；而魁北克（CCQ 2449）针对遗嘱以外书面指定已婚或民事结合（civil union）配偶设为默认不可撤销（irrevocable），另有明示可撤销则从其约定。

opts.t: Both designations are automatically irrevocable across all Canadian provinces whenever the named beneficiary is a legal spouse.
opts.w: 错在「管辖混淆」陷阱，把魁北克对已婚配偶默认不可撤销的特殊规定错误推广到了 BC 省及全国其他普通法省份。

opts.t: Both designations are revocable by default, because irrevocable status only applies when the policyholder's estate is named as beneficiary.
opts.w: 错在忽略了魁北克的配偶例外规定，且指定遗产（estate）为受益人永远是可由保单持有人自由变更的，不可能自动成为不可撤销受益人。

opts.t: In BC the designation is irrevocable by default for married spouses, whereas in Quebec it applies only to common-law partners automatically.
opts.w: 完全说反了。BC 省默认可撤销；而魁北克默认不可撤销规则仅适用于已婚或民事结合（civil union）配偶，同居伴侣（common-law partners）不因同居而自动适用。

variants.pt: 保单演示件两套情景与签字含义
variants.trap: 目标误置（把演示投影当成承诺回报）
variants.stem: An agent reviews a draft policy illustration for a universal life contract whose investment account returns are non-guaranteed. The printout handed to the agent displays the guaranteed column alongside only one optimistic non-guaranteed investment projection. What should the agent do before meeting the client?
variants.zh: 一位代理人在见客户前审阅一份万能寿险合同的保单演示件草稿，该合同的投资账户回报是非保证的。交到代理人手上的打印件在保证栏旁边只展示了一套乐观的非保证投资回报投影。代理人在见客户前应该怎么做？

opts.t: Present the printout as is, since universal life illustrations are exempt from showing multiple scenarios.
opts.w: 错在误以为万能寿险（universal life）豁免两套情景规则。只要是含非保证金额的寿险演示件，都必须遵循展示至少两套情景的标准。
