opts.t: Under the lender's mortgage insurance, the borrower can freely name any family member to receive the proceeds instead of the lender.
opts.w: 混淆了贷款人按揭寿险与个人保单。贷款机构按揭寿险的赔款固定支付给贷款人（lender）用于清偿剩余贷款，不能由客户自由指定家属为受益人。

opts.t: Both the lender's mortgage policy and individual decreasing term typically keep a level premium while the coverage amount declines.
opts.w: 正确。无论是贷款机构销售的按揭寿险还是个人递减定期寿险（decreasing term），虽然身故给付（death benefit）随时间或贷款余额减少而下降，但合同期内的保费通常都保持不变。

opts.t: Lender mortgage insurance is never subject to underwriting conditions, exclusions, or termination rules.
opts.w: 违反实务核查原则。贷款机构按揭寿险同样有承保问卷、除外责任和终止条款，必须核查具体保险证书，不能一概假定毫无核保与除外限制。

checks.pt: 解答按年定制期限、首期固定期满逐年续保与保障终止年龄
checks.stem: An insurer offers a term life product where the policyholder selects an initial term between 5 and 50 years with a guaranteed level premium, followed at expiry by automatic yearly renewals with annually increasing premiums up to the policy anniversary nearest age 85. How should an agent explain the premium structure of this contract?
checks.zh: 某保险公司提供一款定期寿险产品，投保人可选择 5 至 50 年的首期并享有固定保证保费，首期届满后每年自动续保且保费逐年递增，直至最接近 85 岁生日的保单周年日。代理人应如何解释该合同的保费结构？

opts.t: The level premium applies only during the chosen initial term; the yearly renewals after it follow a separate, rising rate table.
opts.w: 正确。首期固定保费（level term premium）与期满后的逐年续保费率（renewal rates）是两段独立安排：既不能把期满后的逐年涨价说成首期年年涨，也不能把首期保费固定误当成终身固定。

opts.t: Because the policy terminates at age 85, the contract cannot include any renewability privilege at the end of the selected initial term.
opts.w: 混淆了续保权（renewability）与保障终止年龄。保单设有 85 岁保障终止年龄与首期期满后享有自动续保权可以同时存在。

opts.t: The policyholder's premium will increase every single year starting from the second policy anniversary, even within the initial term.
opts.w: 混淆了首期与续保期。在不变更保单的前提下，所选首期内的保费是固定的，只有首期期满进入逐年自动续保阶段后保费才会每年增加。

opts.t: The guaranteed initial premium remains locked in until age 85 as long as the insured does not change coverage.
opts.w: 误把首期保费固定当成直至保障终止年龄都固定。首期期满后按续保年龄逐年递增，只有选定首期内保费不变。

checks.pt: 解答为什么考试写固定档位而现行市场支持按年定制期限
checks.stem: Historically, insurers offered term life insurance mainly in standardized blocks such as 1, 5, 10, or 20 years, whereas several insurers now allow clients to customize exact term lengths by the year. Which aspect of term life insurance has remained unchanged despite this product evolution?
checks.zh: 历史上，保险公司主要按 1 年、5 年、10 年或 20 年等标准化档位提供定期寿险，而现在多家保司允许客户按年自定精确期限。尽管产品设计发生了这一演变，定期寿险的哪一项机制始终保持不变？

opts.t: Statutory law still mandates that only 1, 5, 10 and 20-year term lengths are legally valid, so custom terms are a regulatory exception.
opts.w: 误把行业惯例当成法律强制规定。1/5/10/20 年从来只是保险公司沿用的行业惯例（industry practice），并非法律或监管规定的清单。

opts.t: Conversion privileges still restart the two-year suicide exclusion period whenever the client has chosen a custom-length term.
opts.w: 误触「误认转换会重置两年时钟」陷阱。无论期限档位如何设计，转换后自杀除外条款（suicide exclusion clause）均沿用原合同签发日起算。

opts.t: All insurers now apply one uniform national cutoff age of 70 for exercising a term conversion privilege, whatever the product.
opts.w: 违反转换年龄因保司而异的原则。不论过去还是现在，转换年龄上限均因保险公司及具体合同条款而异，不存在全国统一固定数字。

opts.t: Renewability and convertibility are still separate rights, and a conversion still keeps the original issue date for the two-year clauses.
opts.w: 正确。无论产品期限从固定几档演变为按年定制，续保权（renewability）与转换权（convertibility）作为两项独立权利、以及转换沿用原签发日起算不可抗辩期（incontestability period）与自杀除外条款这两项底层合同法原则始终未变。

checks.pt: 解答精确匹配按揭年限、体检异常即刻转换与离婚保单归属
checks.stem: Nora has a mortgage with exactly 17 years remaining. The first insurer she approaches only offers fixed 10-year and 20-year term policies, while other insurers in the market offer customizable year-by-year term lengths. What is the implication of choosing a 20-year fixed term instead of a customizable 17-year term?
checks.zh: Nora 有一笔剩余还款期恰好为 17 年的按揭贷款。她咨询的第一家保司只提供 10 年和 20 年两档固定期限，而市场上其他保司提供按年定制期限的产品。选择 20 年固定期限而非按年定制的 17 年期限意味着什么？

opts.t: Choosing the 20-year term is required by regulation because 17-year term contracts are not permitted under standard rules.
opts.w: 误把考试口径列举的常见档位（1/5/10/20 年）当成监管限制。考试口径按题干档位作答，但实务中固定档位只是行业惯例而非监管禁令。

opts.t: A 20-year term forces Nora to pay for three extra years of coverage beyond her known mortgage liability window.
opts.w: 正确。考试口径虽常以 10/20 年固定档位设题，但实务中 20 年期比 17 年期多出三年的保障与保费支出；按年定制定期险（term life insurance）可精确覆盖 17 年负债窗口，避免多付三年保费。

opts.t: A 17-year custom term policy automatically forfeits the right to name a personal beneficiary.
opts.w: 混淆了个人定期寿险与贷款机构按揭寿险。按年定制的个人定期险依然由投保人（policyholder）自主指定受益人。

opts.t: The 20-year policy will automatically refund the last three years of premiums once the mortgage is paid off in year 17.
opts.w: 违反定期寿险无退还的基本结构。定期寿险（term life insurance）不累积现金价值（cash value），未发生理赔或提前不再需要保障时不会退还已缴保费。

checks.pt: 解答考场按题干档位与年龄作答、柜台核查原合同的双口径
checks.stem: An exam scenario states that a client's convertible term policy permits conversion to permanent insurance at any time before age 65. The candidate knows that several insurers in the current market allow conversion up to age 70 or before the 71st birthday. How should the candidate answer the exam question?
checks.zh: 一道考题题干写明，某客户的可转换定期寿险允许在 65 岁前随时转换为永久险。考生知道当前市场上多家保司允许转换至 70 岁或 71 岁生日前。考生在考场上应如何作答？

opts.t: Apply age 71 because it is the highest conversion cutoff currently available among major insurers.
opts.w: 误触「把各家现行值当成全国统一标准答案」陷阱。71 岁生日前只是特定保司现行产品条件，不能替代题干给定的合同数字。

opts.t: Apply age 70 as the industry-wide statutory standard for all convertible term contracts.
opts.w: 混淆了单一保司产品条件与法定标准。转换权年龄上限（maximum conversion age）因保险公司及具体合同而异，没有全国统一法定数字。

opts.t: Use the age 65 cutoff explicitly stated in the question stem, since conversion age limits are contract-specific.
opts.w: 正确。考试口径明确转换年龄上限「因保险公司而异」，考场作答必须严格按题干给定的具体合同数字（65 岁）计算；而在现行柜台实务中则须查阅客户所持保单的原合同条款。

opts.t: Assume the client can convert at any age up to 100 as long as the policy remains renewable.
opts.w: 误触「混淆续保权与转换权」陷阱。续保至高龄（如 85 岁或 100 岁）是续保权（renewability）的上限，不代表转换权（convertibility）也能延续到同一高龄。

checks.pt: 终身寿险早期多收保费机制、分红属性及限期缴区别
checks.stem: Clara, age 38, is comparing a 20-pay non-participating whole life policy with a life-pay participating whole life policy of the same face amount. Which statement accurately describes the structural difference between these options?
checks.zh: 38 岁的 Clara 正在比较同一保额的 20 年限期缴不分红终身寿险与终身缴分红终身寿险。下列哪项准确描述了这两种选项在制度结构上的区别？

opts.t: The 20-pay policy terminates coverage after 20 years, whereas the life-pay policy covers Clara for life.
opts.w: 掉入「概念混淆」陷阱。限期缴终身寿险（limited payment whole life，如 20-pay）只是把缴费期缩短到 20 年，保障期仍然是终身，不会在 20 年后终止保障。

opts.t: The 20-pay policy requires higher periodic premiums to eliminate longevity payment risk while maintaining lifetime coverage.
opts.w: 正确。限期缴终身寿险（limited payment whole life）在 20 年内缴清全部保费并保障终身，消除了活得比预期久还得一直缴费的长寿风险，代价是同等保额下单期保费显著更高。

opts.t: The non-participating policy requires Clara to pay additional premiums if the insurer experiences investment losses.
opts.w: 掉入「盈亏承担误解」陷阱。不分红（non-participating, non-par）与分红（participating, par）保单持有人都不承担保司亏损，写进合同的保证保额和保证现金价值不会因经营不善而缩水或要求补缴。

opts.t: The participating policy guarantees an annual dividend payout determined by a fixed formula in the contract.
opts.w: 掉入「混淆合同参与权与分红金额」陷阱。参与分红（participating, par）保单持有人虽有合同参与权，但每年是否分红及金额完全由保司董事会自由裁量（at the sole discretion of the Board of Directors），并非保证。

checks.pt: 红利四种去向、分红率与存款利率差异及保单贷款规则
checks.stem: Marcus owns a participating whole life policy and notices that the insurer announced a dividend scale interest rate of 6.30% this year. He selects the 'accumulate at interest' dividend option. What rate will apply to the dividends left on deposit?
checks.zh: Marcus 持有一份分红终身寿险，注意到保险公司今年宣布的分红率（dividend scale interest rate）为 6.30%。他选择了「累积生息」红利选项。留存在保司账户里的红利将按什么利率计息？

opts.t: A separate deposit rate set by the insurer, which can be well below the 6.30% dividend scale rate.
opts.w: 正确。分红率（dividend scale interest rate）只是精算师计算当年应分多少红利的内部假设参数；红利宣布后若选择累积生息（accumulate at interest），适用的是保司另定的存款利率（如现行举例中的 2.3% 或 3.50%），通常显著低于分红率。

opts.t: The full 6.30% dividend scale interest rate, compounded annually for as long as the policy stays in force.
opts.w: 掉入「指标误用」陷阱。把分红率（dividend scale interest rate）误当成客户把红利留在保司账上能拿到的存款利率，混淆了内部精算参数与留存生息账户利率。

opts.t: The policy loan interest rate minus a fixed administrative spread that is specified in the policy contract.
opts.w: 掉入「利率概念张冠李戴」陷阱。保单贷款利率（policy loan interest rate）是投保人向保司借款时支付的利率，与红利累积生息账户的存款利率无关。

opts.t: A guaranteed minimum rate equal to 90% of the dividend scale interest rate declared by the board.
opts.w: 掉入「数字拼凑」陷阱。90% 是考试口径中保单贷款占现金退保价值（CSV）的常见上限比例或行业破产保障机制的保护比例，与累积生息利率毫无关系。

checks.pt: 投保初始选择、年度对账单双栏结构与停缴后四道保底
checks.stem: Five years after buying a non-participating whole life policy, Elena's health declines and she wishes to switch her policy to a participating whole life policy to build paid-up additions. What practical obstacle will she face?
checks.zh: 购买不分红终身寿险五年后，Elena 的健康状况下降，她希望把保单改为分红终身寿险以累积增额已缴清保险（PUA）。她会面临什么实务障碍？

opts.t: She can switch freely on any policy anniversary simply by paying the historical difference in premiums plus interest.
opts.w: 掉入「随意变更假设」陷阱。是否参与分红（par vs. non-par）在投保签单时即已锁定，大多数保司不允许中途补差价直接更改。

opts.t: She must first use up her automatic premium loan limit before the insurer will accept any request to change the policy.
opts.w: 掉入「机制混淆」陷阱。自动垫缴保费（automatic premium loan, APL）是漏缴保费时防止失效的垫付机制，不是变更分红属性的前置条件。

opts.t: A switch usually means surrendering the policy and buying a new one, underwritten at her current age and health.
opts.w: 正确。缴费方式与是否参与分红（participating vs. non-participating）在签单时定下后通常无法直接修改，后续想改往往意味着退保重新投保，必须按当下的年龄和已恶化的健康状况重新核保。

opts.t: She is barred by regulation from owning a participating policy once a medical condition is diagnosed.
opts.w: 掉入「虚构监管禁令」陷阱。法规并未禁止患病客户投保分红险，真正的障碍是更换新单需重新核保（underwriting），健康变差会导致保费更贵甚至被拒保。

checks.pt: 分红险按身故或现金价值导向分化、按批次分红及定位
checks.stem: Two clients hold participating whole life policies with the same insurer, but one policy was issued ten years ago under an older policy cohort while the other was issued this year. How does the insurer manage dividend scales across these policies?
checks.zh: 两位客户持有同一家保险公司的分红终身寿险，但一份是十年前按旧批次签发的，另一份是今年新签发的。保险公司如何管理这两份保单的红利表（dividend scale）？

opts.t: The insurer is legally required to apply the exact same dividend scale interest rate to every policy it has ever issued.
opts.w: 掉入「一刀切假设」陷阱。保单准备金（policy reserve）和红利表（dividend scale）按不同签发批次或历史产品线分组精算，不同签发年份批次可适用不同的红利表。

opts.t: Different issue cohorts and product lines can be assigned separate dividend scales based on the underlying reserve pool experience.
opts.w: 正确。保单准备金按批次分组精算，不同签发年份批次或不同定位的产品线（如偏身故给付导向 vs 偏现金价值积累导向）适用各自的红利表（dividend scale）与演示。

opts.t: Older policies automatically lose their participating status once the insurer launches a new product series.
opts.w: 掉入「合同权利灭失误解」陷阱。参与分红（participating）是写进原合同的权利，不会因为保司推出新批次产品而丧失分红资格。

opts.t: The client with the higher product name tier is guaranteed a higher cash surrender value regardless of contract terms.
opts.w: 掉入「望文生义」陷阱。比较早期现金价值、均衡目标或长期遗产目标时，应阅读各自合同的保证与非保证演示（illustrations），不能凭产品名称推定回报高低。

checks.pt: 消失保费丑闻成因、保证与非保证双栏披露及分红平滑
checks.stem: Why did the 'vanishing premium' marketing practices of the 1970s and 1980s lead to widespread policyholder disputes and stricter illustration disclosure rules in the 1990s?
checks.zh: 为什么 1970–80 年代的「消失保费（vanishing premium）」营销实务会在 1990 年代引发广泛的保单持有人纠纷并催生更严格的演示披露规则？

opts.t: Insurers retroactively cancelled the guaranteed cash value tables that had been printed in the original policy contracts.
opts.w: 掉入「保证条款违约误解」陷阱。已经写进合同的保证现金价值表（guaranteed cash value table）不会因经营或利率下行而缩水，出问题的是非保证的红利预测。

opts.t: Policyholders were taxed every year on their policy reserves before the policies reached the promised offset year.
opts.w: 掉入「无关税务干扰」陷阱。消失保费丑闻的核心是宏观利率暴跌导致分红率腰斩，而非保单准备金被逐年征税。

opts.t: Agents sold Term-100 policies disguised as participating whole life policies that promised fixed dividends every year.
opts.w: 掉入「产品张冠李戴」陷阱。消失保费（vanishing premium / premium offset）发生在分红终身寿险演示中，而非无分红、无现金价值的 T-100。

opts.t: High-rate illustrations were taken as promises, so when rates and dividends fell, premiums did not vanish on schedule.
opts.w: 正确。当年用历史高位的分红率做保费抵消（premium offset）演示，当 1980 年代末至 1990 年代利率与分红率大幅下行时，红利和 PUA 现金价值不足以按期抵扣保费，导致客户被迫多缴十几年；这直接促使监管要求演示件（illustration）并列展示保证栏与非保证栏并由客户签字确认。

checks.pt: PUA 独立保单叠加本质、保费抵消顺延及 T-100 适配
checks.stem: Over 15 years, Gavin's $500,000 participating whole life policy has grown to a total death benefit of $560,000 through the paid-up additions (PUA) dividend option. How is that extra $60,000 of coverage structured?
checks.zh: 在 15 年间，Gavin 的 $500,000 分红终身寿险通过购买增额已缴清保险（PUA）红利选项，总身故保额增长到了 $560,000。这多出来的 $60,000 保额在结构上是怎么构成的？

opts.t: It is a series of individual small, single-premium paid-up permanent policies, each generating its own cash value.
opts.w: 正确。增额已缴清保险（paid-up additions, PUA）是用每年宣布的红利当趸缴保费买下的一小笔独立已缴清永久险，每一笔都有自己的现金价值（cash value），习惯上与原始保额合并展示为总保额。

opts.t: It is a temporary one-year term insurance rider that must be renewed every policy anniversary.
opts.w: 掉入「把 PUA 当成定期附加险」陷阱。PUA 买的是永久性的已缴清保险（paid-up permanent insurance），终身有效且有现金价值，不需要每年续保。

opts.t: It is an automatic upward adjustment to the base policy's face amount that requires higher ongoing base premiums.
opts.w: 掉入「原保单保额上调误解」陷阱。常见错法就是把 PUA 误以为是原保单保额直接上调；实际上它是红利作为趸缴保费买的已缴清保单叠加，不会增加原保单的应缴保费。

opts.t: It is a non-guaranteed bonus that disappears if the insurer lowers its dividend scale interest rate next year.
opts.w: 掉入「已宣布红利可撤回误解」陷阱。未来未宣布的分红不保证，但往年已经宣布并用来买成已缴清增额保险（PUA）的保额和现金价值已经是缴清的永久保障，不会因次年分红率下调而消失。

checks.pt: 八大高频考试陷阱辨析、缴费频率系数差异及双口径
checks.stem: An advisor compares monthly versus annual premium payments on a traditional whole life policy and a universal life (UL) policy. According to exam rules on modal factors, what should the advisor expect?
checks.zh: 一位顾问正在比较传统终身寿险与万能寿险（UL）按月缴费与按年缴费的差异。根据考试关于缴费频率系数（modal factor）的规则，顾问应当预期什么结果？

opts.t: Both policies apply a modal factor that makes the annualized monthly premiums roughly 6% higher than the annual premium.
opts.w: 掉入「类别错配」陷阱。顺着所有保险都有月缴附加费的惯性直觉作答，忽略了万能寿险（universal life, UL）通常没有缴费频率系数（modal factor）。

opts.t: Whole life uses a modal factor, so monthly payments cost more over a year than the annual premium; UL usually has none.
opts.w: 正确。定期险与传统终身寿险（whole life）非年缴时适用缴费频率系数（modal factor，考试口径示例月缴年化总额高于年缴约 6%），而万能寿险（UL）通常没有 modal factor，月缴年化总额与年缴相同。

opts.t: Only the universal life policy charges a modal factor on monthly payments, to cover its monthly mortality administration.
opts.w: 掉入「反向记忆」陷阱。把传统终身寿险（whole life）和万能寿险（UL）关于缴费频率系数（modal factor）的有无彻底搞反了。

opts.t: Neither policy applies a modal factor because permanent life insurance premiums are fixed by level cost of insurance.
opts.w: 掉入「平准保费误推」陷阱。终身寿险虽然年度保费固定，但拆分为月缴时会因利息损失与行政成本而乘以缴费频率系数（modal factor），导致月缴年化总额更高。

checks.pt: 解释三要素拆分后保司与客户的责任边界及三项可调自由度
checks.stem: An advisor is explaining to a prospective policyholder how a universal life policy differs from a traditional whole life policy after its core components are unbundled. Which of the following accurately describes who bears the investment decision-making authority and the resulting risk of policy lapse?
checks.zh: 一位顾问正向准保单持有人解释万能寿险在核心要素拆分后与传统终身寿险有何不同。下列哪项准确描述了谁掌握投资决定权以及由此产生的保单失效风险？

opts.t: The insurer keeps full control of the investment mix and promises that the policy cannot lapse as long as the initial minimum premium is paid.
opts.w: 这混淆了捆绑型终身寿险与万能寿险（universal life insurance）。拆分（unbundling）之后，保险公司把投资决定权交还给了客户，且最低缴费并不等于合同承诺保单终身不失效。

opts.t: The policyholder picks the accounts and bears the lapse risk from weak returns or underfunding; the insurer and advisor keep their duties.
opts.w: 万能寿险通过要素拆分（unbundling）将投资账户（accumulating fund）的选择权交给保单持有人，持有人须承担投资表现不佳或缴费不足导致账户价值盖不住扣费而失效的风险；同时保险人和代理人的合同、通知及适当性义务依然存在，不能以客户自选投资为由预先免除。

opts.t: The policyholder alone must calculate the monthly mortality charges, while the insurer absorbs any negative returns in the index-linked accounts.
opts.w: 颠倒了双方职责：保险成本（cost of insurance, COI）的定价逻辑与精算风险仍由保险公司设定并写入合同，而指数或基金联动账户的亏损风险由保单持有人自己承担。

opts.t: The policyholder may replace the life insured or raise the face amount at any time without underwriting, because unbundling moves all risk to them.
opts.w: 属于过度泛化可调项陷阱：虽然万能寿险具有保额和被保险人可调的灵活性，但增加保额需要重新核保，且只有部分合同允许经核保后新增或替换被保险人，不能推定每张保单都可无条件操作。

checks.pt: 说明最低与最高缴费边界、免税测试作用及演示件双利率要求
checks.stem: Before a client signs an application for a universal life policy that includes equity-linked investment accounts, what does the exam standard require regarding the policy illustration provided to the client?
checks.zh: 在客户签署包含权益联动投资账户的万能寿险投保申请前，考试口径对提供给客户的保单演示件有何要求？

opts.t: It must display at least two investment return assumptions—a current rate and a noticeably lower rate—and require the policyholder's signature acknowledging that neither rate is guaranteed.
opts.w: 按考试口径，万能寿险的保单演示件（policy illustration）必须附至少两套投资回报假设（「现行利率」与「一套明显更低的利率」），并由保单持有人签字确认理解这两套数字都不是保证；实务柜台展示时还必须使用保司当下公布的现行利率重新出具。

opts.t: It must lock in the central bank's current overnight policy rate of 2.25% as a permanent minimum return across all chosen accounts for the life of the contract.
opts.w: 混淆了宏观政策利率与合同保证利率：加拿大央行现行政策利率 2.25% 既不是保单演示件锁定的保证回报，也不能直接替代保证投资账户（GIA）报价或权益联动回报。

opts.t: It must guarantee that if the policy is minimally funded, the account value will automatically pass the annual exemption test and remain in force until age 100 without further review.
opts.w: 混淆了最低缴费（minimally funded）的设计目标与合同保证：考试口径说明最低建议缴费以维持至指定年龄（例为 100 岁）为设计目标，但不等于合同承诺终身有效，实际回报和扣费变化后仍可能不足。

opts.t: It need only show a single historical average return rate, provided the insurer commits to automatically refunding any deposits that exceed the exemption test limit.
opts.w: 违反了保单演示件（policy illustration）至少两套回报假设的硬性规定；同时超过免税测试（exemption test）上限时，保险人可能拒收、退款或按合同转入应税侧基金，不能仅靠单一利率演示。

checks.pt: 厘清保费扣费顺序、NAAR计算、YRT与LCOI对比及六项账户权利
checks.stem: When a policyholder makes a premium deposit into a universal life contract, in what sequence are deductions taken and how is the monthly cost of insurance (COI) determined?
checks.zh: 当保单持有人向万能寿险合同缴入一笔保费时，各项扣费按什么顺序进行，且每月的保险成本（COI）是如何确定的？

opts.t: Admin charges and an insurance charge based on the full face amount come off first, and premium tax is levied only when money is withdrawn.
opts.w: 颠倒了扣费顺序且错算了计费基数：保费税（premium tax）是在保费进账户前按整笔保费先行扣除的，而保险成本（cost of insurance, COI）是按净风险保额（net amount at risk, NAAR）而非固定保额本身计算的。

opts.t: Premium tax comes off the whole premium first; the rest enters the fund, which then pays the NAAR-based insurance charge and admin fees.
opts.w: 根据三要素拆分流程，客户缴入保费后先按整笔保费扣除省级保费税（premium tax），剩余部分进入累积账户（accumulating fund），再从中扣除按净风险保额（net amount at risk, NAAR ＝ 身故给付 − 账户价值）计算的保险成本（COI）及管理费（administration charges）。

opts.t: The whole deposit enters the accumulating fund tax-free, and provincial premium tax applies only to investment returns earned above a 0% floor.
opts.w: 混淆了保费税与投资收益税：省级保费税（premium tax）针对缴入的整笔保费在入账前扣除，而累积账户内的投资增值在免税测试（exemption test）上限内享有税务递延。

opts.t: Surrender charges of 5 to 10 times the LCOI are taken from each deposit up front, and insurance charges apply only if the account falls below zero.
opts.w: 混淆了日常扣费与退保费用（surrender charge）：退保费用仅在保单前 5–10 年退保时按 LCOI 年扣费倍数计算并从账户价值中扣减，不是每次缴保费时预扣。

checks.pt: 总结保司在成本结构、投资账户分类与加息红利上的差异化设计
checks.stem: When comparing universal life offerings across different insurers in the market, an advisor notices variations in how cost structures and investment features are packaged. Which of the following statements accurately reflects how these market features relate to the contract rules?
checks.zh: 在比较市场上不同保险公司的万能寿险产品时，顾问注意到成本结构和投资功能在包装方式上存在差异。下列哪项陈述准确反映了这些市场设计与合同规则之间的关系？

opts.t: Every insurer uses the same names for YRT and LCOI and automatically pays an unconditional investment bonus on all money market and guaranteed accounts.
opts.w: 不符合市场实况：不同保司对逐年更新定期成本（YRT）与平准保险成本（LCOI）的命名各异（或将 LCOI 作为附加险），且投资红利（investment bonus）是否有条件、排除哪些账户（如排除货币市场账户）因合同而异。

opts.t: An advisor can rely on a general website overview alone to confirm every available investment account and cost option, without reading the contract.
opts.w: 违反了核对合同原则：部分保司官网仅提供概览而未列出全部投资账户或成本选项细节，顾问必须以客户所投批次的具体合同为准，网页概览不能替代合同。

opts.t: Insurers compete on how COI options are named and structured, which accounts they offer and any investment bonus, all to be checked in the contract.
opts.w: 万能寿险市场的核心差异点在于保险成本结构（cost of insurance, COI）的命名与灵活度（如是否将平准成本设为可选附加险或限定缴清年限）、投资账户（accumulating fund）种类及是否提供投资红利（investment bonus），顾问比较时必须核实具体合同条款。

opts.t: If an insurer offers level cost of insurance as an optional rider at issue, the policyholder is entitled to switch back to YRT later to cut charges.
opts.w: 违背了转换方向规则：即便保司把平准保险成本（LCOI）设计为投保时可选的附加项，保险成本结构通常也只允许从 YRT 转为 LCOI，一般不允许从 LCOI 转回 YRT。

checks.pt: 揭示透明化诉求与税基保护博弈如何塑造既灵活又受限的产品形态
checks.stem: Why did universal life insurance evolve into a product that combines high transparency and flexibility with strict statutory funding limits?
checks.zh: 为什么万能寿险会演变成一款既具备高度透明度与灵活性、又受到严格法定缴费上限约束的产品？

opts.t: Insurers asked for statutory funding caps so that they would not have to disclose their internal mortality charges or fees to policyholders.
opts.w: 因果颠倒：万能寿险最初正是为了回应客户对传统捆绑产品不透明的批评而将死亡成本、费用和投资回报拆开披露（unbundling），法定上限并非为了隐瞒费用。

opts.t: Buyers wanted protection, fees and returns shown separately, and lawmakers then added the exemption test to stop use as a pure tax shelter.
opts.w: 70 年代末至 80 年代初市场因质疑捆绑型分红险不透明而催生了要素拆分（unbundling）的万能寿险；但投资账户过度灵活容易被人当成纯免税储蓄账户使用，立法者遂引入免税测试（exemption test）保护税基，并在 2017 年 1 月 1 日进一步更新精算参数。

opts.t: Tax authorities abolished whole life insurance in 2017 and required every permanent policy to separate its mortality charges from its investments.
opts.w: 史实错误：终身寿险并未被废除，2017 年 1 月 1 日更新的是免税测试（exemption test）背后的精算参数与保单代次（G1/G2/G3）分界规则。

opts.t: Provincial regulators limited premium flexibility so that monthly premium payments would always carry the same 6% modal factor as term insurance.
opts.w: 张冠李戴：万能寿险根本没有按期系数（modal factor），其缴费上限源于联邦税法的免税测试（exemption test），与期缴系数无关。

checks.pt: 诊断YRT长期最低缴费枯竭、增额重新核保及保单贷款与担保转让差异
checks.stem: Five years after purchasing a universal life policy with a $300,000 face amount, a couple welcomes twins and asks to increase the death benefit to $800,000 on the same contract. Assuming the policy has no special guaranteed insurability rider, how will the insurer treat this request?
checks.zh: 在购买保额为 $300,000 的万能寿险五年后，一对夫妇迎来了双胞胎，并申请在同一份合同上将身故保额提高到 $800,000。假设该保单没有附带特殊的保证增额附加条款，保险公司会如何处理这一申请？

opts.t: The extra $500,000 is new risk that needs underwriting; if the insured's health slipped it may be rated or declined, but the $300,000 stays in force.
opts.w: 按考试口径，万能寿险虽然允许调整保额，但增加保额（从 $300,000 提至 $800,000）超出了免核保范围，新增了实质死亡风险敞口，必须重新核保（medical underwriting）；若健康恶化，新增部分可能被加费或拒保，但原有的 $300,000 保障不受影响（实务中还须核查合同是否附有保证增额权 GIB）。

opts.t: Because universal life has a flexible face amount, any existing policyholder can raise coverage to $800,000 just by adjusting the monthly deduction.
opts.w: 落入「老客户增额免核保误区」：保额灵活可调不代表免核保，大幅增加保额需要填写健康问卷甚至体检。

opts.t: If the insured developed high blood pressure in the past five years, the insurer will cancel the existing $300,000 coverage once the request is filed.
opts.w: 混淆了新增保额核保与既有保单效力：重新核保仅针对申请增加的 $500,000 风险敞口，无论新增部分是否获批，原有的 $300,000 保障均继续有效。

opts.t: The insurer will approve the increase without underwriting as long as the policyholder switches the death benefit option to level plus account value.
opts.w: 更改死亡给付方式或增加风险保额只要扩大了保险公司的净风险保额（net amount at risk, NAAR），均需核保审批，不能靠切换给付方式规避核保。

checks.pt: 识别八大高频考场陷阱并区分考试口径原则与柜台实务核查要求
checks.stem: A retiree uses a universal life policy in a leveraging strategy to obtain tax-free cash advances from a bank, planning for the loan principal and accrued interest to be repaid from the death benefit at death. What critical risk must be disclosed before entering this arrangement?
checks.zh: 一位退休人士利用万能寿险采取杠杆化策略，从银行获取免税现金借款，计划在身故时用身故给付一次性清偿贷款本金和累计利息。在达成这一安排前，必须披露哪项关键风险？

opts.t: The bank advances are taxed immediately as ordinary income in the year they are borrowed, even when the loan is secured by a collateral assignment.
opts.w: 混淆了保单贷款与银行抵押借款的税务待遇：通过担保转让（collateral assignment）向银行借款本身通常不构成保单处置，不会在借款当年直接作为普通收入征税。

opts.t: If returns disappoint, the growing loan balance can overtake the cash value, and the bank may call the loan and force a surrender.
opts.w: 保单杠杆化（leveraging）是免税借钱而非免税白拿钱；若投资回报不及预期，生前不还本息会导致未偿贷款余额追上甚至超过现金价值，银行有权要求提前还款，客户若无力偿还将被迫退保（surrender），导致退休计划落空。

opts.t: Leveraging automatically makes the policy fail the annual exemption test and ends the death benefit coverage immediately on that anniversary.
opts.w: 落入范围误判陷阱：免税测试（exemption test）限制的是向保单内超额多存钱，外部银行杠杆借款不会自动触发免税测试失败，更不会直接终止身故保障。

opts.t: The insurer will charge a 6% modal factor on the outstanding bank loan balance every year until the policyholder reaches age 100 or dies.
opts.w: 概念拼凑错误：万能寿险既无 6% 的按期系数（modal factor），保险公司也不会对第三方的银行抵押贷款余额收取期缴系数。

checks.pt: 区分身故附加险与生前补充保障，掌握依附性、除外边界与预支机制
checks.stem: Marcus owns a whole life insurance policy that includes paid-up additions (PUA) and an accidental death (AD) rider. Facing a cash crunch, Marcus decides to surrender the base whole life policy for its cash surrender value, hoping to keep the paid-up additions and the AD rider in force as standalone coverage. How will the insurer treat his request?
checks.zh: Marcus 持有一份包含已缴清增额（PUA）和意外身故附加险（AD）的终身寿险保单。由于资金紧张，Marcus 决定将终身寿险主险退保以换取现金退保价值，但希望将已缴清增额和 AD 附加险作为独立保障继续保留。保险公司会如何处理他的要求？

opts.t: Both the paid-up additions and the AD rider will remain in force on their own, because their cost has already been paid in full.
opts.w: 错在「附加险当独立保单（类别错配）」陷阱。附加险（riders）依附于主险存续，已缴清增额（paid-up additions, PUA）的「已缴清」是指不需再交分期保费，绝不等于整张主保单退保后仍能独立存在，AD 附加险同样随主险终止而失效。

opts.t: The AD rider ends, and the paid-up additions' cash value is settled together with the base policy on surrender.
opts.w: 正确。绝大多数附加险不能脱离主险单独存在；当整张主保单退保（surrender）时，意外身故附加险（accidental death, AD rider）立即终止，而已缴清增额（paid-up additions, PUA）的现金价值会一并计入整张保单的退保价值进行结算，不能作为独立保单继续保留。

opts.t: The paid-up additions will continue as an independent permanent policy, while only the AD rider will terminate with the base.
opts.w: 错在把已缴清增额（paid-up additions, PUA）当成退掉主险后仍能独立存续的保单（类别错配）。整单退保时，PUA 的现金价值与相关增额保障会随主合同一起结算终止。

opts.t: The AD rider can be kept in force by paying the annual policy fee on its own, while the paid-up additions must be cashed out.
opts.w: 错在违背了附加险的依附性原则（类别错配）。意外身故附加险（AD rider）用失去独立性换取更低的价格，主险退保后无法通过单独缴纳保单年费（policy fee）让 AD 附加险独立存续。

checks.pt: 掌握重疾定义基准的自愿属性、GIB双口径触发与行业惯例数值
checks.stem: Clara is comparing dread disease (DD) benefits across two insurers and asks her advisor whether the industry benchmark definitions published by the Canadian Life and Health Insurance Association (CLHIA) guarantee that both contracts define a covered heart attack identically. How should the advisor respond?
checks.zh: Clara 正在比较两家保险公司的重疾给付（DD）条款，她向顾问询问加拿大寿险与健康险协会（CLHIA）发布的行业重疾定义基准是否保证了这两份合同对「心脏病发」的定义完全一致。顾问应当如何回答？

opts.t: Yes, all member insurers are legally required to adopt the 2024 Final benchmark definitions word for word in every contract.
opts.w: 错在将行业协调文件当成法定强制标准。虽然 CLHIA 重疾定义基准（CLHIA CI Benchmark Definitions）现行版本为 2024 Final，但各保险公司是否采用以及采用哪个版本完全属于自愿决定。

opts.t: Yes, for the four core conditions known as the Big 4, the definitions are required by law to be identical across all insurers.
opts.w: 错在混淆了考试概括术语与法律强制规定。考试口径用「Big 4」（心脏病发、中风、冠状动脉搭桥、危及生命的癌症）概括常见重疾门槛，但这并非法定最低病种或强制统一措辞。

opts.t: No, the 2024 Final benchmark exists but insurers adopt it voluntarily, so each contract's own wording must be checked.
opts.w: 正确。CLHIA 重疾定义基准（CLHIA CI Benchmark Definitions）现行版本虽为 2024 Final（此前有 2018 与 2013 版），但明文规定各保司自愿采用；因此面对客户询问时，不能背版本号代替核对，必须逐条对比具体合同的重疾定义原文（differences between companies）。

opts.t: No, benchmark definitions only apply to stand-alone critical illness policies and never to dread disease riders.
opts.w: 错在捏造适用范围限制。CLHIA 重疾定义基准（CLHIA CI Benchmark Definitions）作为行业参考可用于重疾相关条款，核心在于其自愿采用属性，而非禁止用于重疾附加险（dread disease, DD）。

checks.pt: 理清需求分析、配偶单独核保、收费方式区分及豁免期保单权益运作
checks.stem: Devon owns a participating whole life insurance policy with a waiver of premium for total disability benefit. Two years after purchasing the policy, Devon becomes totally disabled and satisfies the waiting period. While his premiums are being waived by the insurer, what happens to his policy's cash value growth and dividends?
checks.zh: Devon 持有一份附带完全伤残豁免保费条款的分红终身寿险保单。投保两年后，Devon 完全伤残并满足了等待期要求。在保险公司豁免其保费期间，他保单的现金价值增长和保单分红会如何变化？

opts.t: The policy is frozen during the waiver period, so cash values and dividends stop accumulating until Devon recovers.
opts.w: 错在误以为「豁免保费」等于「保单被冻结」。在完全伤残豁免保费（waiver of premium for total disability）生效期间，保单的各项既有权益照常运作，不会暂停累积。

opts.t: Dividends and cash values keep growing, and other riders stay in force, as if Devon were still paying premiums.
opts.w: 正确。当被保险人进入完全伤残豁免期（waiver of premium for total disability）后，虽然停止缴纳保费，但保单本身并未冻结，其分红（dividends）、现金价值（cash value）增长以及其他附加险效力均照常运作。

opts.t: The waived premiums are treated as an automatic policy loan that reduces the cash value and the future death benefit.
opts.w: 错在把完全伤残豁免保费（waiver of premium for total disability）与自动垫交保费贷款混为一谈。豁免是由保险公司承担保费责任，不会产生扣减现金价值的保单贷款。

opts.t: The base death benefit remains intact, but all dividends must be surrendered to the insurer to offset the waived premiums.
opts.w: 错在编造分红抵扣规则。在完全伤残豁免保费（waiver of premium for total disability）期间，保险公司不得要求没收客户的保单分红来抵充被豁免的保费。

checks.pt: 识别市场附加险模块组合、GIB向重疾扩散及单次与累计限额关系
checks.stem: An advisor is reviewing a client's guaranteed insurability benefit (GIB) rider that allows multiple option exercises over the life of the policy. The client believes that because multiple exercises are permitted, there is no restriction on how much coverage he can add at a single option date. Which statement accurately describes how GIB limits operate?
checks.zh: 一位顾问正在审阅客户的保证可保利益（GIB）附加险，该条款允许在保单有效期内多次行权。客户认为，既然允许分多次行权，那么在单次行权日可以加保多少保额就没有限制。下列哪项准确描述了 GIB 限额的运作机制？

opts.t: Allowing multiple exercises removes the single-exercise limit, so only a maximum age restriction is left to check.
opts.w: 错在混淆不同维度的约束条件。在保证可保利益（guaranteed insurability benefit, GIB）中，允许行使多次权利绝不等于取消单次加保上限（single-exercise limit）。

opts.t: The per-exercise limit, the number of exercises and the total limit are separate constraints, all to be checked.
opts.w: 正确。对于保证可保利益（guaranteed insurability benefit, GIB），一次最多能买多少（单次限额）、最多能买几次（次数上限）、累计总共能买多少（累计限额）以及最高行权年龄是相互独立的约束条件，允许多次行权与存在单次限额并不矛盾，必须同时核对。

opts.t: A policy can enforce either a single-exercise dollar limit or a cumulative dollar limit, but never both at the same time.
opts.w: 错在臆造二选一规则。保证可保利益（GIB）合同通常会同时设定单次限额（single limit）与累计限额（cumulative limit）来控制逆选择风险。

opts.t: Once the client exercises the GIB option for the first time, all remaining option dates are automatically forfeited.
opts.w: 错在把单次行权当成一次性作废条款。只要未达到保证可保利益（GIB）合同约定的次数上限、累计保额上限和最高年龄，后续约定周年日或触发事件仍可继续行权。

checks.pt: 不靠附加险名称断定是否扣减身故金，区分考试机制与当期合同信息
checks.stem: Nora holds a life insurance policy with an attached critical illness coverage rider. When she asks whether a critical illness payout will reduce her life insurance death benefit, her junior agent replies, "Because it has the word 'rider' in its name, it automatically deducts from the death benefit." Why is the junior agent's reasoning flawed?
checks.zh: Nora 持有一份附加了重疾保障条款的寿险保单。当她询问重疾理赔金是否会扣减她的寿险身故金时，初级代理人回答：「因为它的名字里有『附加险（rider）』这个词，所以它会自动从身故金里扣减。」为什么这位初级代理人的推理是错误的？

opts.t: Because any coverage labelled as a rider is legally required to pay an extra amount without ever reducing the base death benefit.
opts.w: 错在走入另一个极端（产品混淆）。实务中叫附加险（rider）的条款既可能是预支身故金的加速身故金（accelerated death benefit），也可能是另付保险金的条款，不能仅凭名字一概而论。

opts.t: Because a label cannot replace checking the cash flow: some CI riders pay separately, while accelerated DD benefits deduct.
opts.w: 正确。名称不能代替现金流机制：加速身故金下的重疾给付（dread disease, DD benefit）按设计会扣减后续身故金，但市场上有些附加在寿险上的重疾附加险（critical illness, CI rider）与独立重疾险一样另付保险金而不扣减身故金，因此必须核对合同给付前后的身故保额与主险存续状态。

opts.t: Because critical illness riders only waive future life insurance premiums and never pay out a lump-sum cash benefit at all.
opts.w: 错在把重疾给付（dread disease / critical illness rider）与完全伤残豁免保费（waiver of premium for total disability）混淆。重疾条款在满足疾病定义与存活期后提供一次性给付。

opts.t: Because only stand-alone critical illness policies deduct from the life insurance death benefit, whereas riders never do so.
opts.w: 错在完全颠倒了独立重疾险（stand-alone CI insurance）与预支型重疾给付（DD benefit）的机制（产品混淆）。独立重疾险按独立合同赔付，绝不会扣减另一张寿险的身故金。

checks.pt: 在真实场景中演练定期险附加险配比、代付人豁免纠偏与子女转换权
checks.stem: Hannah and her husband Leo have a son, Lucas, who was covered under a child coverage rider added to Hannah's life policy at birth. At age 8, Lucas was diagnosed with a chronic heart condition that made him uninsurable in the individual market. As Lucas approaches the rider's expiry age of 21, how can the family secure permanent life insurance for him?
checks.zh: Hannah 和丈夫 Leo 的儿子 Lucas 出生时就被纳入了 Hannah 寿险保单下的子女附加险保障。Lucas 在 8 岁时被诊断出患有慢性心脏病，导致他在个人保险市场上实质不可保。当 Lucas 临近该附加险 21 岁的到期年龄时，这个家庭如何为他获得永久寿险保障？

opts.t: Exercise the child rider's conversion right before it expires, getting him a permanent policy at standard rates with no medicals.
opts.w: 正确。子女附加险转换权（converting child coverage rider）允许在附加险到期前（如 21 岁前），免核保（without evidence of insurability）将保障转换为子女本人名下的个人永久险（部分保单允许放大至原保额 5 倍），保费按转换时年龄的标准费率计算，不因健康恶化加费。

opts.t: Wait until 31 days after the rider expires at age 21, then apply for a new term policy and accept a health surcharge on it.
opts.w: 错在「时限压缩」陷阱。子女附加险转换权（converting child coverage rider）必须在附加险到期前（before expiry）的合同窗口内行使，一旦过期错过窗口，实质不可保的子女将失去免核保保护。

opts.t: Convert the rider into a permanent policy with premiums locked in at the newborn rate from when Lucas was 15 days old.
opts.w: 错在「术语误读」陷阱。免核保转换（converting child coverage rider）承诺的是不因健康状况恶化而拒保或加费，但新永久险的保费必须按转换当时的年龄（如 21 岁）定价，而非出生满 15 天时的费率。

opts.t: Add a parent/payor waiver benefit to Hannah's policy, which automatically extends Lucas's child rider coverage for life.
opts.w: 错在「条款错配」陷阱。父母/代付人豁免（parent/payor waiver benefit）解决的是投保人身故或伤残时的保费豁免问题，并不能把有期限的子女附加险变成终身保障。

checks.pt: 排查十大高频陷阱（类别、范围、预支、跨章、窗口）与四项双口径
checks.stem: While reviewing a practice question on the waiver of premium for total disability attached to an individual life insurance policy, Kevin tries to apply the four-tier disability definition spectrum (including regular occupation and any occupation) from the disability income insurance module. What trap is Kevin falling into?
checks.zh: 在复习一道关于个人寿险保单所附完全伤残豁免保费条款的练习题时，Kevin 试图套用伤残收入险模块中的四级残疾定义光谱（包括本职工作与任何工作）。Kevin 掉进了哪一个考试陷阱？

opts.t: Confusing accelerated death benefits with stand-alone critical illness insurance when the two pay out in different ways.
opts.w: 错在张冠李戴。预支型加速身故金（accelerated death benefit）与独立重疾险（CI）的混淆属于重疾给付的产品混淆陷阱，与伤残豁免定义无关。

opts.t: Mixing chapters: the life policy waiver uses the contract's total disability test, not the four-tier income spectrum.
opts.w: 正确。这属于典型的「跨章串味」陷阱：寿险章节的完全伤残豁免保费（waiver of premium for total disability）使用的是合同定义的「完全伤残（total disability）」并持续满等待期这一门槛，与伤残收入险章节的四级残疾定义光谱（如 own occupation 等）是两套不同的判据。

opts.t: Assuming that a waiver of premium benefit is always built into the base policy for free and never shown as a separate charge.
opts.w: 错在偏离题干核心。虽然误以为保费豁免免费属于「定价误解（cost of coverage）」陷阱，但题干问的是套用跨章残疾定义的行为。

opts.t: Mistaking the policyholder for the life insured under a parent/payor waiver benefit when the two are different people.
opts.w: 错在混淆陷阱类型。投保人与被保险人分离时选错豁免属于「条款错配（parent/payor waiver vs. total disability waiver）」，而非跨章套用伤残定义光谱。

checks.pt: 明确官方基准核实状态与不同产品附约数字不可跨产品混用的边界
checks.stem: An advisor reads an insurer's participating life insurance advisor guide, which states that its children's term rider offers $10,000 to $25,000 of coverage for children aged 15 days to 17 years at a flat premium. When a client applies for a stand-alone term life policy from the same insurer, what is the proper way for the advisor to handle the children's rider details?
checks.zh: 一位顾问阅读了某保险公司的分红寿险顾问指南，其中写明其子女定期险附约可为出生满 15 天至 17 岁的子女提供 $10,000 至 $25,000 的保障，且保费为固定金额。当客户向同一家保险公司申请一份独立定期寿险保单时，顾问应当如何处理子女附约的细目？

opts.t: Apply the exact $10,000 to $25,000 range and age 17 limit automatically, because all products from the same insurer share identical rider rules.
opts.w: 错在跨产品盲目套用合同数字。分红险顾问指南中的子女定期险附加险（children's term rider）具体保额（$10,000–$25,000）和投保年龄（15 天至 17 岁）只适用于该指南对应的分红产品，不能自动套用到定期险或其他产品上。

opts.t: Promise the client that the rider face amount will automatically increase every year without additional premium if an educational webpage mentions the word "increasing".
opts.w: 错在以教育网页宣传词代替合同保额表。官网教育文章中单独一个「递增（increasing）」字样不能证明保额随时间自动递增，必须拿到具体附约保额表核对。

opts.t: Verify the specific rider contract and schedule for the term product being applied for, rather than assuming the participating policy's rider numbers apply.
opts.w: 正确。不同产品线（如分红寿险与定期寿险）的附加险（rider）条款与限额（limitations and exclusions）可能不同；顾问必须调取所申请产品的具体附约样本合同逐项确认收费、保额、保障对象与终止条件，不能跨产品混用。

opts.t: Refuse to quote any children's rider because child coverage can only be attached to participating whole life policies.
opts.w: 错在捏造投保限制。子女定期险附加险（family/child coverage rider）既可附加在终身寿险上，也可附加在定期寿险上，只需核对对应产品的具体附约条款即可。

checks.pt: 回答谁持有主保单、BC法定查阅权、逆选择控制及保费与给付税务
checks.stem: Elena is an employee covered under her employer's contributory group life insurance plan in BC. Her employer pays 60% of the group life premium ($480 per year) and Elena pays the remaining 40% ($320 per year) through payroll deduction. When a question arises about the exact wording of an exclusion, Elena asks whether she can inspect the master contract and how her premiums and death benefit are taxed. Which statement is correct?
checks.zh: Elena 是 BC 省一名参加雇主分摊型团体寿险计划的员工。雇主支付 60% 的团体寿险保费（每年 $480），Elena 通过工资扣款支付剩余 40%（每年 $320）。当对某项除外责任的确切措辞产生疑问时，Elena 询问她是否可以查阅总合同，以及她的保费和身故保险金如何征税。下列哪项陈述是正确的？

opts.t: BC law lets Elena get a copy of the master policy from the insurer, the $480 employer share is a taxable benefit, and the death benefit is tax-free.
opts.w: 正确。根据 BC《Insurance Act》s41(5)(b)，团体被保险人（group life insured）在提出请求并给予合理通知后有权向保险人查阅并取得总合同（master contract）副本（首份免费）；雇主代付的 $480 保费计入员工当年应税福利（taxable benefit），而寿险身故保险金本金通常免所得税。

opts.t: Elena is only permitted to read the benefit booklet because she is not the policyholder, and 60% of any future death benefit will be taxable to her beneficiary.
opts.w: 错误。落入『主保单查阅权混淆』与『跨险种税务方向记反』两个陷阱：BC 省成员依法享有取阅主保单权，并非只能看福利手册（benefit booklet）；且团体寿险在保费端收税，身故金本金不按雇主出资比例征税。

opts.t: Elena can deduct her $320 employee contribution on her personal tax return, while the $480 employer-paid portion is not a taxable benefit until a claim is paid.
opts.w: 错误。落入『员工自付可抵扣』与『跨险种税务方向记反』陷阱：员工自付的团体寿险保费不可抵扣（not deductible），而雇主支付的保费在当年即构成应税福利（taxable benefit）。

opts.t: Elena holds full ownership rights to amend the master contract directly, and the entire $800 total premium is reported as a taxable benefit on her T4 slip.
opts.w: 错误。落入『合同当事人角色混淆』陷阱：计划发起人（plan sponsor，即雇主）才是主保单持有人，员工不拥有主保单的全部管理或修改权；且只有雇主支付的 $480 属于应税福利，员工自付的 $320 不计入应税福利。

checks.pt: 回答非魁省20万转换上限、31天缴费窗口及BC保费税
checks.stem: Marcus, age 49, works in Victoria, BC and has $260,000 of basic group life coverage. His employment terminates on May 10, ending his group coverage that day. Under the standard industry guideline rules tested on the exam for non-Quebec provinces, what must Marcus do to exercise his conversion privilege without medical evidence, and how much can he convert?
checks.zh: 49 岁的 Marcus 在 BC 省维多利亚工作，拥有 $260,000 的团体基础寿险保障。他的雇佣关系于 5 月 10 日终止，团体保障于当日结束。根据考试针对非魁北克省份考查的标准行业指引规则，Marcus 必须怎么做才能在不提供健康证明的情况下行使转换权，且最多能转换多少保额？

opts.t: He can convert the full $260,000 within 60 days without medical evidence, provided he also pays the 2% BC provincial premium tax directly to the government.
opts.w: 错误。落入『转换上限与窗口混淆』及『保费税主体混淆』陷阱：非魁省免核保转换上限为 $200,000（不能转全部 $260,000），标准转换窗口为 31 天而非 60 天，且 BC 省 2% 保费税由持牌保险人申报缴纳，不是员工直接向政府缴纳。

opts.t: He can convert up to $200,000 without evidence of insurability if he submits the application and pays the first modal premium within 31 days of termination.
opts.w: 正确。依据 CLHIA Guideline G3 及现行核实标准，非魁省地区（含 BC）65 岁前终止保障时，免健康证明转换权（conversion privilege）上限为 $200,000 或原保额中较小者（故 $260,000 中可免核保转 $200,000），且须在 31 天窗口内提交申请并缴清首期保费。

opts.t: He can convert up to $400,000 without medical evidence as long as he mails the signed application form within 31 days, with the first premium due 20 days later.
opts.w: 错误。落入『魁省数字错配』与『漏看窗口内缴费条件』陷阱：$400,000 是魁北克省的转换上限而非 BC 省上限；且首期保费必须在 31 天转换窗口内缴清，不能只交申请表而延后缴费。

opts.t: He cannot convert any coverage unless his employer cancels the entire master contract, because individual termination does not trigger a conversion privilege.
opts.w: 错误。落入『转换触发条件遗漏』陷阱：员工离职导致团体保障终止正是触发转换权（conversion privilege）的典型情形，并非只有整个主保单取消时才能转换。

checks.pt: 回答试用期与在职要求、高龄递减、家属险及AD&D比例
checks.stem: Nadia is covered for $100,000 under her employer's group life and AD&D plan, which includes family AD&D coverage using the standard exam percentages and a flat-rate dependant life benefit. Nadia is married and has two eligible children aged 6 and 9. If her spouse and one child both die in a car accident, what is the spouse's AD&D benefit and how is Nadia's dependant life premium determined?
checks.zh: Nadia 在雇主的团体寿险及意外身故与伤残险（AD&D）计划下享有 $100,000 保额，该计划包含采用标准考试口径百分比的家属 AD&D 保障以及统一费率的家属寿险。Nadia 已婚并育有两名分别为 6 岁和 9 岁的合资格子女。如果她的配偶和一名子女在车祸中双双身故，配偶的 AD&D 给付是多少，且 Nadia 的家属寿险保费是如何确定的？

opts.t: The spouse's AD&D coverage is $50,000, and Nadia's dependant life premium increases proportionally for each additional child covered.
opts.w: 错误。落入『AD&D 有无子女比例混淆』与『家属险按人头加费』两个陷阱：50% 仅适用于只覆盖配偶、无子女的情形；且采用统一家庭保费（flat family rate）的家属寿险不随合资格子女人数逐个增加保费。

opts.t: The spouse's AD&D benefit is $40,000 (the child's is $15,000), and the flat-rate dependant premium does not rise with the number of children.
opts.w: 正确。按考试口径的家属 AD&D（dependant AD&D）示例，当同时覆盖配偶与子女时，配偶保额为会员保额的 40%（$40,000）、每名子女为 15%（$15,000）；同时，采用统一家庭费率的家属寿险（dependant life coverage）保费不随合资格家属人数逐个增加。

opts.t: The spouse's AD&D coverage is $40,000, but it is paid only as a monthly survivor income benefit until the surviving child turns 18.
opts.w: 错误。落入『AD&D 与遗属收入给付概念混淆』陷阱：家属 AD&D 是一次性意外身故给付，而按月发放的是另一项自选购买的遗属收入给付（survivor income benefits）。

opts.t: The spouse's AD&D coverage is $25,000, and children are only eligible for dependant coverage after they reach age 14.
opts.w: 错误。落入『年龄单位记混』陷阱：子女符合家属寿险资格的起点年龄示例是出生满 14 天（14 days），而非 14 岁；配偶在有子女时的 AD&D 比例示例是 40%（$40,000）而非 25%。

checks.pt: 回答核保宽松度与保额上限反向排列、团体险经纪与TPA角色
checks.stem: A medium-sized employer in BC wants to set up a group life plan and also asks how departing employees who want more than the $200,000 non-medical conversion limit are handled in the market. Based on the relationship between underwriting requirements, coverage limits, and group plan administration, which explanation is accurate?
checks.zh: BC 省一家中型雇主希望设立团体寿险计划，并询问市场上如何处理离职员工想要高于 $200,000 免体检转换上限的需求。基于核保要求、保额上限与团体计划管理之间的关系，下列哪项解释是准确的？

opts.t: Employers typically negotiate directly with actuaries without intermediaries, and departing employees can never obtain more than $200,000 from a group insurer even if they answer health questions.
opts.w: 错误。忽略了团体险经纪与第三方管理商（TPA）在计划设计与续保中的核心角色，且市场上有通过回答简化健康问题换取更高转换上限和更长窗口的通道。

opts.t: Brokers or TPAs help employers design and run plans, and options that ask simplified health questions can offer more than the non-medical limit and a longer window.
opts.w: 正确。雇主通常借助团体险经纪或第三方管理商（TPA）完成计划设计、续保谈判与理赔行政；同时，遵循『保障强度与核保宽松度呈反向排列』逻辑，愿意回答简化健康问题的通道可换取高于 $200,000 免核保上限的保额与更长申请窗口（如 60 天）。

opts.t: Contractual conversion commitments can be revoked at any time by the insurer without notice simply because they originated from an industry guideline.
opts.w: 错误。行业指引、适用法律和具体合同是不同依据，写入合同中的转换承诺（conversion privilege）具有合同约束力，不能因为起源于行业自律指引就被当成可随意撤回。

opts.t: The 2% BC provincial insurance premium tax paid by the insurer replaces the employee's personal income tax obligation on employer-paid group life premiums.
opts.w: 错误。落入『保费税与个人应税福利混淆』陷阱：保险人申报缴纳的 2% 省级保险保费税与雇主支付保费形成的员工个人应税福利（taxable benefit）是完全独立的两件事，不能互相替代。

checks.pt: 回答考试口径与现行合同依据的区分、魁省与BC规则不混用
checks.stem: An advisor in BC is helping a departing group member who wants to know whether to rely on Quebec's $10,000 to $400,000 statutory conversion range or whether she has two different post-employment continuation pathways with 31-day and 60-day deadlines. How should the advisor apply the rules?
checks.zh: BC 省一名顾问正在协助一位即将离职的团体成员，该成员想知道是否应依据魁北克省 $10,000 至 $400,000 的成文转换区间，以及面对 31 天免核保转换和 60 天简化健康问卷两条不同通道时该如何抉择。顾问应如何适用规则？

opts.t: Apply Quebec's $400,000 limit to the BC member because non-Quebec provinces have no statutory protections of any kind in group insurance.
opts.w: 错误。落入『魁省条件搬给 BC 客户』与『误以为 BC 无法定权利』陷阱：魁省 $400,000 上限不适用于 BC 客户，且 BC《Insurance Act》已赋予成员查阅主保单及获得保障证明等法定权利。

opts.t: Wait until day 55 to see if the 60-day simplified-health application is approved before deciding whether to apply for the 31-day guaranteed conversion.
opts.w: 错误。落入『错过 31 天保证转换窗口』的实务陷阱：31 天保证免核保转换窗口一旦届满即丧失，绝不能为了等 60 天简化核保通道的答复而错过前一条 31 天保证转换窗口。

opts.t: Check her own group contract for limits and deadlines, and weigh the 31-day guaranteed conversion against any 60-day health-question option without missing day 31.
opts.w: 正确。不能把魁省规则套用给 BC 客户，也不能用单一公司须知代替全省规则；实务中应核对成员的具体团体合同（master contract），并列比较资格、保额、价格与终止年龄，且绝不能因等待 60 天通道答复而错过 31 天保证转换（conversion privilege）窗口。

opts.t: Ignore the group contract wording altogether, because CLHIA Guideline G3 automatically overrides the terms of every group policy issued in BC.
opts.w: 错误。落入『行业指引凌驾于法条与合同』陷阱：法条优先于行业指引，且具体成员的转换额度、资格及期限必须回到其适用合同与保险人书面确认核对。

checks.pt: 回答31天转换实算、分级应税福利计算及65岁退休核对
checks.stem: Devon is a department director at a BC distribution firm earning $90,000 per year. Under the group plan's membership classes, directors receive basic life coverage of 2 times annual salary while general staff receive 1 times salary. The total annual premium for Devon's basic life coverage is $1,000, of which the employer pays 80% and Devon pays 20%. If Devon dies while employed this year, what are the tax and benefit amounts?
checks.zh: Devon 是 BC 省一家分销公司的部门总监，年薪 $90,000。根据团体计划的会籍分级，总监级别享有 2 倍年薪的基础寿险保额，普通员工为 1 倍年薪。Devon 基础寿险的全年总保费为 $1,000，其中雇主支付 80%，Devon 自付 20%。如果 Devon 今年在职期间身故，税务和保险金数额分别是多少？

opts.t: Devon's taxable benefit this year is $800, and his beneficiary receives a $180,000 tax-free death benefit.
opts.w: 正确。按会籍分级（membership class），总监保额为 2 倍年薪即 $180,000；雇主代付的 80% 保费（$800）计入 Devon 当年的应税福利（taxable benefit），而受益人领取的 $180,000 寿险身故保险金本金全额免所得税。

opts.t: Devon's taxable benefit this year is $1,000, and his beneficiary receives a $90,000 tax-free death benefit.
opts.w: 错误。落入『漏看会籍分级』与『把员工自付保费也算进应税福利』两个陷阱：Devon 属于总监分级（2 倍年薪 $180,000 而非普通员工 1 倍 $90,000），且自付的 $200 不属于应税福利。

opts.t: Devon has no taxable benefit on the premiums, but 80% of the $180,000 death benefit ($144,000) is taxable to his beneficiary.
opts.w: 错误。落入『跨险种税务方向记反』陷阱：把保费端应税与给付端免税颠倒，且错误地按雇主出资比例对寿险身故金征税。

opts.t: Devon can deduct his $200 premium payment, and his beneficiary receives $200,000 because the conversion limit automatically increases his coverage.
opts.w: 错误。落入『员工保费不可抵扣』与『把 $200,000 转换上限当成保额本身』陷阱：员工自付保费不可抵扣，且 $200,000 是离职转换上限，不会把在职 $180,000 保额自动调高到 $200,000。

checks.pt: 回答十大常见陷阱辨析与考场vs柜台四项双口径处理原则
checks.stem: An employer in BC amends its group life master contract to eliminate the membership class for part-time warehouse clerks, while keeping the rest of the group plan active. Clara, a part-time clerk who is healthy and working, also had optional survivor income benefits on her coverage. Which statement accurately avoids the common exam traps regarding Clara's situation?
checks.zh: BC 省一家雇主修改其团体寿险总合同，取消了兼职仓库文员这一会籍分级，同时保留团体计划的其余部分继续有效。Clara 是一名健康且在岗的兼职文员，她此前还附带自选了遗属收入给付。关于 Clara 的情况，下列哪项陈述准确避开了常见考试陷阱？

opts.t: Eliminating her membership class merely reduces Clara's coverage by half, and survivor income benefits are simply a partial lump-sum advance of her basic death benefit.
opts.w: 错误。同时落入『把资格丧失当成保额降低』和『把遗属收入给付当成身故金一部分』两个陷阱：取消某会籍类别会导致该类别成员失去参保资格而非保额减半；遗属收入给付（survivor income benefits）是按月发放的独立补贴，不是一次性身故金的组成部分。

opts.t: Clara loses eligibility when her class ends, so she should get notice of termination and conversion options, and survivor income is a separate monthly benefit.
opts.w: 正确。发起人取消某会籍分级（membership class）时，该类别会员在新计划下直接失去参保资格（而非保额打折），应取得生效日、原保障结束日及转换权（conversion privilege）通知；同时遗属收入给付（survivor income benefits）是叠加在一次性身故金之外按月发放的独立给付。

opts.t: Because the employer did not cancel the entire master contract, Clara has no conversion rights and cannot request to see the master policy wording in BC.
opts.w: 错误。落入『误以为只有整个计划取消才有权利』与『否定 BC 法定查阅权』陷阱：会员因会籍类别取消而终止保障时需核对转换或延续衔接，且 BC《Insurance Act》赋予成员查阅主保单副本的权利。

opts.t: If Clara had been on approved disability waiver of premium before the class was eliminated, her waiver and coverage would immediately be wiped out with no further insurer liability.
opts.w: 错误。落入『假定计划变动将已有伤残豁免一笔注销』陷阱：对于已处于伤残保费豁免（waiver of premium）或已发生索赔的会员，即使雇主调整或终止合同，其豁免与保障仍须持续或核对责任归属，不能假定一笔注销。

checks.pt: 解释身故给付免税边界、ACB组成与保单利得100%计入所得。
checks.stem: Marcus owns an exempt whole life policy acquired in 2010 with no policy loans or dividends taken. To date, he has paid $36,000 in cumulative premiums, the insurer's cumulative net cost of pure insurance (NCPI) is $11,000, and the cash surrender value (CSV) is $40,000. If Marcus fully surrenders the policy today, how much must be included in his taxable income?
checks.zh: Marcus持有一张2010年购入的免税终身寿险保单，无保单贷款或已领红利。截至目前，他累计缴纳保费$36,000，保险公司记录的累计纯保险净成本（NCPI）为$11,000，现金退保价值（CSV）为$40,000。如果Marcus今天全额退保，有多少金额必须计入他的应税收入？

opts.t: $4,000, calculated as the cash surrender value minus cumulative premiums paid.
opts.w: 错误。这是把已缴保费（$36,000）直接当成调整后成本基础（adjusted cost basis, ACB）的常见陷阱，忽略了G2/G3保单计算ACB时必须从累计保费中减去累计纯保险净成本（NCPI $11,000）。

opts.t: $7,500, applying the 50% capital gains inclusion rate to the $15,000 gain.
opts.w: 错误。虽然正确算出了$15,000的保单利得（policy gain），但落入了「把保单利得当成资本利得（capital gain）按50%计入」的第一号考试陷阱；保单利得必须100%计入应税收入。

opts.t: $15,000, because 100% of the policy gain over the $25,000 ACB is taxable income.
opts.w: 正确。先算调整后成本基础（adjusted cost basis, ACB）＝累计保费$36,000 − 累计纯保险净成本（NCPI）$11,000 ＝ $25,000；全额退保的保单利得（policy gain）＝ 处置所得（CSV $40,000）− ACB（$25,000）＝ $15,000，且保单利得100%计入应税收入。

opts.t: $0, because cash values inside an exempt life insurance policy are completely tax-free.
opts.w: 错误。混淆了「身故给付（death benefit）免税」与「生前退保处置（disposition）应税」；免税保单（exempt policy）只是在持有期间递延保内增值，生前全额退保触发处置，超出ACB的正差额必须交税。

checks.pt: 辨析资本利得计入率、LCGE、AMT、税阶与BC遗嘱认证费。
checks.stem: Victor died domiciled in British Columbia leaving an estate valued at $40,000 that must pass through probate, along with a life insurance policy naming his sister directly as beneficiary. Under the BC probate fee scale (which matches the LLQP exam syllabus scale), what is the proportional BC probate fee on the estate value before adding the flat court filing fee?
checks.zh: Victor生前定居在BC省，身故后留下一笔估值$40,000且须经遗嘱认证的遗产，以及一张直接指定其姐姐为具名受益人的寿险保单。按BC省遗嘱认证费分档标准（与LLQP考试口径一致），在加上固定法院提交费之前，针对该遗产估值按比例计算的BC省遗嘱认证费是多少？

opts.t: $90, based on $6 per $1,000 on the $15,000 portion above the $25,000 exemption.
opts.w: 正确。BC省遗嘱认证费（probate fee）规则在2022考试口径与2026现行法下完全一致：直接指定姐姐为具名受益人的寿险赔款绕开遗产；遗产估值≤$25,000部分免征，$25,000至$50,000部分每$1,000收$6，因此（$40,000 − $25,000）÷ $1,000 × $6 ＝ $90（另注：固定法院提交费考试口径印$208，现行法为$200）。

opts.t: $240, based on $6 per $1,000 applied to the entire $40,000 estate value.
opts.w: 错误。漏掉了首$25,000遗产估值免征遗嘱认证费（probate fee）的豁免档位，误对全部$40,000按每$1,000收$6计费。

opts.t: $210, based on $14 per $1,000 on the $15,000 portion above $25,000.
opts.w: 错误。混淆了分档费率：每$1,000收$14仅适用于遗产估值超过$50,000的部分，而$25,000至$50,000区间适用的是每$1,000收$6。

opts.t: $0, because having a named beneficiary on the life policy exempts the entire estate.
opts.w: 错误。保单指定具名受益人（named beneficiary）仅使该笔保险赔款本身不进入遗产从而免交遗嘱认证费，并不能免除死者名下其他$40,000遗产的遗嘱认证费。

checks.pt: 掌握处置触发表、保单贷款与利息抵扣、免税测试及CDA计算。
checks.stem: Nora's exempt universal life policy has a CSV of $45,000; its ACB is $18,000. Rather than taking a policy loan from the insurer, she assigns the policy to a bank as collateral for a $25,000 loan used to buy dividend-paying shares in a non-registered account. What is the immediate tax result?
checks.zh: Nora持有一张免税万能寿险保单，现金退保价值（CSV）为$45,000，调整后成本基础（ACB）为$18,000。她没有向保险公司申请保单贷款，而是将保单作为担保物抵押给银行，借入$25,000用于在非注册账户中购买派息股票。当期的即时税务后果是什么？

opts.t: She must report a $7,000 taxable policy gain because the $25,000 loan exceeds her $18,000 ACB.
opts.w: 错误。落入了将「银行担保转让（collateral assignment）」与「向保险公司申请保单贷款（policy loan）」混同的陷阱；只有保单贷款才按贷款额减ACB计算保单利得，担保转让不是处置。

opts.t: No disposition occurs, and the loan interest can generally be deducted because the borrowed money is used to earn taxable income.
opts.w: 正确。用免税保单向银行作担保转让（collateral assignment）不触发处置（disposition），保内增值继续递延；同时借入资金用于购买派息股票（产生应税收入而非仅指望资本利得），符合利息扣除条件时贷款利息可抵税。

opts.t: She triggers a deemed disposition equal to the $45,000 CSV because a bank now holds security over the policy.
opts.w: 错误。混淆了担保转让（collateral assignment）与改变保单所有权的绝对转让（absolute assignment）；把保单押给银行作贷款担保并不转移所有权，不触发处置。

opts.t: There is no disposition of the policy, but loan interest can never be deducted when a life policy is used as collateral.
opts.w: 错误。贷款利息能否抵扣取决于「借来的钱花在哪里（是否用于赚取应税收入）」，而不是看抵押物是不是寿险保单。

checks.pt: 掌握遗产均衡险种选择与慈善捐赠两条路径的税务差异。
checks.stem: Evelyn continues to own her permanent life insurance policy personally and simply designates a registered charity as the beneficiary to receive the death benefit upon her passing. How are the premiums she pays during her lifetime and the eventual death benefit treated for tax purposes?
checks.zh: Evelyn继续以个人名义保留其永久寿险保单的所有权，仅将一家注册慈善机构指定为身故受益人，以便在她去世时领取身故给付。她在生前缴纳的保费以及最终的身故给付在税务上如何处理？

opts.t: She receives annual charitable donation tax receipts for every premium paid during her lifetime, and no tax credit is available at death.
opts.w: 错误。混淆了慈善捐赠的两条路径：只有将保单所有权绝对转让给合资格慈善机构时，日后缴纳的保费才符合捐赠收据条件；保留保单所有权仅指定机构为受益人时，生前保费不能开具慈善捐赠收据。

opts.t: She triggers an immediate taxable disposition under s.148(7) upon naming the charity as beneficiary.
opts.w: 错误。仅仅指定或变更受益人（beneficiary designation）并不改变保单所有权，不构成生前转让或处置（disposition），因此不会触发s.148(7)的处置所得计算。

opts.t: The charity issues a donation receipt today equal to the policy's cash surrender value, and future premiums are non-deductible.
opts.w: 错误。由于Evelyn保留了保单所有权而未作生前转让，慈善机构在当期既未取得保单所有权，也不能就保单价值开具当期捐赠收据。

opts.t: Her premiums earn no donation receipts, but the death benefit paid to the charity generally supports a donation credit for her estate or final returns.
opts.w: 正确。保留所有权、仅指定合资格慈善机构领取身故给付（death benefit）时，生前保费不具捐赠收据资格；身故后支付给机构的赔款通常视为遗产作出捐赠，符合合格遗产（GRE）等条件时可用于遗产年度、死者最后一年或前一年申报慈善捐赠税收抵免（charitable donations tax credit）。

checks.pt: 掌握G1至G3代次划分、2017参数更新与丧失既得权。
checks.stem: Arthur bought an exempt whole life policy in 2012 (a G2 policy) that includes a term life rider. In 2026, he applies to add additional coverage to the policy that requires medical underwriting. How does the Income Tax Act treat this change with respect to the policy's grandfathering status?
checks.zh: Arthur在2012年购买了一张含定期附加险的免税终身寿险保单（属G2保单）。2026年，他申请在该保单中增加需要经过医疗核保的额外保额。在保单既得权（grandfathering）身份方面，《所得税法》如何处理这一变更？

opts.t: Adding medically underwritten coverage after 2016 can make the policy lose G2 treatment and fall under G3 rules from that point.
opts.w: 正确。依ITA s.148(11)，2016年后对G2保单进行定期保障转永久保障，或加入需要医疗核保（medical underwriting）的保障，会在该实际触发时点丧失G2既得权（grandfathering），视同新签发而转用G3免税测试规则。

opts.t: The policy retroactively loses its G2 status effective January 1, 2017, requiring amended tax returns since that year.
opts.w: 错误。讲义明确指出，s.148(11)是在实际触发变更的时点视同新签发转用G3规则，不能把2017年以后才发生的转换或加保追溯写成自2017-01-01起已失去旧待遇。

opts.t: Any policy issued before 2017 permanently retains G2 rules regardless of subsequent underwriting changes.
opts.w: 错误。落入了「老保单永远不会降级」的误区；2017年后若发生需要医疗核保的加保或定期转永久等触发事件，G2保单会失去既得权并适用G3规则。

opts.t: The change is governed by CLHIA Guideline G2 on variable contract disclosure rather than the Income Tax Act.
opts.w: 错误。混淆了同名简称：本章的G1/G2/G3是按取得日期划分的税法保单代次（ITA s.148），并非CLHIA发布的《Guideline G1/G2/G3》行业披露指引。

checks.pt: 演练保单借款还款抵扣、配偶展期退出与遗嘱认证豁免案例。
checks.stem: Two years ago, Gavin took a $15,000 policy loan from his universal life policy when its ACB was $11,000, reporting a $4,000 taxable policy gain and reducing his ACB to zero. Assuming no other premiums, NCPI, or adjustments occurred in the interim, if Gavin repays $6,000 of the policy loan this year, what is the tax effect?
checks.zh: 两年前，Gavin在万能寿险保单ACB为$11,000时申请了$15,000保单贷款，申报了$4,000应税保单利得并将ACB降至零。假设期间无其他保费、NCPI或调整，如果Gavin今年偿还$6,000保单贷款，税务后果是什么？

opts.t: He can deduct the entire $6,000 repayment from his taxable income this year, and his ACB remains $0.
opts.w: 错误。偿还保单贷款可从当年应税收入中抵扣的金额，以他此前因该贷款已申报的应税保单利得（policy gain $4,000）为上限，不能把超出已报利得的$2,000也拿去抵扣应税所得。

opts.t: He cannot claim any tax deduction, and his ACB increases by the full $6,000 to $6,000.
opts.w: 错误。忽略了偿还此前已触发应税保单利得的保单贷款时，税法允许先就已申报利得（$4,000）申请相应所得扣除，只有超出已报利得的还款余额（$2,000）才计入ACB。

opts.t: He can deduct $4,000 from his taxable income to offset the previously taxed gain, and his ACB increases to $2,000.
opts.w: 正确。Gavin偿还$6,000保单贷款（policy loan）时，首先可抵扣他此前已申报的$4,000保单利得对应的应税所得，剩余的$6,000 − $4,000 ＝ $2,000重新计入调整后成本基础（ACB），使ACB由零恢复至$2,000。

opts.t: He must report an additional $2,000 policy gain because the repayment is less than the original loan balance.
opts.w: 错误。偿还保单贷款不会产生新的保单利得，反而能抵扣此前已报利得并恢复ACB。

checks.pt: 排查八大高频考场陷阱与非免税单视同处置规则。
checks.stem: A universal life policy fails the annual exempt test on its policy anniversary and cannot be adjusted within the permitted timeframe, causing it to become a non-exempt policy. The policyowner makes no cash withdrawal. What is the tax consequence?
checks.zh: 一张万能寿险保单在保单周年日未通过年度免税测试（exempt test），且未能在允许期限内完成修正，从而变为非免税单（non-exempt policy）。保单持有人没有提取任何现金。税务后果是什么？

opts.t: There is no tax consequence until the policyowner actually withdraws cash or surrenders the contract.
opts.w: 错误。这是第七节第8条明确指出的最高频反直觉陷阱：「既然没有实际提取现金，就不产生税务后果」是错的，变为非免税单会立即触发视同处置（deemed disposition）。

opts.t: There is a deemed disposition based on the accumulating fund minus ACB, and the policy's growth is taxed yearly from then on.
opts.w: 正确。保单一旦失去免税身份变为非免税单（non-exempt policy），依ITA s.148(2)(d)立即触发视同处置（deemed disposition），以法定累积基金（accumulating fund）减ACB计算当期应税利得，且此后年度收益须按年计提纳税。

opts.t: Only 50% of the excess cash value over the exempt test policy limit is taxed as a capital gain.
opts.w: 错误。保单变为非免税单触发的是寿险保单视同处置，所得按100%计入应税收入，绝不适用资本利得（capital gain）50%计入率。

opts.t: The death benefit remains completely unaffected and future cash value growth continues to defer tax until death.
opts.w: 错误。非免税单（non-exempt policy）不仅在丧失免税身份时触发视同处置，此后的账户价值年度收益也须按年应税，且死亡前还受ITA s.148(2)(b)视同处置规则约束。

checks.pt: 企业身故三大冲击、三种组织形式差异与四类商业寿险需求。
checks.stem: Marcus operates a catering business as a sole proprietorship, while his sister Elena owns 100% of the shares of an incorporated graphic design studio. Neither has a spouse. If both Marcus and Elena were to die unexpectedly today, how would the tax treatment of their business interests differ upon death?
checks.zh: Marcus 以独资企业形式经营一家餐饮服务店，而他的姐姐 Elena 持有一家注册为有限公司的平面设计工作室 100% 的股份。两人都没有配偶。如果 Marcus 和 Elena 今天不幸意外身故，他们的企业权益在身故时的税务处理有何不同？

opts.t: Marcus's business has no separate ACB, so its assets are deemed disposed of with his estate, while for Elena only her shares, not the company's own assets, are deemed disposed of.
opts.w: 正确。独资企业（sole proprietorship）在法律上与业主是同一实体，没有独立的调整后成本基础（adjusted cost basis, ACB），身故时企业资产随遗产直接视同处置；公司（corporation）是独立法律实体，股权有独立 ACB，股东身故视同处置的是股份而非公司本身的资产。

opts.t: Both businesses are treated as separate legal entities at death, meaning only the ownership units of the sole proprietorship and the shares of the corporation are deemed disposed of at fair market value.
opts.w: 错误。独资企业并不是独立法律实体，也没有独立的调整后成本基础（ACB）可供单独处置或继承，这是把独资企业与公司的法律属性混为一谈的陷阱。

opts.t: Elena's estate becomes personally liable for all ordinary trade debts of the graphic design corporation, while Marcus's estate is shielded from business creditors once his sole proprietorship ceases operations.
opts.w: 错误。颠倒了责任规则：公司股东原则上不对公司一般债务负责（除非提供个人担保等），而独资企业与业主是同一实体，业主遗产仍须面对企业债务。

opts.t: Marcus's sole proprietorship automatically qualifies for a tax-deferred rollover to his adult children, whereas Elena's corporate shares must be liquidated immediately by the corporate creditors.
opts.w: 错误。依据 ITA s.70(5)，一般资本财产在死亡前按公允市值视同处置（配偶或符合条件的农渔业财产除外），独资企业资产传给成年子女并无自动免税展期。

checks.pt: LCGE 双口径数值与资格、小企业税率差及关键人保额估算法。
checks.stem: A manufacturing firm wants to determine an appropriate face amount of key person life insurance for its lead robotics specialist. The specialist earns an annual salary of $150,000. The firm's gross profit is $2,000,000 per year, of which the specialist's work directly accounts for 25%, and it would take 2 years to find and train an equivalent replacement. Using the profit contribution method, what is the estimated coverage need?
checks.zh: 一家制造企业希望为其首席机器人专家确定合适的关键人寿险保额。该专家年薪为 $150,000。公司年毛利润为 $2,000,000，其中该专家直接负责的业务贡献占 25%，预计找到并培养出同等水平的替代者需要 2 年时间。若采用利润贡献法估算，所需的保障额度是多少？

opts.t: $300,000, calculated by multiplying the specialist's annual salary of $150,000 by the 2-year replacement period.
opts.w: 错误。按年薪乘以倍数属于收入/薪酬倍数法（income/salary multiple method）的思路，而非利润贡献法。

opts.t: $500,000, representing a single year's share of the firm's gross profit attributable to the specialist without factoring in the replacement timeframe.
opts.w: 错误。利润贡献法（profit contribution method）不仅要算关键人对年毛利润的贡献份额（$2,000,000 × 25% = $500,000），还必须乘以培养等效替代者所需的年限（2 年）。

opts.t: $1,000,000, calculated by multiplying the $2,000,000 annual gross profit by the 25% contribution share and the 2-year replacement period.
opts.w: 正确。利润贡献法（profit contribution method）估算该关键人主导业务对企业毛利润的贡献份额（$2,000,000 × 25% = $500,000/年），再乘以培养等效替代者所需的时间（2 年），得出 $1,000,000。

opts.t: $650,000, determined by taking the mandatory statutory average of the salary multiple and a single year's gross profit share.
opts.w: 错误。考试口径并无法定公式要求取不同方法的平均值，核保时须解释各方法覆盖的损失并提交财务资料佐证。

checks.pt: 买卖协议四要素、三种资金结构税务后果与 CDA 分配机制。
checks.stem: Two equal shareholders of a private corporation have a lawyer draft a buy-sell agreement. The agreement binds the deceased shareholder's estate to sell, obligates the surviving shareholder to buy, and sets a clear valuation formula for the shares. However, neither the corporation nor the shareholders have set aside funds or purchased life insurance. Why is this buy-sell agreement still vulnerable to failure?
checks.zh: 一家私人公司的两名等额股东请律师起草了一份买卖协议。协议规定亡故股东的遗产必须出售股份，幸存股东必须买入，并设定了清晰的股份定价公式。但公司和股东都没有预留资金或购买寿险。为什么这份买卖协议在执行时仍然极易失败？

opts.t: Because a buy-sell agreement is legally void unless the corporation's lender also signs it as a co-owner of the shares being sold.
opts.w: 错误。买卖协议的有效性并不要求贷款人成为股份共有人，核心缺陷在于缺少资金来源。

opts.t: Because it lacks guaranteed funding, the most critical of the four conditions, so cash may not be there when a death triggers the purchase.
opts.w: 正确。买卖协议（buy-sell agreement）必须同时满足保证有买家（guaranteed buyer）、保证价格（guaranteed value）、强制出售（mandatory sale）和保证资金（guaranteed funding）四个条件；缺少保证资金会使协议在需要付款的那一刻因没有现金流而沦为一纸空文。

opts.t: Because mandatory sale clauses can be enforced only between partners in a partnership and never between corporate shareholders.
opts.w: 错误。强制出售（mandatory sale）是买卖协议的标准四要素之一，同样适用于公司股东与合伙企业的合伙人。

opts.t: Because without life insurance, the deceased shareholder's shares are exempt from deemed disposition at death.
opts.w: 错误。无论是否配置寿险，股东身故时其股份仍须依 ITA s.70(5) 按公允市值视同处置。

checks.pt: 商业保险产品配置、T2054 表申报与三方专业协作流程。
checks.stem: After a key shareholder dies, a private corporation receives a tax-free life insurance death benefit and credits the eligible portion to its capital dividend account (CDA). Before distributing this amount as a tax-free capital dividend to the surviving Canadian-resident shareholders, what administrative step and professional approach are appropriate?
checks.zh: 在一名核心股东身故后，一家私人公司收到了免税寿险身故给付，并将符合条件的部分计入其资本红利账户（CDA）。在将这笔款项作为免税资本红利派发给幸存的加拿大税务居民股东之前，应当采取什么正式行政步骤与专业协作方式？

opts.t: The insurance agent alone should draft the corporate resolution and transfer the funds immediately without filing any tax election forms.
opts.w: 错误。企业寿险与 CDA 分配涉及复杂税法与公司程序，不能由代理人独自起草决议并不经申报直接发钱。

opts.t: The corporation should verify its CDA balance and file Form T2054 to elect the capital dividend, working with its tax accountant and lawyer.
opts.w: 正确。企业需通过正式渠道核验资本红利账户（capital dividend account, CDA）余额并提交 T2054 表（Form T2054，即 ITA s.83(2) 资本红利选择表）完成有效资本红利选择，且实务中需代理人、公司税务会计师与企业律师三方协作。

opts.t: The surviving shareholders must first report the entire death benefit on their personal income tax returns and claim a personal refund.
opts.w: 错误。公司是保单受益人，身故金先免税进入公司账户并通过 CDA 机制免税派发，不需要股东先按个人应税收入全额申报。

opts.t: The corporation must convert its existing life insurance policy into a specialized government-issued CDA certificate before paying dividends.
opts.w: 错误。并不存在所谓政府签发的 CDA 专用凭证，而是由公司依据税法计算并提交 T2054 表进行资本红利选择。

checks.pt: 无协议传承的家族博弈风险及用寿险平衡不接班子女利益。
checks.stem: Victor owns a thriving manufacturing company that represents nearly 85% of his total estate value. His daughter Clara works in the business and will take over upon his death, while his son Leo has no interest in the company. Victor wants to pass 100% of the business shares to Clara without forcing her to sell corporate assets, while still treating Leo equitably. How is life insurance commonly used in this succession scenario?
checks.zh: Victor 拥有一家蒸蒸日上的制造公司，占其遗产总价值的近 85%。他的女儿 Clara 在公司工作并将接班，而儿子 Leo 对经营公司毫无兴趣。Victor 希望将 100% 的公司股份传给 Clara 且不迫使她变卖公司资产，同时又能公平对待 Leo。在这一企业传承场景中，通常如何运用人寿保险？

opts.t: Victor can buy life insurance naming Leo as beneficiary, so a tax-free payout roughly evens out Leo's share without splitting the business.
opts.w: 正确。在企业传承中，“公平不等于平分”企业股权；通过指定不接班子女为受益人的寿险（life insurance），可以在不拆分或出售企业资产的前提下，给不接班子女补上一份大致等值的免税身故给付。

opts.t: Leave 50% of the voting shares to Leo without a buy-sell agreement so he can negotiate a buyout price with Clara after Victor's death.
opts.w: 错误。无协议地把股份分给无意经营的继承人，会把公司推入漫天要价或僵局的家族博弈，正是传承规划要避免的陷阱。

opts.t: Require Clara to liquidate half of the factory's machinery immediately upon Victor's death to pay Leo in cash.
opts.w: 错误。被迫拆卖生产资产会严重损害企业存续能力，违背了保持企业完整传承的初衷。

opts.t: Purchase key person insurance on Leo's life owned by the manufacturing company to fund his future retirement.
opts.w: 错误。Leo 并不在公司工作，也不是公司的关键员工，公司对他没有关键人可保利益。

checks.pt: 多合伙人、关键工程师与一人公司三类典型实务场景算账。
checks.stem: Nadia is an independent IT consultant operating through a wholly owned private corporation in BC. She needs life insurance to protect her family and is deciding whether to own the policy personally or have her corporation own it and pay the premiums. Which statement accurately reflects the trade-off she faces?
checks.zh: Nadia 是 BC 省一名通过全资私人公司执业的独立 IT 顾问。她需要一份人寿保险来保障家人，正在权衡是由个人持有保单，还是由她的一人公司持有保单并缴纳保费。下列哪项陈述准确反映了她面临的利弊取舍？

opts.t: Corporate ownership is always superior because 100% of the corporate-paid premiums are tax-deductible as an ordinary business expense.
opts.w: 错误。公司持有寿险的保费原则上不可作为一般营业费用抵税（除非满足严格的受限金融机构贷款担保条件），且一人公司持保没有绝对唯一的更优解。

opts.t: Personal ownership is always required by law whenever a corporation has only a single shareholder who is also the life insured.
opts.w: 错误。法律允许一人公司作为投保人和受益人为关键股东投保，并非强制个人持有。

opts.t: Corporate ownership can cut the cost of premiums thanks to the lower small business rate, but it adds complexity when the proceeds move out through the CDA.
opts.w: 正确。利用公司较低的小企业税率（small business tax rate）留存资金缴保费比用高边际税率的个人税后收入缴费更省当期成本，但身故金进公司后只有超出调整后成本基础（ACB）的部分能进资本红利账户（CDA），且需向股份持有人或遗产分配，增加了税务与分配复杂度。

opts.t: Personal ownership causes the death benefit to be taxed at Nadia's personal marginal rate, whereas corporate ownership makes the payout taxable only to the corporation.
opts.w: 错误。无论个人持有还是公司持有，寿险身故给付进入受益人账户时第一步都是全额免税的。

checks.pt: 八大高频考场陷阱、交叉互保保费不均与 CDA 扣减误区。
checks.stem: Owen, age 29 and a non-smoker in excellent health, and his business partner Greg, age 58 and a smoker with hypertension, each own 50% of a distribution company valued at $1,600,000. They decide to fund a cross-purchase buy-sell agreement using criss-cross life insurance of $800,000 each. What practical problem will immediately arise from this arrangement?
checks.zh: 29 岁、身体健康且不吸烟的 Owen，与他 58 岁、吸烟且有高血压的生意合伙人 Greg 各持有一家估值 $1,600,000 的分销公司 50% 的股份。他们决定采用交叉互保（每人保额 $800,000）来为交叉购买买卖协议提供资金。这种安排会立即产生什么现实问题？

opts.t: Owen will have to pay a much higher premium than Greg because Owen owns the policy insuring Greg's older, higher-risk life.
opts.w: 正确。在交叉互保（criss-cross insurance）中，各股东为对方投保并支付保费；由于保费按被保险人的年龄与健康风险定价，年轻健康的 Owen 替年长且吸烟有高血压的 Greg 投保，承担的保费负担会远高于 Greg，造成严重不对等。

opts.t: Greg will have to pay a much higher premium than Owen because premiums under a cross-purchase agreement are based on the policyowner's own age and health.
opts.w: 错误。寿险保费取决于被保险人（life insured）的风险，而不是投保人（policyowner）自身的年龄和健康状况。

opts.t: Both partners will pay identical premiums because the face amount of coverage on each partner's life is exactly $800,000.
opts.w: 错误。这是“保额相同等于保费负担公平”的典型陷阱，忽略了被保险人年龄和健康差异对保费定价的影响。

opts.t: Neither partner can obtain coverage because shareholders have no insurable interest in one another's lives.
opts.w: 错误。生意合伙人或股东之间因为买卖协议付款义务与经营冲击，彼此完全具备可保利益（insurable interest）。

checks.pt: 代理人实地核保权限边界与三类核保风险的信息来源区分
checks.stem: While completing a life insurance application with a new client, Nathan, the agent notices that Nathan has a persistent heavy cough and yellow-stained fingers, even though Nathan states he has never smoked and has no respiratory conditions. How should the agent handle this situation?
checks.zh: 在与新客户Nathan填写寿险申请表时，代理人注意到Nathan持续剧烈咳嗽且手指有烟渍，尽管Nathan声称自己从不吸烟且没有呼吸系统疾病。代理人应当如何处理这一情况？

opts.t: Change Nathan's answer on the health questionnaire to smoker so the insurer receives accurate material facts.
opts.w: 错误。实地核保（field underwriting）严禁代理人擅自替申请人修改健康问卷答案，问卷须如实录入申请人本人的陈述并由其签字确认。

opts.t: Record Nathan's stated answers on the application and note the conflicting personal observations in the agent's comments section.
opts.w: 正确。代理人作为保司的「眼睛」进行实地核保（field underwriting），应按申请人陈述录入问卷答案，同时在代理人意见栏（agent's comments）中如实记录与申请人自述相矛盾的吸烟及健康观察。

opts.t: Assign a rated risk classification directly on the application form before submitting it to the head office.
opts.w: 错误。代理人不是核保员（underwriter），无权决定正式承保等级或直接给保单定级加费。

opts.t: Ignore the coughing because only a medical examination or Attending Physician's Statement can evaluate physical risk.
opts.w: 错误。代理人有义务在实地核保中记录所观察到的健康与吸烟矛盾迹象，不能因为后续可能有体检或主治医生报告（APS）而隐瞒现场观察。

checks.pt: 五档核保结论、吸烟分类与加费区别及基因与反洗钱双口径
checks.stem: Four years ago, Clara was issued a renewable term life insurance policy with a rated premium because she participated in competitive motor racing. Two years ago, she permanently gave up racing, and last month she was diagnosed with mild hypertension. If Clara contacts the insurer today regarding her policy rating, what is the expected outcome?
checks.zh: 四年前，Clara因参加竞技赛车而获发一份加费（rated）的可续保定期寿险保单。两年前她永久放弃了赛车，而上个月她被诊断出轻度高血压。如果Clara今天联系保险公司处理其保单评级，预期结果是什么？

opts.t: The insurer will increase her rating further because her newly diagnosed hypertension increases her mortality risk.
opts.w: 错误。已有效承保并符合续保保证的寿险单向保护投保人，保司不能因签发后被保险人单纯健康恶化而重新作个人风险评级加费（rated policy）。

opts.t: Clara can request the removal of the motor racing rating, and the insurer cannot add a new rating for her post-issue hypertension on the existing coverage.
opts.w: 正确。加费原因消失时，投保人可申请撤销或降低原评级（removal of rating）并相应调减保费；同时，已生效的续保保证寿险不因事后单纯健康恶化而新增个人风险加费。

opts.t: The insurer will cancel the policy immediately because any change in health or lifestyle requires a brand-new underwriting application.
opts.w: 错误。保单生效后健康或爱好变化不会导致已生效合同被取消，合同受单向保护机制约束。

opts.t: Premium ratings are permanently locked at issue and can never be reduced even if the hazardous activity stops completely.
opts.w: 错误。当导致加费的因素（如危险爱好或吸烟）消失满一定年限后，投保人有权向保司申请降低或取消该项加费评级。

checks.pt: TIA生效条件、MIB与APS规则、交付确认及2年不可抗辩期
checks.stem: During the underwriting of Victor's life insurance application, the underwriter decides to order an Attending Physician's Statement (APS) to clarify a surgery Victor had three years ago. Who is responsible for paying the physician's fee for preparing this report, and when does Victor's 10-day free-look period begin?
checks.zh: 在核保Victor的寿险申请期间，核保员决定索取一份主治医生报告（APS）以核清Victor三年前做过的一次手术。谁负责支付医生撰写该报告的费用？Victor的10天审阅冷静期从何时开始起算？

opts.t: Victor pays for the APS out of pocket, and the 10-day period begins on the day he signs the initial application.
opts.w: 错误。主治医生报告（Attending Physician's Statement, APS）的费用由保险公司承担，且审阅期从收到交付的保单时起算，而非签署申请表之日。

opts.t: The agent splits the APS fee with the insurer, and the 10-day period begins when the underwriter approves the file.
opts.w: 错误。代理人不承担APS费用，且核保批准时保单尚未交付给投保人，10天冷静期尚未起算。

opts.t: The insurer pays for the APS, and the 10-day free-look period begins when the policy is delivered to and received by Victor.
opts.w: 正确。主治医生报告（APS）由核保员直接向申请人医生索取且费用由保司承担；10天审阅期（10-day free-look / right of rescission）自投保人收到并接受交付的保单起算。

opts.t: The insurer pays for the APS only if the policy is issued as preferred, and the 10-day period can be extended indefinitely by delaying the delivery receipt.
opts.w: 错误。无论最终核保档位如何，APS费用均由保司承担；且审阅期按合同规定的收单时点起算，不能把晚签接受书当成无限制自动延后起算。

checks.pt: 免体检、简化承保、转换权核保与法定身份核验边界
checks.stem: Five years ago, Leo purchased a convertible term life insurance policy after passing full medical underwriting at standard rates. Today, after developing type 2 diabetes, Leo decides to exercise his contractual conversion privilege to convert the term policy into a permanent life policy with the same face amount. How will the insurer handle underwriting for this conversion?
checks.zh: 五年前，Leo在通过全面体检核保并以标准费率获批后，购买了一份可转换定期寿险。今天，在患上2型糖尿病后，Leo决定行使合同转换权，将该定期保单转换为相同保额的终身寿险。保险公司将如何处理此次转换的核保？

opts.t: The insurer must underwrite Leo's new diabetes diagnosis and apply a medical rating to the permanent policy.
opts.w: 错误。初次申请时的核保与行使既有合同转换权（conversion option）是两个不同环节，按合同转换权转换时无需重新证明健康状况。

opts.t: The insurer will process the conversion under the contract's conversion privilege without asking for new evidence of insurability.
opts.w: 正确。初次投保时的核保（underwriting）与行使既有保单转换权是不同环节，行使合同转换权时无需重新提供健康可保性证明。

opts.t: The insurer will force Leo onto a simplified issue questionnaire and decline the conversion if he answers yes to any health question.
opts.w: 错误。行使可转换定期寿险的转换权不需要重新填报简化承保（simplified issue）健康问卷，也不会因患病而拒批转换。

opts.t: The insurer will issue a Temporary Insurance Agreement for 90 days while reviewing his current medical records.
opts.w: 错误。保单转换不涉及新的医学核保审查期，也不需要签发临时保险协议（TIA）。

checks.pt: 远程电子投保中代理人角色与算法核保对风险逻辑的保留
checks.stem: An agent conducts a remote video meeting to complete an electronic life insurance application with a client living in another town. Compared with a traditional face-to-face paper application, how do the agent's field underwriting duties and the insurer's risk assessment logic change?
checks.zh: 代理人通过远程视频会议与居住在另一城镇的客户完成电子寿险投保申请。与传统的面对面纸质投保相比，代理人的实地核保职责以及保险公司的风险评估逻辑发生了什么变化？

opts.t: Field underwriting is eliminated in video applications because automated algorithms replace all human observation and identity verification.
opts.w: 错误。远程视频投保中「代理人是保司的眼睛」依然成立，代理人仍须履行实地核保（field underwriting）、核验身份及记录观察的职责。

opts.t: Moral hazard and financial risk are no longer evaluated once an application is submitted through an electronic portal.
opts.w: 错误。无论采用纸质还是电子算法流程，核保评估三类风险（医疗、财务、道德风险）的底层逻辑完全没有改变。

opts.t: Identity verification is optional during video meetings unless the policy face amount exceeds two million dollars.
opts.w: 错误。核验申请人身份既是合同核保步骤，也涉及反洗钱（PCMLTFA / FINTRAC）合规要求，不会因为视频投保或保额低于两百万而变成可选项。

opts.t: The core logic of assessing medical, financial, and moral risk is unchanged, and the agent still serves as the insurer's eyes by video, including identity checks.
opts.w: 正确。从纸质核保到电子与算法核保，核保判断三类风险与五档结论的底层逻辑未变，代理人依然通过摄像头履行实地核保（field underwriting）与身份核验（KYC / PCMLTFA）职责。

checks.pt: 运动爱好加费判断、离婚后可保利益时点与家族病史合规性
checks.stem: Elena, a 32-year-old accountant, quit smoking four years ago, drinks a glass of wine at dinner once a week, and skis exclusively on groomed resort runs on weekends. When she applies for a $400,000 term life policy, how is an underwriter most likely to classify her application?
checks.zh: 32岁的会计师Elena四年前戒烟，每周晚餐喝一杯红酒，周末仅在常规雪场雪道内滑雪。当她申请一份$400,000的定期寿险时，核保员最可能如何对她的申请进行分类？

opts.t: Standard non-smoker rates with no rating, because weekly social drinking and groomed resort skiing do not normally trigger one.
opts.w: 正确。戒烟满规定年限影响的是非吸烟人基础费率分类（standard rate classification），偶尔小酌与常规雪场滑雪通常按标准风险处理，不会触发评级加费（rated policy）。

opts.t: Rated smoker policy with a large automatic premium surcharge because of her past smoking history and her weekend skiing.
opts.w: 错误。混淆了信息收集与加费判定：已戒烟满规定年限可按非吸烟人费率核保，且常规雪道滑雪通常不会导致加费。

opts.t: Automatic decline because combining alcohol consumption with winter sports creates an uninsurable moral hazard.
opts.w: 错误。每周一杯红酒和常规雪道滑雪既不构成酗酒也不属于高危极限运动，更不构成道德风险（moral hazard）拒保理由。

opts.t: Simplified issue approval only, because applicants with any former smoking history are barred from full underwriting.
opts.w: 错误。既往吸烟史完全可以走正常全面核保流程，不会被限制只能购买简化承保（simplified issue）产品。

checks.pt: 八大高频陷阱识别与考场标准答案对比实务合规做法
checks.stem: An applicant tells his agent that he underwent a private genetic test last year and asks whether he must hand over the test report or avoid answering questions about his parents' heart disease on the life insurance medical questionnaire. How do the rules apply to these two items?
checks.zh: 一名申请人告诉代理人，他去年做过一次私人基因检测，并询问自己是否必须提交该基因检测报告，或者能否拒绝回答寿险医疗问卷中关于其父母心脏病的问题。规则对这两项内容如何适用？

opts.t: He must submit the genetic test report, but he can refuse to answer questions about his parents' health under privacy laws.
opts.w: 错误。完全颠倒了规则：《基因非歧视法》（GNDA）禁止要求提供基因检测报告，而询问父母的家族病史（family history）则是合法的标准核保问题。

opts.t: Both the genetic test report and questions about parents' health are prohibited under the Genetic Non-Discrimination Act.
opts.w: 错误。陷阱八：把《基因非歧视法》（GNDA）误解为禁止询问一切与家族相关的问题；事实上询问已发生的家族病史完全合法。

opts.t: He must truthfully answer the questions on his parents' health, but the insurer cannot require him to hand over his genetic test results.
opts.w: 正确。核保问卷询问父母及兄弟姐妹的家族病史（family history）完全合法且须如实告知；而根据《基因非歧视法》（Genetic Non-Discrimination Act, GNDA），保司不得要求申请人提供基因检测结果或因拒绝披露而拒保。

opts.t: Both items must be disclosed whenever the policy face amount is under two million dollars and no medical exam is required.
opts.w: 错误。无论保额大小或是否免体检，GNDA均禁止将提供基因检测结果作为保险合同条件。

checks.pt: 解释需求分析为何独立于产品推荐及企业主与离异家庭的隐性责任
checks.stem: Darius is a sole proprietor who also holds an interest in a general operating partnership. During a first meeting, his agent wants to skip detailed fact-finding and quote a life insurance policy based solely on Darius's gross annual income. Why does this approach create a severe practice risk?
checks.zh: Darius是一名独资经营者，同时持有一家普通经营合伙企业的权益。在初次面谈中，他的代理人想跳过详尽的处境调查，仅凭Darius的税前年总收入直接报价推荐一张寿险保单。为什么这种做法会产生严重的执业风险？

opts.t: Because a sole proprietorship continues indefinitely after death and automatically transfers tax-free to adult children.
opts.w: 错在混淆企业形态的法律后果：独资企业（sole proprietorship）在企业主身故后通常随之消亡，遗属损失的是自雇收入且企业资产按视同处置（deemed disposition）计算，并不会无限期存续或免税自动转给成年子女。

opts.t: Because needs analysis must precede product selection to identify capital gains from deemed disposition and actual income gaps.
opts.w: 正确：需求分析法（needs analysis approach）必须先于产品推荐，是一份独立的财务分析文件；跳过全面问询会漏掉独资企业消亡后的收入损失及普通经营合伙权益视同处置（deemed disposition）触发且通常无终身资本利得豁免（LCGE）的税负缺口。

opts.t: Because a general operating partnership interest is always fully exempt from capital gains tax under the lifetime exemption.
opts.w: 错在误用「考场旧口径与现行规则混淆」陷阱：普通经营合伙（general operating partnership）权益在身故视同处置时触发资本利得，通常不享有终身资本利得豁免（LCGE），只有符合定义的合格家族农渔业合伙权益才可能适用。

opts.t: Because BC family law automatically requires every business owner to purchase a new permanent policy for business creditors.
opts.w: 错在编造法定义务：BC省《家庭法》（Family Law Act）s.170(e)仅涉及针对已有寿险指定配偶或子女为受益人并维持缴费以担保抚养义务，并不存在强制所有企业主为债权人购买新终身寿险的法律规定。

checks.pt: 对比政府给付与资本利得豁免的考试口径与现行值
checks.stem: Clara, aged between 60 and 64, was recently widowed and has a low annual income of $20,000. Her advisor is reviewing government survivor benefits under the LLQP exam snapshot versus 2026 current figures. Which statement accurately reflects the exam figure and the 2026 rule for the OAS Allowance for the Survivor?
